tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mngon rtogs rgyan gyi skabs dang po'i spyi don sgron me rab gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs/

na mo gu ru mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ dang po snying rje'i stobs kyis byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed nas/ /bar du brtson pa chen pos grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags te/ tha mar nyes pa'i skyon bral mngon sangs rgyas nas gdul bya la/ rnam gsum 'khor lo bskor mdzod ston pa de la gus phyag 'tshal/ mgon des rang gis rin chen cod pan mchog /gang gi spyi bor bcings nas rgyal tshab tu/ dbang bskur rang chos sde lnga mdzad pa yis/ rgyal ba'i dgongs 'grel mi pham mgon la 'dud/ /de sras sa gsum brnyes pa thogs med dang*/ /dbyig gnyen grol sde rgyal sras sed+ge bzang*/ /rgyal ba gnyid pa yab sras brgyud par bcas/ /bshes gnyen rnams kyis rjes bzung byin rlobs zhig /rgyal yum dgongs 'grel mngon rtogs rgyan nyid kyi/ /tshig 'grel spyi don mtha' dpyod bcas pa zhig /sngar brjod zin mod 'dir yang rang gzhan la/ /phan phyir spyi don mdor bsdus sgron me bri/ /de la 'dir bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan 'grel pa dang bcas pa'i spyi'i dona'achad pa la 'jug par bya ste/ de ltar zhugs pa las phan yon rgya chen po 'byung ba'i phyir rgyud bla ma las/ gzhan gang 'di las tshig tsam thos shing thos nas kyang mos na ni/ /sbyin pa las byung dge ba de las de ni khyad par ches rab 'phags/ zhes pa dang*/ dbus mtha' las/ yi ge 'bri mchod sbyin pa dang*/ /zhes pa nas/ bsod nams phung po dpag tu med/ /ces 'byung ba'i phyir/ de ltar na 'di la gsum/ bshad bya rtsa ba'i mdo bzung ba dang*/ rtsa bas mdo 'chad tshul dang*/ 'grel bas rtsa ba 'chad tshul lo/ /dang po la/ snga ma kha cig rgyan gyi bshad bya rtsa ba'i mdo la yum sras bcu bdun du grangs nges pa yin te/ 'di ltar 'bum/ nyi khri/ khri brgyad stong pa/ shes rab khri ba/ brgyad stong pa/ mdo sdud pa ste yum drug dang*/ shes phyin bdun brgya pa/ lnga brgya pa/ sum brgya pa/

tshul brgya lnga bcu pa/ lnga bcu pa/ sgo nyer lnga pa/ rab rtsal rnam gnon gyis zhus pa/ ko'u shi kas zhus pa/ sher phyin yi ge nyung ngu ma/ yi ge gcig ma/ shes rab snying po ste/ sras bcu gcig tu nges pa'i phyir te/ dang po drug gis mngon rtogs brgyad tshang bar ston par yum zhes bya la/ phyi ma rnams kyis de ltar mi ston cing phyogs re tsam ston pas zhes brjod pa'i phyir zer/ de ni ma 'thad de/ yum sras kyi don dang grangs nges gnyis ka la skyon chags pa'i phyir/ der thal/ ston tshul de tsam la yum sras kyi don dang tha snyad don 'thun med cing*/ sdud pa khri brgyad stong pa'i le'u gya bzhi pa yin pas de las logs su 'dren mi rigs shing*/ sras su bzhag pa'i bcu gcig po de tsam du ma zad/ sher phyin nyi ma'i snying po/ /zla ba'i snying po/ kun tu bzang po/ lag na rdo rje/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis zhus pas mdo sogs/ sher phyogs kyi mdo gzhan du ma yod pa'i phyir/ rang lugs rgyan gyi bshad bya rtsa ba'i mdo la bzhi'am lngar gsal te/ rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum sdud pa dang bcas pa bzhi dang*/ khri brgyad stong pa logs su 'dren na lngar nges pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de rnams dang rgyan sbyar ba'i tshad ldan gyi 'grel ba yod cing*/ gzhan la de lta bu med pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis la rtsa bas mdo 'chad tshul yod de/ rnam bshad rig pa las/ mdo don smra ba rnams la ni/ /ngas ni man ngag sbyin par bya/ /dgos pa bsdus pa'i don bcas pa/ /tshig don bcas dang mtshams sbyar bcas/ /brgal lan bcas te bsnyad par bya/ /zhes 'byung pa ltar/ rgyan gyi mdo bshad thabs yan lag lnga'i sgo nas 'chad pa yin pa'i phyir te/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid las/ zhes sogs kyi dgos don gyi sgo nas 'chad/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa ni/ dngos po brgyad kyis yang dag bshad/ ces sogs kyibasdus don dang*/ sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir/

zhes sogs kyi tshig don dang*/ de nas thams cad shes pa nyid/ zhes dang*/ de nas sed+ge rnam bsgyings pa'i/ /zhes sogs kyis mtshams sbyar dang*/ chos kyi dbyings la dbye med phyir/ /zhes sogs dang*/ de la klan ka spangs pa yis/ zhes dang*/ grangs med pa sogs bstan pa rnams/ / zhes sogs kyis brgal lan gyi sgo nas gtan la phab pa'i phyir/ de ltar bshad pa la dgos pa yod de/ dgos don gyis bshad pas nyan pa po rnams kyis dgos pa gnyis mthong nas don gnyer skyes te thos bsam gyis 'jug / bsdus don gyis don rags rim zhig shes nus/ tshig don gyis don mtha' chod par shes nus shing brgal lan gyis snga phyi dang dngos shugs 'gal lam mi 'gal snyam pa'i dogs pa sel/ mtshams sbyar gyis gzhung snga phyi'i go rim 'brel chags su go nus pa'i phyir/ de skad du yang rnam bshad rig pa las/ mdo don che ba nyid mthong nas/ /nyan pa dang ni 'dzin pa la/ /nyan pa po rnams gus byed pas/ /thog mar dgos pa brjod par bya/ /de sgrub de ni bsdus don la/ /bsdus pa'i don ni tshig don la/ /go rim rig pa snga phyi dag /mi 'gal ba ni gnyis las so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa 'grel ba'i rtsa ba 'chad tshul la gsum/ /shing rta'i srol 'byed ngos bzung ba dang*/ /rgyan gyi 'grel pa'i rim pa byon tshul dang*/ /'grel pa 'dis rgyan gyi don ji ltar 'chad pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po la snga ma kha cig /shing rta'i srol 'byed la bzhir grangs te/ rje btsun byams pa dang mgon po klu sgrub gnyis dang*/ phyogs glang dang mchi ba'i sde gnyis dang bcas bzhir nges pa'i phyir/ phyi ma gnyis de ltar yin te/ slob dpon phyogs glang gis brgyad stong pa don tshan so gnyis kyi sgo nas 'grel ba la brgyad stong don bsdud mdzad/ mchi ba'i sdes rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi don rnams sgo gsum dang rnams grangs bcu gcig gi sgo nas ston pa la yum gsum gnod 'joms mdzad pa'i phyir/

phyogs glang gis brgyad stong pa'i don rnams don tshan so gnyis su bsdus nas bshad tshul yod de/ don bsdus las/ rten dang dbang du bya ba dang*/ /las ni bsgoms pa dang bcas pa/ /rab dbye rtags dang lhung ba dang*/ /phan yon bcas pa yang dag brjod/ /ces 'byung ba ltar/ rten mdo gsung pa po/ /dbang du bya ba 'khor byang sems dang nyan rang*/ las yum la ji ltar spyod tshul/ bsgom pa rnam g.yeng gi rtog pa bcu'i gnyen po/ rab dbye stong nyid bcu drug bdud las dang phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags/ sher phyin log par bzung na ngan 'gror lhung ba/ sher phyir la spyod pa'i phan yon bstan pa rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ mchi ba'i yum don sgo gsum dang rnam grangs bcu gcig gi sgo nas bstan tshul yod de/ gdul bya dbang rnon tshig gi 'go smos pas go ba rnams la bsdus te bstan pa'i sgo dbang 'bring la rnam mkhyen gyi le'u'i bar 'bring du bstan pa'i sgo/ dbang rtul la yongs gtad ky-i bar rgyas par bstan pa'i sgo gsum du bsdus nas bshad pa'i phyir/ rnam grangs bcu gcig yod de/ dang po shā ri'i bu la bka' stsal pa'i rnam grangs gcig /de nas rab 'byor la bka' stsal ba/ brgya byin gyis zhus pa/ slar rab 'byor gyis zhus pa/ byams pas zhus pa/ rab 'byor gyis zhus pa/ brgya byin gyis zhus pa/ rab 'byor gyis zhus pa/ byams pas zhus pa/ rab 'byor gyis zhus pa/ de nas kun dga' po la gtad pa'i rnam grangs rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ de la phyogs glang dang mche ba'i sde gnyis shing rta'i srol 'byed du mi rigs te/ shing rta'i srol 'byed ni 'dzam gling 'dir mdo don rang dbang du 'grel ba zhig la 'jog pas/ slob dpon de gnyis kyis mdo don rang dbang du mi 'grel ba'i phyir/ der thal/ phyogs glang gi brgyad stong don bsdus ni thogs med kyi rjes su 'brang*/ mche ba'i sde'i gnod 'joms ni mgon po klu sgrub kyi rjes su 'brang nas 'chad pa'i phyir/

gal te byams mgon gyis mdo don rang dbang du 'grel pa'i shing rta'i srol 'byed du rigs so snyam na/ de yang mi 'thad de/ shing rta'i srol 'byed ni 'dzam gling 'dir mi'i rnam par bstan nas mdo don 'grel pa po zhig la 'jog dgos pa'i phyir/ des na rang lugs la shing rta'i srol 'byed la gnyis su grangs nges pa yin te/ dbu ma pa'i shing rta'i srol 'byed la mgon po klu sgrub dang*/ sems tsam pa'i shing rta'i srol 'byed la 'phags pa thogs med gnyis su grangs nges pa'i phyir te/ legs bshad snying po las/ bde gshegs gsung rab tshul gnyis shing rta'i srol/ /legs par phye bas rgyal ba'i bstan pa mchog /sa gsum 'gro la nyi ltar gsal mdzad pa/ klu sgrub thogs med zhabs la spyi bos 'dud/ /ces 'byung ba ltar yin pa'i phyir/ shing rta'i srol 'byed ces pa'i sgra don yod de/ dper na 'jig rten na lam dogs pa dang mi bde ba la shing rta 'gro mi nus shing*/ bgrod lam yangs pa la shing rta 'gro nus pa ltar/ slob dpon 'di gnyis ma byon gong du rgyal ba'i gsung rab kyi tshig don phyogs re tsam rang stobs kyis 'grel pa'i srol byung yang*/ slob dpon 'di gnyis kyis rgyal ba'i gsung rab kyi dgongs don rgyal bas gsungs pa ltar tshul gnyis rang stobs kyis legs par phye ba'i srol chen po gtod cing phye bas na de snyad du brjod pa'i phyir/ slob dpon 'di gnyis shing rta'i srol 'byed du rgyal ba'i lung bstan pa yin te/ lang gshegs las/ lho phyogs be ta'i yul du ni/ /dge slong dpal ldan cher grags pa/ /de ming klu zhes bod pa des/ /zhes sogs kyis klu sgrub dang*/ /'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ /thogs med ces bya'i dge slong ni/ /bstan bcos de nyid don la mkhas/ /zhes sogs kyis thogs med lung bstan pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa brgyan gyi 'grel ba ji ltar byon pa'i tshul la/

spyir mngon rtogs rgyan la 'grel ba rgya gar mar grags pa nyer gcig yod de/ mdo dang rgyan sbyar ba'i 'grel pa bcu gnyis/ ma sbyar ba'i 'grel pa dgu yod pa'i phyir/ dang po yod de/ nyi khri dang sbyar ba bzhi/ brgyad stong pa dang sbyar ba gsum/ sdud pa dang sbyar ba gsum/ rgyas 'bring bsdus pa gsum ka dang sbyar ba gcig / 'bum rkyang dang sbyar ba gcig yod pa'i phyir/ dang po nyi khri dang sbyar ba bzhi yod de/ 'phags pa grol sdes mdzad pa'i nyi khri snang ba/ btsun pa ga /mdzad pa'i nyi khri rnam 'grel/ shan+ti pas ma mdzad pas nyi khri dag ldan/ slob dpon gyis mdzad pa'i nyi khri le'u brgyad ma rnams yin pa'i phyir/ brgyad stong dang sbyar ba gsum yod de/ slob dpon gyi rgyan snang*/ shan+ti pa'i snying po mchog /a bh+ya'i ka ra'i gnad kyi zla 'od rnams yin pa'i phyir/ sdud pa dang sbyar ba gsum yod de/ slob dpon gyi sdud 'grel rtogs sla/ sangs rgyas ye shes kyi sdud pa'i dka' 'grel/ dharma shrīs mdzad par grags pa'i sher phyin mdzod kyi lde mig rnams yin pa'i phyir/ yum gsum ga dang sbyar ba la gcig gam gnyis kyang yod de/ kha che mche ba'i sdes mdzad pa'i yum gsum gnod 'joms dang*/ smṛ tas mdzad pa grags pa'i yum gsum don brgyad mthun par bstan pa gnyis su yod pa'i phyir/ 'bum dang sbyar ba gcig yod de/ dharmāḥshris mdzad pa'i stong phrag brgyad pa'i bshad pa zhes bya ba gcig yod pa'i phyir/ mdo rgyan ma sbyar ba'i 'grel pa dgu yod de/ slob dpon gyis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa don gsal/ gser gling pa'i 'grel bshad rtogs dga'i snang ba/ chos kyi bshes gnyen kyi tshig gsal/ jo bo dang gzhon nu dpal dang sher 'byung blo gros gsum gyi bsdus don rin chen grags pa'i 'grel pa grags cha/ bung+ngha shri'i shes rab sgron me'i 'phreng ba/ a bh+ya ka ra'i thub pa dgongs rgyan rnams su yod pa'i phyir/

'o na 'grel pa de rnams kyi nang nas gang gi rjes su 'brang nas 'chad ce na/ slob dpon gyi mdzad pa'i 'grel ba don gsal gyi rjes su 'brang nas 'chad pa yin te/ 'grel pa 'di tshig nyung zhing don rgya che ba dang 'chad nyan byed bde zhing dgongs pa dbu mar bkral ba'i khyad chos du ma dang bcas pa'i phyir/ gsum pa 'grel pas rtsa ba 'chad tshul la gsum/ bshad pa la 'jug pa/ bshad pa nyid nye bar 'god pa/ bshad pa mthar phyin pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po la gsum/ mchod par brjod cing bshad par dam bca' ba/ 'grel ba rtsom rigs par sgrub pa/ khengs skyung zhing spro ba la bskyed po'o/ dang po yod de/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa la zhes pa'i rkang pa dang po dang bzhi pa'i gus phyag 'tshal zhes pa gnyis sbrel te bstod yul ngos bzung nas phyag mdzad pa kun gyi rgyan du 'gyur ba ni/ /zhes pas rgyan 'di yum gsum ka'i rgyan du 'gyur pa'i dgos pa/ rnam par dbye phyir zhes pa'i rtsom pa dam bca' dngos su bstan nas nying dgos dang brjod bya shugs la 'phangs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la de nas don tshan gsum gyis rtsom rigs pa'i rgyu gsum bstan te/ dam pa gong ma'i man ngag dang ldan tshul dang*/ don rtogs pa'i shes rab dang ldan pa gnyis dngos su bstan cing*/ lhag pa'i lha'i gnang ba thob pa shugs la 'phangs nas 'grel pa rtsom rigs par bstan pa'i phyir/ gsum pa khengs skyung zhing spro ba bskyed pa la yod de/ 'grel pa brtsom pa ni mkhas pa'i nga rgyal gyis kun nas bslangs pa ma yin par gzhan phan gyi bsam pa ldan pa'i sgo nas dang*/ rang nyid skyes bu dam pa'i spyod pa dang mthun par 'gyur ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa bshad pa nye bar 'god pa la gnyis/ mchod brjod kyi don 'chad tshul phye te rgyas par bshad pa/ bsdus don gzhan bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rje btsun gyis mdo bshad thabs yan lag lnga'i bshad pa de bzhin du/ slob dpon gyis rgyan bshad thabs yan lag lnga'i sgo nas 'chad pa yin te/

thog mar rgyan gyi mchod brjod bshad thabs yan lag lnga'i sgo nas 'chad par 'dzad pa'i phyir/ de yang yin te/ 'phags pa byams pa rang nyid dam pa'i spyod pa dang mthun pa zhes sogs kyis mtshams sbyar gyi sgo nas 'chad/ tshigs su bcad pa 'dis ni zhes sogs kyis bsdud don gyi sgo nas 'chad/ re zhig dad pa'i rjes su 'brang ba rnams kyis zhes sogs kyis dgos don gyi sgo nas 'chad/ nyan thos dang de'i phyogs su/ zhes sogs kyis tshig don gyi sgo nas 'chad/ de la thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyis don brgyad bsdus la zhes sogs kyis brgal lan gyi sgo nas 'chad pa'i phyir/ 'phags pa byams pa rang nyid dam pa'i spyod pa dang zhes sogs kyi gzhung 'dis mchod brjod rang don gyi dgos pa la sbyar ba la rtsod lan gnyis/ dang po la/ kha cig /de ni mi 'thad de rje btsun gyi rgyud la rang don gnyer gyi blo med pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de rang don yongs su rdzogs pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa yin pa'i phyir/ zhes rtsod/ gnyis pa lan 'debs tshul bsdu na/ rtsod tshul de mi 'thad par thal/ rje btsun sangs rgyas pa'i dbang du byas na yang mi 'thad/ byang chub sems dpa'i dbang du byas nas yang mi 'thad pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ rje btsun sangs rgyas yin pa'i dbang du byed na thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i skabs ma phyed pa'i skyon yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ thun mong ba phar phyin theg pa'i lugs gzhir 'jog pa'i tshe rje btsun byang chub sems dpar khas len rigs pa'i phyir/ der thal/ yum gyi mdo las skye ba gcig gis thogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' byams pa mngon du gyur pa 'di la dris shig dang*/ des 'di'i lan ldon par 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang*/ rgyud bla mas kyang*/ de ltar yid ches lung dang rigs pa la/ /brten nas bdag nyid 'ba' zhig dag phyir dang*/ /zhes sogs dang*/ mdo gzhan du ma las kyang rje btsun byang chub sems dpar bshad pa'i phyir/

rje btsun byang chub sems dpa'i dbang du byas na yang rtsod pa de mi 'thad par thal/ de ltar de'i rgyud la rang don gnyer gyi blo yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de'i rgyud la rang don chos sku don gnyer gyi blo yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ der rang don chos sku don du gnyer gyi gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de byang sems yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ byang sems kyis rang don du chos sku dgos pa ma mthong na/ zhi ba rkyang pas chog par 'dzin pa'i blo mi ldog la/ de ma ldog na ni theg dman lam du lhung ba'i skyon yod pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang phar phyin theg pa'i grub mtha' dang ma sbyar na ni spyir rang lugs la rje btsun sangs rgyas khas len dgos te/ lung rig du mas 'grub cing*/ khyad par du rjes tshangs cod mar rje btsun sangs rgyas kho na'i dbang du mdzad de/ bstod pa ltar khas len rigs pa'i phyir ro/ /mchod brjod ni nyan thos zhi ba 'tshol rnams zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad gcig ste/ 'di la bzhi/ dgos pa dang go rim/ grangs nges/ bstod yul mkhyen gsum ngos bzung ba/ yum sras kyi don dngos/ dang po ni/ mchod brjod kyi skabs 'dir bstan bcos lus kyi go rim dang mi mthun par gzhi shes dang por byas nas bstod pa'i dgos pa dang rgyu mtshan gang zhe na/ kha cig mdo'i gling gzhi'i go rim dang mthun par bstod pa yin te/ mdo'i gling gzhi las/ dge slong lnga stong dang thabs gcig tu bzhugs so/ /'di lta ste/ tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen po dang*/ zhes sogs kyis rten gyi gang zag bstan/ thams cad kyang dgra bcom pa zag pa zad pa zhes pas 'bras bu nyer bzhi de bstan nas thabs gzhi shes don gyis 'phangs/ de nas byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor mang po dag dang thabs gcig tu bzhugs so/ /'di lta ste/ tshe dang ldan pa bzang skyong dang zhes sogs kyis rten byang sems dang*/ thams cad kyang gzungs thob pa zhes pas 'bras bu gzhan don grub tshul de bstan nas thabs lam shes don gyis 'phangs/

de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gdan sed+ge khri bshams pa la sku drang por bsrangs te zhes sogs kyis rten sangs rgyas 'phags pa dang bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal gyi sgo nas ljags kyi dbang po bkram nas ljags kyi dbang po las 'od zer bye ba brgya stong drug cu drug cu byung ngo*/ / zhes sogs kyis 'bras bu chos 'khor bskor ba'i tshul de bstan nas thabs rnams mkhyen don gyis 'phangs pa rnams kyi don rje btsun gyis mchod brjod 'dir gsal bar mdzad pa'i phyir zer na/ de ni mi 'thad de/ bstan bcos rin chen sgron me las de ltar sbyar yang slob dpon 'phags seng gang gis kyang gling gzhi dang mchod brjod ma sbyar bas lugs de khas blang du mi rung ba'i phyir/ kha cig de ltar bstod pa de gdul bya theg pa gsum gyi lam la rim gyis 'jug pa'i go rim dang mthun par bstod pa min zer na/ de yang mi 'thad de/ rgyan 'di'i ched du bya ba'i gdul bya theg dman lam du 'jug pa med cing*/ spyir de ltar bu'i gdul bya zhig srid kyang mngon rtogs rgyan rtsom pa'i thog ma nyid nas de lta bu'i lam gyi 'jug rim ston pa skabs su ma babasapa'i phyir/ rang lugs 'dir dang po gzhi shes/ de rjes lam shes/ de nas rnam mkhyen la bstod pa'i rgyu mtshan dang dgos pa yod de/ rgyan gyi ched du bya ba'i gdul byas dang por mi rtag la sogs bcu drug rtogs pa'i gzhi shes kyi rnam pa nyams su blangs te snying rje chen pos kun nas bslangs pa'i sgo nas byang chub tu sems bskyed/ lam shes kyi rnam pa rnams nyams su blangs te mthar 'bras bu rnam mkhyen thob par 'gyur ba'i rim pa dang mthun par bstod pa yin pa'i phyir te/ de yang lam rim pa ltar ngan song dang 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsams te nges 'byung sgom pa ni gzhi shes kyi rnam pa sgom pa yin la/ byang chub tu sems bskyed nas phyin drug bsdu bzhi dang khyad par phar phyin tha ma gnyis slob pa ni lam shes kyi rnam pa sgom par byed pa yin zhing*/

de dag kyang mthar 'bras bu rnam mkhyen thob par 'gyur ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa grangs nges la/ skabs 'di'i dngos bstan gyi gtso'i lam mkhyen pa gsum du grangs nges pa yin te/ 'dir 'phags pa bzhi'i bzhi don sgrub pa'i yum la gtso bor bstod pa gang zhig /rigs can gsum gyi don dang 'phags bzhi'i bzhed don sgrub par byed pa'i thabs kyi gtso bo la/ mkhyen pa gsum las yang mi dgos shing*/ nyung na mi 'du ba'i phyir dang*/ mkhyen gsum la dngos su bstod pa la bstod grangs mang nyung gi skyon med pa nyid kyang 'di'i grangs nges kyi don yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa ni skabs 'di'i dngos bstan gyi mkhyen pa gsum gyi 'jog tshul yod de/ nyan rang slob pa rnams kyis rang gi byang chub thob par byed la bsgom bya'i gtso bor byas bsgom dgos shing*/ gnas skabs byang chub sems kyang rang rgyud kyi nyon mongs gzhom pa dang*/ gdul bya nyan rang gi rigs can rjes su 'dzin pa'i ched du bsgom dgos pa'i gzhi shes de/ tshig rkang dang po'i dngos bstan gyi gzhi shes kyi gtso bo dang*/ rigs can gsum gyi don sgrub pa'i lam shes de tshig rkang gnyis pa'i dngos bstan gyi lam shes dang*/ gdul bya rigs can gsum la chos 'khor bskor ba'i bdag rkyen byed pa'i rnam mkhyen de/ tshig rkang gsum pa'i dngos bstan gyi rnam mkhyen du 'jog pa'i phyir dang*/ rnam grangs byas na spyir gzhi shes/ lam shes/ rnam mkhyen gsum dang*/ gang zag gi bdag med dang*/ mi rtag sogs bcu drug mngon du rtogs pa'i gzhi shes lta bu dang*/ lam gsum bden med du rtogs pa'i lam shes lta bu dang*/ 'dus byas kyi chos rnams bden pa'i rkyen med du rtogs pa'i rnam mkhyen dang*/ rnam mkhyen skad cig gnyis pa lta bu rnams kyang de ltar yin pa'i phyir/ 'di'i dngos bstan gyi gzhi shes dang lam shes la rnam gzhag gi rten gyi dbang du byas pa gtso che yang der ma nges te/

de la skye ba'i rten gyi dbang du byas pas gzhi shes dang lam shes kyang bzhag mchog pa'i phyir/ der thal/ skabs gsum par bstan pa'i gzhi shes dang*/ skabs gnyis par bstan pa'i lam shes la de ltar 'jog dgos pa'i phyir/ des na mchod brjod kyi gzhung 'di'i rkang pa dang po dang gnyis pa'i dngos bstan gyi gzhi shes dang lam shes la mi mthun phyogs kyi gzhi shes dang rgyu lam shes gnyis yod par khas len dgos te/ gzhan du na ma 'brel zhing lung rigs dang 'gal bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ ji ltar na rigs pa snga ma dang gzhan yang tshig rkang dang po'i dngos bstan gyi theg dman gzhi shes yod pa thal/ de'i dngos bstan gyi nyan thos kyi 'phags lam yod pa'i phyir/ de'i dngos bstan gyi nyan thos 'phags pa yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ nyan thos zhi ba 'tshol rnams zhes pa'i mang tshig gis nyan thos slob pa 'phags pa rnams dngos su bstan pa'i phyir/ der thal/ des de rnams dngos su bstan nas rang rgyal 'phags pa shugs la bstan pa'i phyir/ der thal/ 'di'i don 'chad pa na 'grel pa las/ nyan thos dang de'i phyogs su bslan pa zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ dpyad par bya ba mang yang de tsam smras so/ /bzhi pa yum sras kyi don la/ kha cig 'jig rten na skyed pa'i ma dang*/ gso ba'i ma dang*/ don sgrub pa'i ma gsum yod pa de bzhin du/ 'di'i yum la rang sras 'phags pa bskyed pa'i yum dang*/ gso ba'i yum dang*/ bzhed don sgrub pa'i yum gsum yod ces dang*/ kha cig 'dir yum sras kyi don ni rnam par bzhag 'jog pa'i don yin gsungs na/ de ni mi 'thad de/ 'di'i yum sras kyi don ni bskyed bya bskyed kyi sgo nas 'jog pa'i phyir/ der thal/ mkhyen pa snga ma snga mas rang sras 'phags pa phyi ma phyi ma bskyed pa de skabs 'di'i yum sras kyi don du gsungs pa'i phyir te/ ji ltar bskyed na/ lam snga ma snga ma nyams su blangs pa las 'phags pa phyi ma phyi ma'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur ba'i tshul gyis bskyed pa'i phyir/

7 /chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba rnams kyis gcig dang du ma'i ngo bo nyid dang bral ba'i phyir zhes sogs ky-is skabs su sbyor ba 'god pa dang*/ gzhi lam rnam gsum bden med du bstan pa gnyis/ dang po ni mngon rtogs rgyan gyi ched du bya ba'i gdul bya chos can/ yum mkhyen gsum la dang ba skye tshul yod de/ yum mkhyen gsum gyi ngo bo dang nus pa'i khyad par la gnod pa yod med ma mthong yang mchod brjod thos pa tsam gyis mkhyen gsum la ngo bo dang nus pa'i yon tan de lta bu yod nges snyam du the tsom med par dang ba skye ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gsum/ don dam la dpyod pa'i rtags yang dag gi dgag bya ngos bzung ba dang*/ de 'gog byed kyi gtan tshigs bshad pa dang*/ rtogs pa skye ba'i rim pa bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ dgag bya ngos 'dzin dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan dang*/ ngos 'dzin tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ stong nyid rtogs pa'i lta ba rnam dag rgyud la skye ba la/ thog mar dgag bya ngos zin dgos te/ dper na/ bum pa med par tshad mas nges pa la/ sngon du bum pa'i don spyi blo yul du 'char ba sngon du 'gro dgos pa bzhin yin pa'i phyir/ de yang yin te*/ bum pa ji 'dra zhig yin mi shes na gzhi gang du'ang bum pa med par nges mi nus pa'i phyir/ de bzhin du dgag bya bden grub de ji 'dra zhig la 'jog mi shes par dgag bya de bkag pa'i bden med rtogs mi nus te/ spyod 'jug las/ brtag pa'i dngos la ma reg par/ de yi dngos med 'dzin ma yin/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir gnyis pa la/ rang rgyud pa'i lugs kyi dgag bya ngos 'dzin dbu ma snang ba las bshad pa ltar bdag gis rgyas par gzhan du brjod zin pas/ 'dir bsdu na/ gzugs sogs kyi chos rnams ni blo gnod med la snang ba'i dbang gis bzhag pa yin te/ 'phral gyi 'khrul rgyus ma bslad pa'i blo ma 'khrul pa la snang ba'i dbang gis bzhag pa tsam yin pa'i phyir te/

tha snyad pa'i blo don mthun la snang ba'i dbang gis bzhag pa tsam yin pa'i phyir/ de ltar yin gyi/ blo don mi mthun gangs ri sngon snang gi dbang shes lta bu dang*/ bden 'dzin lta bu la snang tsam gyis yod par 'jog mi nus te/ gangs ri'i kha dog sngon po min zhing bden grub yod par bzhag tu mi rung ba'i phyir ro/ /des na blo gnod med la snang ba'i dbang gis bzhag pa ma yin par yul rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i sdod lugs kyi ngos nas grub pa de/ don dam la dpyod pa'i rtags yang dag gi dgag bya mthar thug yin te/ blo gnod med la snang ba'i dbang gis bzhag tsam du grub pa de/ gzugs sogs kyi chos rnams kyi kun rdzob pa'i yod tshul yin pa'i phyir chos blo gnod med pa snang ba'i dbang gis 'jog nus kyi/ de la snang ba'i dbang gis mi 'jog par rang gi thun mong min pa'i sdod lugs kyi dbang gis min te/ yin na bum pa lta bu bum 'dzin tshad ma la snang ba de tsam gyis mi chog par/ de'i sdod lugs rang dbang gis yod dgos shing de yod na 'phags pa'i mnyam gzhag gi gzigs don yang dgos pas bden grub tu 'gyur ba'i phyir/ spyir bum pa lta bu rang gi sdod lugs kyi ngos nas grub ste/ bum pa rang ngos nas bum par grub pa'i phyir/ de ni blo la snang ba'i dbang gis phar bzhag pa yin gyi blos phar bzhag pa la ma bltos pa tshur rang gi sdod lugs kyis dbang gis ma 'grub ste/ grub na bum pa'i brda mi shes pa'i byis pa la'ang 'di ni bum pa'o snyam pa'i blo skye bar thal ba'i phyir/ des gzhan la'ang mtshon par bya'o/ /'di ba'i lugs la rang bzhin gyis grub pa/ rang ngos nas grub pa/ rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub pa/ rdzas su grub pa tha snyad du yod par bzhed kyang*/ bden par grub pa/ don dam par grub pa/ yang dag par grub pa/ de kho na nyid du grub pa rnams rtags yang dag gi dgag bya mtharathug tu bzhed de/

de rnams ni bden grub kyi rnam grangs tsam yin pa'i phyir/ de yang brtag pa mtha' bzung tsam yin gyi/ bden grub yin pa sogs med de/ gzhi grub na bden med yin dgos pa'i phyir ro/ / gnyis pa dgag bya de 'gog byed kyi gtan tshigs bshad pa la/ dbu ma ba la grags pa'i dngos po bden med du sgrub byed kyi gtan tshigs chen po lnga yod de/ rgyu la dpyod la rdo rje gzegs ma'i gtan tshigs/ 'bras bu la dpyod pa yod med skye 'gog gi gtan tshigs/ rgyu 'bras gnyis la dpyod pa mu bzhi skye 'gog gi gtan tshigs/ rigs pa'i rgyal po rten 'brel gyi gtan tshigs dang*/ skabs 'dir 'chad bya'i gtso bo gcig du bral gyi gtan tshigs dang lnga yod pa'i phyir/ dang po ni phyi nang gi dngos po rnams chos can/ don dam par mi skye ste/ bdag las mi skye/ don dam pa gzhan las mi skye/ bdag gzhan gnyis ka las mi skye/ rgyu med las kyang mi skye ba'i phyir zhes pa lta bu yin te/ rtsa she las/ bdag las ma yin gzhan las min/ gnyis las ma yin rgyu med min/ dngos po gang dag gang na yang*/ skye ba nam yang yod ma yin/ /zhes pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ de rnams chos can/ don dam par mi skye ste/ rang gi rgyu'i dus su yod par yang mi skye/ med par yang don dam par mi skye/ gnyis kar yang don dam par mi skye/ gnyis ka ma yin par yang don dam par ma skye ba'i phyir zhes pa lta bu yin te/ dbu ma brgyad las/ yod pa yod phyir skye ma yin/ /med pa nam mkha'i pad mo bzhin/ /chos mi mthun phyir gnyis chos min/ gnyis ka'i bdag nyid min pa'ang ma yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ shes bya chos can/ 'bras bu rnams don dam par mi skye ste/ rgyu du mas 'bras bu gcig don dam par mi skyed/ rgyu du mas 'bras bu du ma yang don dam par mi skyed/ rgyu gcig gis 'bras bu du ma yang don dam par mi skyed/

rgyu gcig gi 'bras bu gcig kyang don dam par mi skyed pa'i phyir zhes pa ltar bu yin te/ dbu ma bden gnyis las/ du mas dngos po gcig mi byed/ /du mas du ma byed ma yin/ gcig gi du ma'i dngos mi byed/ gcig gis gcig byed pa yang min/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/ phyi nang gi dngos po rnams chos can/ don dam par med de/ rten 'brel yin pa'i phyir zhes bkod pa'i tshe rtags de lta bu yin te/ ma dros pas zhus pa'i mdo las/ gang zhig rkyen las skyes pa de ma skyes/ /de la skye ba'i rang bzhin yod ma yin/ /rkyen la rag las gang de stong par bshad/ /gang zhig stong nyid shes te bag yod yin/ /zhes dang rtsa she las/ rten nas 'byung ba gang yin pa/ /de dag ngo bo nyid kyis zhi/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rten 'brel gyi gtan tshigs la rigs pa'i rgyal po zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ rigs pa gzhan rnams kyang mthar gtugs na rten 'brel gyi rigs pa la bltos dgos pa dang*/ rten 'brel gyi rtags kyis rtag chad kyi mtha' gnyis cig car du 'gog nus pas na de ltar du brjod pa'i phyir/ phyi ma grub ste/ rten 'brel yin par go na tha snyad du yod par go bas chad mtha' sel zhing don dam par med par go bas rtag mtha' sel ba'i phyir te/ dbu ma 'jug pa las/ de phyir rten 'byung rigs pa yis ni/ lta ngan dra ba mtha' dag gcod par byed/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ lnga pa la gnyis/ rtags chos don gsum ngos bzung ba dang*/ 'gog tshul bshad pa'o/ /dang po yod de/ 'dir gzhi lam rnam gsum rtsod gzhir bzung nas rten 'brel gyi rtags kyis bden med sgrub pa na/ bden grub kyi gcig dang bden grub kyi du ma gang rung du ma grub pa rtags/ gzhi lam rnam gsum shes 'dod chos can skyon med/ bden med sgrub bya'i chos/ gzhi lam rnam gsum bden par med pa sgrub bya yang dag

/de bzhin du bden grub dgag bya'i chos/ gzhi lam rnam gsum bden par grub pa dgag byar 'jog pa yin pas phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis/ rtags 'grod pa dang*/ tshul sgrub pa'o/ /dang po ni gzhi lam rnam gsum chos can/ bden pa med de/ bden grub kyi gcig dang bden grub du ma gang rung du ma grub pa'i phyir zhes 'god/ gny-is pa la gnyis/ phyogs chos sgrub pa dang*/ khyab pa sgrub pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po gnyis/ bden pa'i gcig bral du sgrub pa dang*/ bden pa'i du bral du sgrub pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de gsum chos can/ bden grub kyi gcig tu med de/ cha bcas yin pa'i phyir/ dper na bum pa bzhin/ rtags grub ste/ yod pa gang zhig cha med shes bya la mi srid pa'i phyir/ phyi ma der thal/ 'dus byas la yang med/ 'dus ma byas pa yang med pa'i phyir/ dang po der thal/ gang zag lta bu rang rang gi stod smad yan lag gi cha dang bcas/ bum pa lta bu mchu zhabs sogs kyi cha dang bcas/ dus dang shes pa lta bu skad cig snga phyi'i cha dang bcas pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa der thal/ stong nyid lta bu stong gzhi chos can dang gzhan gyis rtogs ma rtogs kyi cha dang bcas/ nam mkha' lta bu thogs bcas reg pa dang 'brel ma 'brel dang bu ga che chung la khyab ma khyab dang phyogs gang na yod med kyi cha dang bcas/ 'gog bden lta bu rang bzhin gyis thob ma thob dang*/ dgag bya phra rags dang bral ma bral gyi cha dang bcas pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ de gsum chos can/ bden grub kyi du mar ma grub ste bden grub kyi gcig med pa'i phyir/ khyab ste gcig med na du ma mi 'grub pa'i phyir/ der thal/ du ma gcig bsags pa la brten nas 'jog dgos pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa rtsa ba'i khyab pa sgrub pa la bden grub kyi gcig dang de'i du ma gang rung du med na/ bden par ma grub pas khyab ste/ bden par grub na de gang rung du grub dgos pa'i phyir/ der thal/ yod na gcig dang du ma gang rung du yod dgos pa'i phyir/

der thal/ de gnyis phan tshun spangs 'gal gyi dngos 'gal yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ yod pa la gcig yin pa rnam par bcad na du mar yongs su gcod dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang yod na gcig dang du ma gang rung du yod pa'i khyab pa nges pa'i tshad mas bden par grub na bden grub kyi gcig dang du ma gang rung du ma grub pas ma khyab pa'i sgro 'dogs bcad pa ni ma yin te/ byas na mi rtag pas khyab pa nges pa'i tshad mas/ sgra byas na sgra mi rtag pas ma khyab snyam pa'i sgro 'dogs mchod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de 'dra ba'i phyi rgol de la da dung de sgra'i steng du rtag 'dzin gyi sgro 'dogs gcod rgyu yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de la sgra mi rtag par rtogs pa'i rjes dpag tshad ma skye dgos pa'i phyir/ rten 'brel gyi rtags kyis myu gu bden med du sgrub pa skabs su bab pa'i phyir rgol yang dag des/ mthun dpe gzugs brnyan la brten nas rten 'brel la bden med kyis khyab pa tshad mas nges kyang*/ bsgrub bya'i chos bden med tshad mas ma nges te/ rgol ba des phyogs chos rten 'brel tshad mas nges shing*/ khyab 'brel tshad mas nges nas/ bsgrub bya'i chos nges pa'i rjes dpag skye ba ma yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ des bsgrub bya'i chos tshad mas nges zin na phyir rgol yang dag tu mi rung ba'i phyir/ dper na/ mdo sems lta bu zhig myu gu bden med du bsgrub pa'i phyir rgol byas nas nam des myu gu bden med du nges pa na mdo sde pa dang sems tsam par bzhag tu mi rung ba bzhin no/ /tshul de ni/ gcig tu bral sogs gzhan la yang sbyor/ mthun dpe gzugs brnyan lta bu bden med du tshad mas nges pa la/ bsgrub bya'i chos tshad mas nges pas ma khyab kyang*/ chos gcig bden med du tshad mas nges na de'i byed pa la brten nas chos gzhan bden med du nges nus pa yin te/ 'phags pa lhas/ /gcig gi lta bo gang yin pa/

/de ni kun gyi lta bo dang*/ /gcig gi stong nyid gang yin pa/ de ni kun gyi stong nyid yin/ zhes dang*/ gang gis dngos gcig de bzhin nyid mthong ba/ /de yis dngos kun de bzhin nyid du mthong*/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gong gi rtsod gzhir bzung ba'i gzhi lam rnam gsum zhes pa de gang la byed ce na/ kha cig de mkhyen gsum tsam la byed pa ni don ma yin te/ gzhi zhes pa ni phung khams skyed ched rnams dang*/ lam ni gnyen po'i lam spyi dang*/ rnam pa ni mi rtag la sogs bcu drug lta bu la bshad pa'i phy-ir/ gsum pa lta ba skye tshul gyi rim pa yod de/ dang po stong nyid ston pa'i gzhung la thos pas zhugs nas shes rab bskyed/ de nas gcig du bral sogs ky-i rtags la brten nas bsam pa'i shes rab bskyed/ de nas de la brten nas zhi lhag dang 'brel ba'i bsgom byung gi shes rab bskyed par bya ba yin pa'i phyir/ dbang brtul la nges pa med kyang*/ thar ba don gnyer gyi gdul bya dbang rnon gyis sems bskyed pa dang thar pa don du gnyer ba'i bsam pa dam bca' yang dag 'jog pa la sngon du stong nyid kyi lta ba bskyed pa yin te/ dbu ma rgyan las/ yang dag gshes rtsol sngon btang ste/ /don dam rnam par nges gyur pas/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ rnam bshad las tshogs lam nas bden med dang por nges par gsungs pa'i don yod de/ lam zhugs kyi thog mar lta ba gsal 'debs pa'i dbang du mdzad pa'i phyir ro/ ༈ /de la thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyis don brgyad bsdus la zhes sogs kyi skabs su rtsod pa dang lan gnyis/ dang po la/ kha gcig/rgyan gyi mchod brjod gyi gzhung 'dis mkhyen gsum la bstod phyag mdzad pa 'di/ yum mtha' dag la bstod dam/ phyogs gcig la bstod/ dang po ltar na mi rigs te/ bstod yul nyung ba'i skyon yod pa'i phyir/ phyi ma yang mi rigs te/ de ltar na rnam mkhyen lta bu gcig la bstod chog pa las/

mkhyen pa gsum ka la bstod pa'i bstod yul mang ba'i skyon snang ba'i phyir zhe na/ gnyis pa la/ de lta bu'i skyon med de/ de ltar bstod pa la rgyu mtshan dang dgos pa khyad par can gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ rgyu mtshan yod de/ /mkhyen gsum gyis 'phags bzhi'i mngon rtogs mtha' dag bsdus shing*/ de ltar bsdus pa la dgongs nas mkhyen gsum la dngos su bstod pa'i phyir/ dgos pa yod de/ /mkhyen gsum gyis bsdus pa'i don mngon par rtogs pa brgyad po yum mtshan nyid pa yin zhing*/ brgyad po des kyang 'phags bzhi'i bzhed don phun gsum tshogs pa sgrub nus so zhes shes pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ mkhyen gsum gyis don mngon par rtogs pa brgyad bsdus pa yin te/ mkhyen gsum gang rung nyams su len pa'i slob pa dang de gang rung gi nyams len yin na/ don mngon par rtogs pa brgyad po gang rung nyams su len pa'i slob pa yin pa dang de gang rung gi nyams len gyis bsdus pa zhig yin dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /༈ nyan thos dang de'i phyogs su bslan pa zhes sogs kyi skabs su/ myang 'das kyi dbye ba spyir bstan pa dang*/ rnam bzhag bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ myang 'das la sgras brjod rung gis dbye na mang ste/ rang bzhin gyis myang 'das/ theg pa che chung gi myang 'das/ lhag bcas lhag med kyi myang 'das sogs du ma yod pa'i phyir/ rang bzhin gyis myang 'das zhes pa ni stong nyid kyi ming gi rnam grangs yin te/ gdod ma nas kun nas nyon mongs phyogs kyi chos su skye ma myong ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis de ltar du brjod pa'i phyir/ 'khor 'das gnyis su phye ba'i myang 'das ni spyir 'khor ba las grol ba zhig yin yang*/ kha cig sdug bden yin la 'khor ba yin pas khyab ces bzhed pa'i lugs la de mi rigs te/ lhag bcas myang 'das la gnas pa'i nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i rgyud la sdug bden yod pa'i phyir/

sdug bden kun 'khor ba yin par 'dod mi rigs te/ ma dag pa'i snod kyi 'jig rten sdug bden yin kyang 'khor ba ma yin zhing*/ 'khor bar las nyon gyis nying mtshams sbyar ba'i so skye rnams 'khor bar 'khor pa po yin gyi/ 'khor ba ma yin pa'i phyir/ de ltar ma yin na/ mi 'thad de/ 'khor ba la bltos pa'i las bya byed thams cad gcig tu gyur pa'i phyir te/ /gang 'khor ba dang*/ gang du 'khor ba dang*/ ji ltar 'khor ba thams cad kyang dbye ba med par 'khor ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /rang lugs la ji ltar 'khor ba zhig 'khor ba'i ngo bor 'jog pa yin te/ las dang nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis yang srid du nying mtshams sbyar ba'i cha'am khyad par de nyid la 'khor bar 'jog rigs pa'i phyir/ myang 'das la bzhed tshul mi 'dra ba yod kyang*/ bsdu na 'di ltar yin te/ nyon sgrib spangs pa'i so sor brtags 'gog ni/ myang 'das kyi ngo bo yin/ de la gnyis las/ nyon sgrib ma lus par spangs shing snga ma'i las nyon gyi 'bras bur gyur pa'i sdug bsngal gyi phung po dang bcas pa'i so sor brtags 'gog ni/ lhag bcas myang 'das dang*/ de lta bu'i sdug bsngal gyi phung po dang bral ba'i so sor brtags 'gog ni/ lhag med myang 'das su 'jog pa'i phyir/ des na skabasas 'dir lhag bcas lhag med kyi don ni/ nyon sgrib spangs pa gzhir byas nas sdug bsngal gyi phung po'i lhag ma dang bcas ma bcas la byed pa'i phyir/ lugs gzhan gyis lhag bcas lhag med kyi 'dod tshul yod de/ thal 'gyur bas bden snang gi lhag ma dang bcas ma bcas la mdzad cing*/ lung gi rjes 'brang gi sems tsam pa dang*/ mdo sde pa kha cig theg dman gyi lhag med myang 'das kyi tshe na 'dus byas kyi rgyu ba gtan log tu 'dod/ bye brag smras pas lhag med myang 'das kyi tshe bem rig rgyun chad par 'dod pas de ltar na lhag bcas lhag med kyi don yang mi 'dra ba'i phyir/

myang 'das yin na/ nyon sgrib spangs pas khyab pa'i phyir na/ nyon mongs pa'i kun 'byung spangs pa'i khyab kyang*/ las kyi kun 'byung spangs pas ni ma khyab ste/ lhag bcas myang 'das la gnas pa'i nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i rgyud la las kyi kun 'byung yod pa'i phyir te/ rnam 'grel las/ srid pa'i sred las rnam 'argal ba/ las gzhan 'phen nus ma yin te/ /lhan cig byed pa zad phyir ro/ /zhes/ de'i rgyud la las kyi kun 'byung yod kyang nyon mongs med pas las kyi dbang gis 'khor bar mi skye bar bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /༈ rnam pa thams cad skye ba med pa thugs su chud pa gang dang ldan na zhes sogs kyi skabs su/ chos 'khor spyi'i rnam gzhag bshad pa dang*/ bka' dang bstan bcos kyi rnam gzhag bshad pa dang*/ 'khor lo gsum gyi grangs nges 'grel tshul bye brag tu bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po la/ ngo bo/ /dbye ba/ phye ba so so'i don/ sgra don/ chos phung gi tshad bshad pa dang lnga/ dang po la/ 'gog bden chos 'khor du mi bzhed pa mang yang 'dir chos 'khor du 'dod pa'i dbang du byas na chos 'khor gyi ngo bo yod de/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pas bsdus pa'i dam chos/ chos 'khor gyi mtshan nyid dam ngo bor 'jog pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa de la dbye na gnyis yod de/ lung gi chos 'khor dang*/ rtogs pa'i chos 'khor gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa yod de/ sangs rgyas kyi lung rtogs kyi bstan pa so sos bsdus pa'i sgo nas lung rtogs kyi chos 'khor du 'jog pa'i phyir/ lung gi chos 'khor la dbye na du ma yod de/ ngo bo'i sgo nas bka' dang*/ der gyur pa'i bstan bcos gnyis/ bka' la brjod byed kyi sgo nas gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis/ brjod bya'i sgo nas sde snod rin po che rnam pa gsum/ gdul bya'i sgo nas theg pa che chung gi sde snod gnyis/ gdul bya brjod bya dus gsum gyi sgo nas 'khor lo rim pa gsum yod pa'i phyir/

rtogs pa'i chos 'khor la dbye na du ma yod de/ lam zhugs kyi dbang du byas na lam lnga gsum bco lnga 'gog bden dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ lam ma zhugs kyi dkon gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba'i skyabs 'gro dang*/ des zin pa'i nges 'byung byams snying rje bdag med rtogs pa'i lta ba phyin drug bslab gsum dang bcas pa'ang chos 'khor du rigs pa'i phyir/ de yang yin te/ dkon gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba'i skyabs 'gro sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i 'jug sgo yin pa la rgyu mtshan yang dag pa yod pa'i phyir/ chos 'khor la bka' dang mngon rtogs gang rung gis khyab ces 'dod pa'ang yod med 'dir rje btsun bstan dar ba'i bzhed pa bzhin bya ste/ de ltar 'thad snyam du kho bo yang sems pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa sgra don yod de/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po'i 'khor lo rin po che dang chos mtshungs pa dang*/ gdul bya'i rgyud la gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa'i tshul gyis 'jug pas na de ltar dus brjod pa'i phyir te/ bsdu ba las/ de bas na gcig nas gcig tu brgyud de mthun par bskor ba'i don gyis na 'khor lo zhes bya'o/ /yang dag pa'i lta ba la sogs pa'i chos kyi rang bzhin yin pas na chos kyi 'khor lo'o/ /zhes dang*/ /'grel chen las kyang*/ 'khor lo dang 'dra ba'i na chos kyi 'khor lo ste/ chos sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ lnga pa chos phung gi tshad yod de/ mdzod las/ kha cig bstan bcos tshad ces zer/ /phung po la sogs gtam re yin/ /spyod pa rnams kyi gnyen por ni/ /chos kyi phung po mthun par gsungs/ / zhes 'byung ba ltar bzhed pa mi mthun pa yod kyang*/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen rang lugs ni phyi ma ltar yin la/ theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i lugs kyi chos phung gi tshad ni/ glang po che sā la rab brtan gyis ci tsam 'khur nus pa'i snag tshas 'bri nus pa'i gsung rab re la chos phung re'i tshad 'jog pa'i phyir ro/

/ chos phung gi grangs ni spyir lugs la brgyad khri bzhi stong yin yang*/ bye brag smra ba ltar na brgyad khri yin te/ mdzod las/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri dag /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa bka' bstan bcos kyi rnam bzhag bshad pa la/ bka' bshad pa dang*/ bstan bcos bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ ngo bo/ / dbye ba/ phye ba so so'i don bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po yodade/ rang gsung pa po sangs rgyas 'phags pas gdul bya'i mi mthun phyogs spong phyir du gsung pa'i ngag de/ sangs rgyas kyi bka'i mtshan nyid dam ngo bor 'jog pa'i phyir/ bka' zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ legs par bshad pa'i na de skad ces brjod pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi dka' de khyad chos bzhi dang ldan te/ brjod bya'i don dang ldan/ rjod byed kyi tshig dang 'brel/ 'dul bya'i mi mthun phyogs spong phyir du gsungs/ zhi ba myang 'das kyi phan yon ston pa bzhi dang ldan pa'i phyir te/ rgyud bla ma las/ gang zhig don dang chos dang nyer 'brel zhing*/ khams gsum kun nas nyon mongs spong phyir gsungs/ /zhi ba'i phan yon ston par mdzad pa gang*/ de ni drang srong gsung yin log pa gzhan/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi bka'i cha 'ga' zhig la de lta bu'i khyad chos bzhi dngos su ma tshang yang mi 'gal te/ de'i rigs gnas su 'jog pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa dbye na du ma yod de dus dang brjod bya dang brjod byed dang gdul bya dang gnyen po dang bdag rkyen gyi sgo nas dbye ba dang drug yod pa'i phyir/ bdag rkyen gyi sgo nas dbye ba la gsum yod de/ zhal nas gsungs pa dang*/ rjes su gnang ba dang*/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i bka' gsum yod pa'i phyir te/ mdo sdud pa lta bu zhal nas gsungs pa'i bka'/ gling gzhi dang mtshams sbyar dang 'thun 'gyur dang rjes su yid rang ba'i mdo rnams ni rjes su gnang ba'i bka' yin yin pa'i phyir/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i bka' la gsum yod de/

sku gsung thugs kyi sgo nas byin gyis brlabs pa'i bka' gsum yod pa'i phyir te/ sku'i sgo nas byin gyis brlabs pa'i bka' ni sa bcu pa'i mdo lta bu/ gsung gis byin gyis brlabs pa'i bka' ni ma skyes dgra'i 'gyod pa bsal ba'i mdo lta bu yin pa'i phyir/ thugs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i bka' la gsum yod de/ thugs ting nge 'dzin gyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i sher snying lta bu/ thugs bden pas byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ bden stobs brjod pas ljon shing sogs las chos ston pa lta bu/ thugs 'phrin las kyis byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las kyi dbang gis gnod sbyin sogs kyis thol byung du smras pa'i rig sngags khyad par can lta bu yin pa'i phyir/ 'dir kha cig gleng gzhi dang mtshams sbyar sogs ni sangs rgyas 'phags pa rang nyid kyis brtsams pa ma yin te/ de dag phyis sdud pa pos brtsams kyang sangs rgyas kyis rjes su gnang zhing byin gyis brlabs pas sangs rgyas kyi bkar bzhag pa tsam yin pa'i phyir/ dper na/ rgyal po'i bka' bzhin du gzhan gyis smras pa la rgyal po'i bka' zhes brjod pa bzhin no/ /gzhan du na sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul bstan pa'i rjes su de dag sangs rgyas kyis ji ltar brtsams zhes zer te dpyad par bya'o/ /gnyis pa bstan bcos la/ ngo bo/ dbye ba/ phye ba so so'i don dang gsum/ dang po yod de/ rang rtsom pa po sems can gyis rang gi grub mtha' ston pa'i phyir du brtsams pa'i rigs gnas kyi ngag de/ bstan bcos kyi ngo bo'am mtshan nyid du rigs pa'i phyir/ phyi rol ba'i bstan bcos rnams ni bstan bcos su mi bzhed pa mang yang*/ 'dir rje btsun bstan dar ba'i bzhed pa ltar bstan bcos su 'dod la/ nang pa'i bka'i dgongs 'grel du brtsams pa'i bstan bcos rnams ni/ bstan bcos rnam dag yin zhing*/ de la bstan bcos zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/

shes rgyud bslab gsum gyi ngo bor 'chos shing mi mthun phyogs las skyob pas na de skad ces brjod pa'i phyir te/ rnam bshad rig pa las/ 'chos skyob yon tan phyir na bstan bcos nyid/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ sems rnyed bkur sogs nyon mongs can gyis kun nas bslangs pa min par rgyal ba'i bstan pa dang sems can la phan pa'i ched du dmigs nas brtsams pa'i bstan bcos rnam dag ni sangs rgyas kyi bka' bzhin du spyi bor blangs nas gus pas mchod par byar rigs te/ rgyud bla ma las/ gang zhig rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'ba' zhig gi /dbang byas rnam g.yeng med yid can gyis bshad/ /thar ba thob pa'i lam dang rjes mthun pa/ de yang drang srong bka' bzhin spyi bor blangs/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa dbye na/ brjod bya'i sgo nas du ma yod kyang*/ ngo bo'i sgo nas gnyis yodade/ phyi nang gi bstan bcos gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa phye ba so so'i don ni/ rnam bshad rig pa las/ don med don log don dang ldan/ /thos rtsod sgrub pa lhur len pa/ /ngan g.yo brtse bral sdug bsngal spong*/ /bstan bcos drug bral gsum du 'dod/ /ces 'byung ba ltar/ don med kyi bstan bcos don log pa dang*/ thos pa tsam lhur len pa dang*/ rtsod pa tsam lhur len pa dang*/ ngan g.yo ston pa dang*/ brtse ba dang bral ba'i bstan bcos drug ni rnam dag min pa'i bstan bcos ltar snang yin te/ mtshan gzhi ni rim pa bzhin du/ sgra rtag par ston pa'i bstan bcos lta bu dang po/ /skye ba snga phyi med par ston pa lta bu gnyis pa/ phyi rol pa'i rig byed ston pa lta bu gsum pa/ phyi rol pa'i rtog ge'i rigs ston pa bzhi pa/ phyi rol pa'i sgyogs dang 'khrul 'khor gzhas ston pa lta bu lnga pa/ phyugs kyi mchod sbyin byed par bston pa'i phyi rol de'i bstan bcos lta bu drug pa yin pa'i phyir/ yang*/ don dang ldan pa'i bstan bcos/

sgrub pa lhur len gyi bstan bcos/ sdug bsngal spong ba'i thabs ston pa'i bstan bcos gsum ni bstan bcos rnam dag yin zhing*/ mtshan gzhi yod de/ mngon rtogs rgyan dang mdo sde rgyan gnyis de gsum ka'i mtshan gzhi yin pa'i phyir/ gnas kyi sgo nas lnga yod de/ bzo rig pa ston pa'i bstan bcos/ gso ba rig pa/ sgra rig pa/ gtan tshigs rig pa/ nang don rig pa ston pa'i bstan bcos rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ mtshan gzhi yod de/ rim pa bzhin du 'phags pa shā ri'i bus mdzad pa'i sku gzugs kyi cha tshad ston pa lta bu dang po/ /dpa' bos mdzad pa'i sman dpyad yan lag brgyad pa lta bu gnyis pa/ tsan+ḍa go mis mdzad pa'i sgra mdo lta bu gsum pa/ phyogs glang*/ chos grags kyi mdzad pa'i tshad ma'i bstan bcos lta bu bzhi pa/ byams chos sde lnga dang rigs tshogs drug lta bu lnga pa yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang*/ 'khor lo gsum so so'i dgongs 'grel dang thun mong ba'i dgongs 'grel rnams las lta ba'i cha gtso bor 'grel pa dang spyod pa'i cha gtso bor 'grel pa dang lta spyod cha mnyam du 'grel pa rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ dang po ni/ rtsa ba shes rab dang tshad ma sde bdun mdo dang bcas pa lta bu dang*/ gnyis pa ni/ mngon rtogs rgyan dang sa sde lnga lta bu dang*/ gsum pa ni/ bslab spyod gnyis lta bu sogs yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan bstan bcos kyi rigs la dbye ba mang du yod cing*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' la yang bstan bcos kyi sgra bshad du yod pa la dgongs nas bstan bcos zhes tshad ldan gyi gzhung du ma las 'byung ba la brten nas mkhas pa mang pos bka' dang bstan bcos gnyis mi 'gal bar ma zad/ bka' la bstan bcos kyis khyab par 'dod kyang*/ 'dir bka' dang bstan bcos 'gal bar 'dod pa yin te/ de gnyis sangs rgyas dang sems can gyi ngag yin min gyi sgo nas 'jog pa'i phyir ro/ /༈ gsum pa 'khor lo gsum gyi grangs nges 'grel tshul la/

dgongs 'grel las bshad tshul dang*/ gzungs rgyal gyi mdo nas bshad tshul gnyis/ dang po la/ sems tsam pa dang*/ dbu ma pa'i lugs gnyis/ dang po la/ mdo sde la 'gal spong gi dri lan dang*/ grub don ji ltar zhus pa'i tshul gnyis/ dang po yod de/ dgongs 'grel las/ bcom ldan 'das kyis rnam grangs du mar phung po rnams kyi rang gi mtshan nyid kyang bka' stsal/ zhes pa nas/ bdag yongs su zhu lags so zhes pa'i bar gyi dri ba dang*/ don dam yang dag 'phags/ ngas chos rnams kyi ngo bo nyid med pa rnam pa gsum po 'di lta ste/ zhes pa nas/ don dam pa ngo bo nyid med ces bya ba'o zhes pa'i bar gyis dri ba'i lan bstan pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ bshad bya grub don gyi mdo 'god pa dang*/ de'i don bshad pa gnyis/ dang po yod de/ dgongs 'grel las/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dang por yul wa ra ṇa sir drang srong smra ba ri dwags kyi nags su nyan thos kyi theg pa la yang dag par zhugs pa/ zhes pa nas/ nges pa'i don lags te/ rtsod pa'i gzhi'i gnas su gyur pa ma lags so/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ don bsdus te bshad pa dang*/ grangs nges 'grel tshul bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ zhu ba'i rgyu mtshan dang*/ don bshad pa gnyis/ dang po zhu ba'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ sngar don dam yang dag 'phags kyis 'gal spong zhus pa'i lan ston pas gsungs pa na/ slar yang dag 'phags kyis ston pa la bdag gis grub don 'di ltar go'o zhes zhus pa yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa 'di'i mdo tshan gsum gyis brjod bya ji ltar bstan pa'i tshul yod de/ dang po la bden pa bzhi'i rnam pa bstan pa zhes pa yan gyis 'khor lo dang po gsung pa po dang gsung pa'i dus dang yul dang gdul bya dang brjod bya rnams rim par bstan/ ches ngo mtshar ba nas rab tu bskor te zhes pa yan gyis dbye ba'i yon tan de bstan/ bcom ldan 'das kyi chos kyi 'khor lo zhes pa man chad kyis 'di'i gong na nges don gyi mdo gzhan yod pas bla na mchis pa/

rgol ba gzhan gyis klan ka'i skabs mchis pa/ sgra ji bzhin bzung du mi rung bas drang ba'i don/ don gsal bar ma phye bas dgongs pa gang yin mi mthun pa'i rtsod pa'i gnas su gyur par bstan/ gnyis pa la/ chos kyi 'khor lo gnyis pa bskor te zhes pa yan gyis 'khor lo gnyis pa gsung pa po sogs sngar dang 'dra bar bstan/ gsum pa la/ gsum pa bskor te zhes pa'i bar gyis 'khor lo gsum pa gsung pa po sogs sngar ltar bstan nas/ 'di ni bla na ma mchis pa zhes pa man chad kyis 'di'i gong na nges don gyi mdo gzhan med pa dang*/ klan ka ma mchis pa dang*/ sgra ji bzhin par khas blang du rung ba'i nges pa'i don dang*/ don gsal bar phye bas rtsod pa'i gnas ma yin par bstan pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa grangs nges 'grel tshul mdor bsdu na bzhi ste/ 'khor lo dang po drang don du 'grel tshul dang*/ bar ba drang don du 'grel tshul dang*/ tha ma nges don du grub pa dang*/ de'i sgo nas lugs 'di'i mtshan nyid gsum gyi 'jog tshul lo/ /dang po la/ 'dir 'khor lo dang po drang don gyi mdo yin te/ des phyir don bstan pa de dgongs gzhi/ dgos pa/ dngos la gnod byed gsum gyi sgo nas drang don du 'jog pa'i phyir/ dgongs gzhi yod de/ kun gzh-i'i rnam shes kyi steng du phyi rol don snang gi bag chags bzhag pa smin pa la brten nas phyi rol don snang gi rnam shes skye ba la dgongs pa'i phyir te/ de skad du yang nyi shu pa las/ rang gi sa bon gang las su/ /rnam rig snang ba gang byung ba/ /de dang de yi skye mched ni/ /rnam pa gnyis su thub pas gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ dgos pa yod de/ thabs des gdul ba'i don smra sde gnyis rjes su 'dzin pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir te/ de nyid las/ gzugs sogs skye mched yod pa ni/ /des 'dul skye bo'i don du'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ dngos la gnod byed yod de/

phyi don 'gog pa'i lung rigs rnams kyis gnod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la 'khor lo bar pa drang don gyi mdo yin te/ des chos rnams phyogs gcig tu rang gi mtshan nyid kyis ma grub par bstan pa de/ dgongs gzhi dgos pa dngos la gnod byed gsum dang bcas pa'i phyir/ dgongs gzhi yod de/ kun btags rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub pa'i ngo bo nyid med pa dang*/ gzhan dbang bdag las skyai ba'i ngo bo nyid med pa dang yongs grub chos bdag gi ngo bo nyid med pa la dgongs nas der chos thams cad ngo bo nyid med ces gsungs pa'i phyir te/ sum cu pa las/ ngo bo nyid ni rnam gsum gyi/ /ngo bo nyid med rnam gsum la/ /dgongs nas chos rnams thams cad ni/ /ngo bo nyid med bstan pa yin/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ dgos pa yod de/ ngo bo nyid med par smra ba'i rigs can rjes su 'dzin pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ dngos la gnod byed yod de/ gzhan dbang dang yongs grub gnyis so sor bden grub tu ston pa'i lung rigs rnams kyis gnod pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa la/ 'khor lo tha ma nges don du grub pa yin te/ 'khor lo dang bar gnyis kyi dgongs pa 'khor lo tha mas legs par bkral ba la brten nas dang bar gnyis drang don dang phyi ma nges don du grub pa'i phyir/ de ltar bstan pa la dgos pa yod de/ dang po drang don du bkral bas rtag mtha' spong*/ bar ba drang don du bkral bas chad mtha' spong par byed pa'i phyir/ der thal/ kun btags rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub par 'dzin par rtag pa'i mthar 'dzin dang gzhan dbang yongs grub bden med du 'dzin pa de chad pa'i mthar 'dzin yin pa'i phyir/ 'khor lo tha ma la brten nas de gnyis spong nus pa yin te/ der 'khor lo bar ba drang don du bshad pa la brten nas 'khor lo dang po yang drang don rtsa 'grel ba'i tshul gyis de gny-i+is spong bar byed pa'i phyir/ der thal/ gzugs sogs gzhan dbang gi chos rnams kyi steng du ngo bo dang khyad par la kun btags pa'i kun btags rang gi mtshan nyid kyis ma grub pa dang*/

de ltar ma grub pa de yongs grub tu bsgrubs shing de dang gzhan dbang gnyis bden grub du bstan pa la brten nas lugs 'di'i mtshan nyid gsum dang bden pa gnyis kyi rnam bzhag kyang 'thad pa grub pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa la de ltar byas na ngo bo dang khyad par la kun btags pa'i ku btags 'jog tshul yod de/ 'di ni gzugs so zhes tha snyad btags pa'i kun btags pa'i cha de ngo bo la kun btags pa'i kun gtags dang*/ 'di ni gzugs kyi skye ba'o/ /'gag pa po zhes sogs tha snyad btags pa'i cha de khyad par la kun btags pa'i kun btags yin pa'i phyir/ yongs grub 'jog tshul yod de/ de ltar btags pa ltar rang gi mtshan nyid kyis ma grub pa yongs grub tu 'jog pa'i phyir/ 'dus byas kyi chos thams cad ni gzhan dbang yin la/ gzugs sogs gzhan dbang rnams rang 'dzin rtog pa'i zhen gzhir rang gi mtshan nyid kyi grub pa ni mtshan nyid yongs chad kyi kun btags zhes bya zhing*/ de 'gog byed kyi rigs pa yod de/ theg bsdus las/ ming gi snga rol blo med phyir/ /mang ba'i phyir dang ma 'dres phyir/ /de yi bdag nyid bdag mang dang*/ /bdag 'dres 'gal par grub par 'gyur/ zhes 'byung ba 'di lta bu yin pa'i phyir/ 'di la rigs pa gsum gsungs pa'i dang po ni/ lto ldir ba la bum pa'o snyam pa'i blo skye ba de brda la mi ltos par thal/ lto ldir ba de bum pa zhes pa'i tha snyad 'jug pa'i gzhi der rang gi dngos po'i gnas lugs kyi dbang gis grub pa'i phy-i+ir/ 'dod na/ brda mi shes pa'i byis pas kyang lto ldir ba mthong tsam nyid nas 'di ni bum pa'o snyam pa'i blo skye bar thal/ 'dod pa de'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ de ltar skye ba ma mthong ba'i phyir/ rigs pa gnyis pa ni/ brgya byin gcig la dbang po dang grong 'joms/ mig stong pa sogs ming du ma btags pa'i tshe ming de dag brgya byin gcig la dngos dbang gis 'jug par thal/

brgya byin gcig po de ming du ma de dag la 'jug pa'i 'jug gzhir dngos dbang gis grub pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ ming du ma bzhin du brgya byin gcig po de yang rgyud du mar thal lo/ /rigs pa gsum pa ni/ skyes bu gnyis la bkra shis zhes ming gcig btags pa'i tshe ming gcig po de skyes bu de gnyis la dngos dbang gis 'jug par thal/ skyes bu gnyis po de ming gcig po de 'jug pa'i 'jug gzhir dngos po'i gnas lugs kyi dbang gis grub pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ ming gcig yin pa de bzhin du skyes bu gnyis po de yang rgyud gcig tu 'dres par thal/ 'dod pa de'i phyir/ des gzhan yang mtshon nus shing*/ lhag ma rnams ni gzhan du bshad zin pas 'd-ir bzhag go /༈ gnyis pa dbu ma pa'i lugs la/ rang rgyud pa dang*/ thal 'gyur pa'i lugs bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ thal rang gnyis kas blo gros mi zad pas mdo la brten nas drang nges 'byed pa yin kyang*/ drang nges 'dod tshul mi 'dra ste/ dbu ma rang rgyud pa rnams kyis grub don nas dngos su bshad pa'i 'khor lo dang po la drang don gyi mdos khyab cing*/ 'khor lo bar mtha' gnyis la drang nges kyi mdo gnyis re yod par bzhed pa'i phyir/ bar mtha' gnyis la de ltar bzhed pa yin te/ yum gyi mdo dang*/ don dam yang dag 'phags zhus kyi le'u lta bu nges don gyi mdo dang*/ shes rab snying po dang*/ byams zhus kyi le'u lta bu drang don gyi mdor bzhed pa'i phyir/ shes rab snying po drang don du 'grel ba'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ de yi 'go 'jug gang rung du dgag bya la don dam gyi khyad par dngos su ma sbyar ba ltar khas len du mi rung ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin pa'i phyir/ yum gyi mdo'i bar bar du dgag bya la don dam gyi khyad par dngos su ma sbyar ba yod kyang drang don du mi 'grel te/ de'i 'go 'jug gang rung du sbyar ba de dngos su ma sbyar ba dag la yang 'khyer dgos pas skyon du mi 'gyur ba'i phyir/

shes rab snying po las phung po lnga po de dag kyang rang bzhin gyis stong pa rnam par yang dag par rjes su blta ba'o/ /zhes pa 'dis dgag bya la don dam gyi khyad par sbyar yang dngos su sbyar ba mi 'dod de/ lugs 'dir rang bzhin gyis grub pa tha snyad du bzhed pa'i dbang gis yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa thal 'gyur ba'i lugs kyi drang nges 'grel tshul yod de/ dgongs 'grel las dngos su gsungs pa'i 'khor lo dang bar gnyis la nges don gyi mdos khyab/ des nas dngos su bshad pa'i 'khor lo tha ma la drang don gyis mdos khyab par bzhed pa'i phyir/ shes rab snying po nges don gyi mdor bzhed pa yin te/ der phung po lnga rang bzhin gyis stong par gsungs pa ni dgag bya la don dam gyi khyad par dngos su sbyar ba'i sgra ji bzhin pa yin par bzhed pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ gzungs rgyal nas 'khor lo gsum gyi tha snyad dngos su ma gsungs kyang gdul bya bkri ba'i rim pa'i dbang du byas pa'i 'khor lo gsum gsungs pa yin te/ de'i rim pa dang pos gdul bya'i 'khor ba la yid 'byung ba'i tshul bstan/ bar pas zab mo'i lam la khrid pa'i tshul bstan/ gsum pas zab pa dang rgya che ba'i spyod pa gnyis kas zung 'brel gyi sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i tshul bstan cing*/ de yang gdul bya rgyud gcig lam la rim gyis 'khrid pa'i dbang du mdzad pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /༈ de ltar phyag 'tshal ba dang bstod pa sngon du 'gro ba'i bstan bcos zhes sogs kyi skabs su gnyis/ rtsod pa dang*/ de'i lan bshad pa'o/ /'dir rtsod mkhan dngos su med kyang slob dpon gyis dogs pa bsu ba'i dbang du mdzad de/ rje btsun gyis mchod brjod kyi skabs su gzhung gzhan nas mchod brjod kyi yul du smos pa'i sangs rgyas byang sems sogs la bstod phyag dngos su mdzad par yum mkhyen pa gsum la bstod phyag mdzad pas/ mkhyen gsum brjod byar byed pa'i bstan bcos zhig rtsom mam/

de rtsom na yul gzh-i gnyen rnam gsum gtan la ma phab par yum mkhyen pa gsum gtan la 'bebs mi nus pas/ gzhi gnyen rnam pa gsum gyi nang nas gzhi kho na brjod byar byed dam/ gnyen po kho na brjod byar byed dam/ rnam pa kho na brjod byar byed brtag grang*/ dang po ltar na mi 'thad de/ chos mngon pa dang zlos pa'i skyon yod pa'i phyir/ der thal chos mngon pa nas gzhi phung khams sogs gtan la phab pa las lhag 'dir mi 'byung ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ltar na yang mi rigs te/ gnyen po kho na brjod de kun nas nyon mongs phyogs ma bstan na gnyen po rnams spang bya gang gi gnyen po yin pa khong du chud par mi 'gyur ba'i phyir/ gsum pa ltar na rnam pa bzhi bcas su ston nam/ gzhi med du ston/ dang po ltar na mi 'thad de/ mngon pa dang zlos pa'i skyon de nyid du 'gyur ba'i phyir gnyis pa ltar na'ang mi 'thad de/ mi rtag pa dang bdag med pa sogs rnam pa rnams gzhi gang dang 'brel ba khong du chud mi nus pas bstan bcos brtsams pa don med du thal ba'i phyir ro/ /zhe na/ gnyis pa lan la/ lan dngos dang*/ shes byed kyi lung dgos pa dang*/ lung gi don bshad pa dang*/ don bsdu ba bzhi'o/ /dang po ni/ de ni ma yin te gang gi phyir zhes sogs kyis bstan te/ mngon rtogs rgyan chos can/ khyod kyis gzhi gnyen rnams re re kho na brjod byar bsdus pa'i sgo nas skyon med de/ khyod kyis gzhi gnyen rnam gsum brjod byar byed cing*/ de yang gzhi gnyen rnam pa gsum gas mkhyen gsum mtshon pa'i tshul gyis mkhyen gsum gtan la 'bebs pa'i phyir/ mkhyen gsum brjod byar gtan la 'bebs pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ 'phags bzhi'i mngon rtogs mtha' dag gtan la 'bebs par bzhed pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ khyen gsum gyis 'phags bzhi'i mngon mtha' dag bsdus pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa shes byed kyi lung 'god pa la/ yum bar ma dang bsdus pa'i shed byed dang rgyas pa'i shes byed kha 'phangs pa gsum/

dang po la mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ mkhyen gsum gyis 'phags bzhi'i mngon rtogs mtha' dag bsdus te/ rgyal ba'i yum bar ma las/ rab 'byor thams cad shes pa nyid ni nyan thos dang*/ zhes pa nas/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi yin no/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la gsum yod de/ gzhi shes kyis nyan rang gi mngon rtogs bsdus tshul dang*/ lam shes kyis byang sems dang*/ rnam mkhyen gyis sangs rgyas kyi mngon rtogs bsdus tshul gsum yod pa'i phyir te/ gsum yod de/ dang po ni bcom ldan 'das ci'i slad du thams cad shes pa nyid nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi lags/ zhes sogs dang*/ gnyis pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das ci'i slad du lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid byang chub sems pa rnams kyi lags/ zhes sogs dang*/ gsum pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das ci'i slad du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi lags/ zhes sogs kyis 'chad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa bsdus pa'i shes byed kyang yod de/ de nyid las/ nyan thos kyi sa la slob par 'dod pas kyang sher phyin la bslab par bya'o zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa rgyas pa la kha 'phangs tshul yod de/ rgyas pa las kyang rgya cher zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa dang bzhi pa don bshad pa dang don bsdu ba'i tshul yod de/ dang po ni/ de la thams cad shes pa nyid ces sogs dang*/ gnyis pa ni/ de lta bas na zhes sogs kyis 'chad pa'i phyir ro/ /༈ rab 'byor nyan thos kyi lam gang yin pa dang zhes sogs kyi skabs su/ 'dir bstan shes bya'i lam gsum ngos bzung ba/ de gsum lam gang nas shes bskyed rdzogs gsum byed pa/ rdzogs smin sbyangs gsum gyi tshad/ yang dag mtha' ngos bzung nas de mngon du byas tshad/ spyir btang dmigs gsal gyi don bshad pa dang lnga/ dang po la bzhed pa mi 'dra ba mang yang rang lugs yod de/

gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes de 'dir bstan shes bya'i nyan thos kyi lam dang*/ rnam bzhag gi dbang du byas pa'i nyan thos kyi lam yang yin/ de bzhin du gzugs 'dzin gnyis stong mngon gsum rtogs pa'i ye shes de rang rgyal gyi lam dang*/ stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes de sangs rgyas kyi lam du 'jog pa'i phyir/ dang po gnyis nyan rang gi rtogs rigs su gnas pa dang bsgom bya'i gtso bo yin pas de'i lam zhes bya'o/ /de gnyis nyan rang gi lam dngos min te/ theg chen 'phags pa'i rgyud la yang yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa lam gsum po de lam gang nas shes skyed rdzogs gsum byed pa'i tshul yod de/ dman lam sngon du ma song ba'i theg chen rigs nges rnams kyis sa dang po nas nyan rang gi rtogs rigs rags pa dang sa brgyad pa nas spang rigs rags pa zhig rdzogs pa yod kyang*/ de rnams kyis nyan rang gi spangs rtogs kyi rigs ma lus par rdzogs pa dang sangs rgyas pa dus mnyam pa'i phyir te/ de rnams kyis sgrib gnyis cig car du spong ba'i phyir/ der thal/ kun las btus las/ cig car nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa spong*/ cig car dgra bcom pa dang de bzhin gshegs par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ sa dang po nas rtogs rigs rags pa zhig rdzogs te/ sa der bdag med gnyis mngon sum du rtogs pa 'byung ba'i phyir te/ sa brgyad pa nas spangs rigs rags pa zhig rdzogs te/ bden 'dzin mngon 'gyur ba spangs pa'i phyir/ sa dang po nas nyan rang ltar nyon mongs spang bya'i gtso bor byas te spong pa la 'bad na de spong nus pa yin te/ sa dang po ba de nyan rang las lam gyi rtogs pa dang bsod nams dang dbang po sogs khyad zhugs pa'i lam gyi nus pa dang ldan pa'i phyir te/ theg chen mthong lam sdug bsngal chos bzod kyi byed par nyan rang gi spangs rtogs kyi byed pa 'dus pa'i don yod pa'i phyir/

gsum pa rdzogs smin sbyangs gsum so so'i tshad yod de/ chos nyid la rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag bzhin pa'i ngang nas gzhan don 'bad med lhun grub tu byed nus pa'i rgyu'i dge ba'i rtsa ba'i nus pa yongs su rdzogs pa de/ 'dir bstan smon lam yongs su rdzogs tshad dang*/ zhing bye ba phrag brgya la sogs par sku'i bkod pa ji snyed bstan pa'i 'khor sems can grangs med pa la chos tshigs bcad re bstan pas kyang 'phags lam la 'god nus pa'i rgyu'i dge rtsa'i nus pa yongs su rdzogs pa de/ 'dir bstan sems can smin pa'i tshad dang*/ rang nyid gang du 'tshang rgya 'gyur gyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing khyad par can 'grub pa'i rgyu'i dge rtsa'i nus pa yongs su rdzogs pa de/ 'dir bstan sangs rgyas kyi zhing sbyangs pa'i tshad yin pa'i phyir/ phyi ma de la longs sprul gyi zhing sbyangs pa'i tshad gnyis yod de/ dang po ni/ longs skur sangs rgyas pa'i zhing der 'khor byang 'phags sha stag 'byung ba dang*/ gnyis pa ni/ sprul skur 'tshang rgya ba'i zhing khyad par can der 'khor mngon shes lnga ldan sha stag 'byung ba'i dge rtsa'i nus pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i sgo nas/ de gnyis kyi zhing sbyangs pa'i tshad du yang 'gyur ba'i phyir/ sprul skur 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul bstan pa'i zhing yin na dag pa'i zhing yin pas ma khyab ste/ bdag cag gi ston pa ni/ zhing 'dir sprul skur 'tshang rgyal ba'i tshul bstan kyang 'di dag pa'i zhing ma yin pa'i phyir/ sprul sku'i zhing dag pa rnams kyang 'dra ba min te/ zhing kha cig gi rgya khyon ni stong gsum dang mnyam zhing 'phags pa kho nas spyod pa dang*/ 'ga' zh-i+ig ri rgya chung zhing so skye yang skye nus la/ la lar skyes pa ni slar ngan song du ldog mi srid cing*/ 'ga' zhig tu skyes kyang der ldog srid pa dang*/ bde ba can lta bu na rdzus skyes dang*/ mi 'khrugs pa'i zhing na mngal skyes yin pa sogs mi 'dra ba yod pa'i phyir ro/

/bzhi pa yang dag mtha' ngos bzung nas mngon du byas tshad bshad pa la/ spyir bstan pa dang*/ 'dir bstan yang dag mtha' ngos bzung ba gnyis/ dang po la/ yang dag mtha' ni stong nyid dang don gcig ste/ dbus mtha' las/ stong pa nyid ni mdor bsdu na/ de bzhin nyid dang yang dag mtha'/ /mtshan ma med dang don dam dang*/ / chos kyi dbyings kyi rnam grangs so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir spyir yang dag mtha' mngon du byas pa'i sems can med de/ de bzhin nyid mngon du byas pa'i sems can med pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de bzhin nyid mngon du byas pa'i gang zag la sangs rgyas 'phags pas khyab pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de bzhin nyid las slar mi ldang ba'i tshul gyis mnyam par bzhag pa'i gang zag yin na/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa yin pas khyab pa'i phyir/ der thal/ yab sras mjal ba'i mdo las/ de bzhin gshegs pas stong pa nyid rab tu gzigs/ rab tu mkhyen/ legs par mngon du byas pa de'i tshe thams cad mkhyen pa zhes brjod do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'dir bstan gdams don gtso bor gyur pa'i yang dag mtha' ni/ sdug bsngal gsum gyi nang nas khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal nye bar zhi ba'i nyer zhi'i dbyings la bzhed cing*/ de ni khyad chos gsum dang ldan te/ dman lam sngon du ma song ba'i byang sems kyis rdzogs smin sbyangs gsum ma byas pa'i snga rol du mngon du byed nus kyang mi byed/ byas rjes su mngon du byed/ ma byas pa'i snga rol mngon du byas na zhi mthar ltung ba'i dgag bya yod pa'i khyad chos dang ldan pa'i phyir/ dang po sgrub ste/ byed mi nus na gdams pa smos pa la dgos pa mi 'byung ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa grub ste/ byas rjes su chos sku de bzhin nyid mngon du byed dgos pa'i phyir/ gsum pa grub ste/ dmigs bsal gsum ma rdzogs gong du gal te khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal nye bar bzhi ba'i myang 'das mngon du byas na zhi ba'i bde ba tsam gyis thugs 'phrog nas gzhan don byed pa la g.yel ba nyan rang dgra bcom pa ltar 'gyur ba'i skyon yong ba'i phyir/

mchog gi sprul skus chos gsum ma rdzogs gong du 'dir bstan gdams don gtso bor gyur pa'i yang dag mtha' khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal nye bar zhi ba'i nyer zhi'i dbyings mngon du ma byed ces gdams pa'i tshul yod de/ des theg chen rigs nges kyi byang sems la chos gsum ma rdzogs gong du de lta bu'i lhag med myang 'das mngon du ma byed cig /gal te mngon du byas na/ de'i tshe bzhi ba'i bde bas yid 'phrog nas gzhan don rgya chen po byed pa las nyams te dman pa'i zhi mthar ltung pa'i dgag bya che ba'i phyir zhes gdams pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'o na/ lhag med myang 'das zhes brjod pas chog gi /khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal nyer bar zhi ba'i nyer zhi'i dbyings zhes brjod ci dgos snyam na/ dgos pa yod de/ lhag med myang 'das de ni snga ma'i las nyon gyi 'bras bur gyur pa'i sdug bsngal gyi phung po spangs pa'i zhi ba dang dbyings dngos btags ci rigs yin pa'i go don dang bcas te de ltar du brjod pa'i phyir/ de yang yin te/ sdug bsngal gsum gyi nang nas 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal ni las nyon gyi dbang gis blangs pa'i nyer len gyi phung po lnga lta bu la zer la/ lhag med myang 'das yin na/ de nye bar zhi ba'am spangs pa yin dgos shing*/ thal 'gyur bas myang 'das la dbyings yin pas khyab ces bzhed pa ltar 'dir mi 'dod kyang dbyings yin pa'am de'i phyogs gtogs bdag med rags pa zhig la'ang dbyings zhes brjod pa yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de ltar 'dod pa myang 'das la bdag med rags pa zhig bzhed pa'i dbang gis yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ lugs 'dir theg dman gyi lhag med myang 'das thog mar mngon du byas pa'i tshe stong nyid mngon gsum du rtogs par mi bzha/ pas/ de'i tshe nyan thos lhag med pas gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i sgo nas myang 'das de mngon du byas shing*/

rang rgyal lhag med pas gnyis stong gi de kho na nyid rtogs pa'i sgo nas de mngon du byas par bzhed pas na 'dir bstan gdams don gyi gtso bo'i yang dag mtha' la de lta bu'i bdag med rags pa zhig kyang yod pa'i phyir/ 'dir bstan gdams don gyi gtso bo'i yang dag mtha' mngon du byed pa'i tshad yod de/ theg chen gyi dbang du byas na/ rdzogs smin sbyangs gsum byas rjes su khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal nye bar zhi ba'i nyer bzhi'i dbyings las slar mi ldang ba'i tshul gyis mnyam par bzhag pa'i tshe/ 'dir bstan yang dag mtha' mngon du byas pa yin la/ theg dman gyi dbang du byas na tshes gsum ma rdzogs gong du de lta bu'i dbyings la zhi ba'i bde bas thugs phrogs pa'i sgo nas gnas chod ma yin par rang gi bsam ngo tsam la bltos nas slar mi ldang ba'i tshul gyis mnyam par bzhag pa'i tshe/ 'dir bstan yang dag mtha' mngon du byas par 'jog pa'i phyir/ 'o na de lta bu'i theg dman dgra bcom de mchog gi sprul sku'i gdams pa dang 'gal nas sam/ ma 'gal bar de mngon du byas zhe na/ 'di la gnyis yod par mngon te/ dang po nyid las theg dman du rigs nges pa ni gdams pa de dang 'gal bar 'jog mi nus kyang*/ theg dman du ltung nas de mngon du byas pa ni gdams pa de dang 'gal nas mngon du byas par 'dod rigs pa'i phyir/ de yang zhar byung gi gdams pa dang 'gal ba yin gyi/ gtso bor gdams pa dang 'gal ba min te/ gtso bor ni theg chen rigs nges kyi byang sems rnams dang sa brgyad pa pa lta bu la gdams pa yin pa'i phyir/ phyi ma yin te/ dman lam sngon du ma song ba'i sa brgyad pa ba des bden 'dzin mngon 'gyur ba spangs shing*/ mi rtog ye shes la goms pa dbang bsgyur thob pas/ de ltar na des chos gsum ma rdzogs gong du 'dir bstan yang dag mtha' mngon du byed dam snyam pa'i dogs pa che bas de ltar du gdams pa yin pa'i phyir/

ji skad du/ rgyal ba rnams kyis 'gog las slong bar mdzad/ /ces pa yang tshul 'di lta bu la dgongs pa'i phyir/ de yang brtag pa mtha' bzung tsam yin te/ sa brgyad pa nas de lta bu 'byung ba mi srid cing*/ mchog gi sprul sku la'ang de ltar du dogs pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /mdor na byang sems kyis chos gsum ma rdzogs gong du zhi ba'i dbyings la dus ring bar 'jog tu mi rung ste/ sher phyin sogs mdo sde du ma las nyan rang zhi ba'i dbyings su zhugs nas gzhan don rgyun gcod kyang*/ byang 'phags zhi ba thob pa rnams ni zhi ba'i dbyings la yun ring du 'jug pa dor nas snying rje chen po'i dbang gis 'khor ba'i gnas su yang dang yang du skye ba 'dzin par bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /lnga pa spyir btang dmigs bsal gyi don yod de/ 'dir byang sems rnams kyi lam gsum gyi bya ba byed pa spyir btang nas chos gsum ma rdzogs bar du 'dir bstan yang dag mtha' mngon du mi byed cing dmigs kyis bsal ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /༈ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid lam/ zhes sogs kyi skabs su/ bstan bcos lus kyi dgos sogs chos bzhi bshad pa dang*/ dgos 'brel ngag gi dgos sogs chos bzhi bshad pa gnyis/ dang po yod de/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid lam/ /ston pas 'di las bshad pa gang*/ /zhes pas brjod bya bstan pa ltar rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi don rnams rgyan 'di'i brjod bya/ rgyan 'di la brten nas yum gyi don bde blag tu rtogs pa de dgos pa/ de la brten nas sa bcu dang rnam mkhyen thob par 'gyur ba de nying dgos/ chos gsum phyi ma snga ma 'brel ba'i 'brel ba yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa yod de/ rgyan 'di'i dgos sogs chos bzhi po de dgos 'brel ngag gi brjod bya/ ngag de la brten nas rgyan 'di la dgos sogs chos bzhi yod par rtogs pa de de'i dgos pa/ rtogs pa la brten nas rgyan la don gnyer gyis 'jug pa de de'i nying dgos/

chos gsum gyi phyi ma snga ma la 'brel ba de de'i 'brel ba yin pa'i phyir/ chos spyod bcu yi bdag nyid kyi/ /zhes pa'i chos spyod bcu po de gang la byed ce na/ yod de/ rje btsun shaṇ+ti pas dbu mtha' las/ yi ge 'bri mchod sbyin pa dang*/ /nyan dang klog dang len pa dang*/ /'chad dang kha ton byed pa dang*/ /de sems pa dang bsgom pa dang*/ /spyod pa 'di bcu'i bdag nyid de/ /bsod nams phung po dpag tu med/ /ces 'byung ba ltar bzhed/ gser 'phreng sogs las phar phyin bcu la bzhed/ rnam bshad las rnam mkhyen mtshon byed kyi chos bcu las bshad pa'i phyi ma ltar yin pa'i phyir/ /༈ shes rab pha rol phyin pa ni/ zhes sogs kyi skabs su sher phyin la/ ngo bo/ /dbye ba/ phye ba so so'i don/ dngos btags kyi khyad par dang bzhi/ dang po yod de/ theg chen sems bskyed kyis zin pa'i sgo nas stong nyid rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi mkhyen pa/ sher phyin gyi ngo bo'am mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa dbye ba la sgras brjod rigs kyi dbye na du ma yod de/ rang bzhin gyi sher phyin/ gzhung sher phyin/ lam sher phyin/ 'bras bu sher phyin dang bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa phye ba so so'i don la/ rang bzhin gyi sher phyin dang*/ rang bzhin gyi yum/ rang bzhin gyi myang 'das don gcig yin te/ de rnams don dam bden pa'i rnam grangs tsam yin pa'i phyir/ gzhung sher phyin gyi gtso bo ni yum rgyas 'bring bsdus pa lta bu sogs stong nyid ston pa'i sher phyogs kyi mdo rnams yin la/ de la bkas ma khyab ste/ mngon rtogs rgyan dang*/ dbu ma rtsa ba shes rab lta bu yang gzhung sher phyin du rigs pa'i phyir/ thabs shes khyad par can gnyis kyis zin pa'i sems dpa'i ye shes rnams lam sher phyin yin kyang thabs shes kyis zin pa'i sems dpa'i ye shes la lam sher phyin gyis ma khyab ste/ stong nyid rtogs ma myong zhing bdag med rags pa rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i sems dpa'i ye shes rnams ni lam sher phyin du mi rigs pa'i phyir/

'bras bu sher phyin yin na/ rnam mkhyen yin pas khyab ste/ de dang rnam mkhyen don gcig pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa dngos btags kyi khyad par yod de/ rang bzhin gyi sher phyin rnams sher phyin btags pa ba dang*/ gzhung sher phyin rnams kyang sher phyin btags pa ba yin la/ lam sher phyin la dngos btags gnyis yod cing*/ 'bras bu sher phyin yin na sher phyin yin dgos pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ de rnams sher phyin gyi yul gyi gtso bo yin pas yul la yun can gyi ming gis btags pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa grub ste/ lam 'bras kyi sher phyin rnams brjod bya ston pa'i brjod bya'i ming brjod byed la btags pa'i phyir/ gsum pa grub ste/ byang 'phags rgyud kyi bdag med rags pa rtogs pa'i ye shes lta bu sher phyin min la/ de'i rgyud kyi stong nyid rtogs pa'i ye shes rnams sher phyin yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa grub ste/ 'bras bu sher phyin yin na/ phyin zin pa'i sher phyin yin dgos pa'i phyir/ 'bras bu sher phyin de khyad chos gsum mam bzhi dang ldan te/ rten sangs rgyas 'phags pa kho na la yod pa/ ngo bo zag med kyi ye shes yin pa/ gzhal bya bden pas stong pa gsum dang*/ khyad par bden stong sgyu ma lta bu bzhi dang ldan pa'i phyir/ kha cig rnam bshad kyi sgras zin la brten nas sher phyin la/ 'bras bu sher phyin gyis khyab par 'don cing*/ gser 'phreng las sher phyin la stong nyid mngon gsum du rtogs pa'i theg chen 'phags pa'i mkhyen pas khyab par bshad kyang*/ rang lugs ni rje btsun bstan dar ba'i bzhed pa ltar yin te/ sher phyin la phyin byed kyi sher phyin dang phyin zin pa'i sher phyin gnyis kyi dbye ba 'thad pa'i phyir/ der thal/ phyin byed dang sbyar na slob lam la sher phyin yod pa'i phyin/ der thal/ rnam bshad dgongs pa rab gsal las/ 'dis pha rol tu phyin pa zhes byed pa la sbyar na slob lam na yang sher phyin yod do/

/zhes gsungs pa'i phyin/ 'on kyang shes rab kyi phar phyin la sher phyin gyis khyab pa min stai/ sher phyin yin na stong nyid rtogs pa'i ye shes yin dgos kyang*/ shes rab kyi phar phyin la ni stong nyid ma rtogs kyang rdzogs byang du bsngos pa'i bsngo ba rnam dag dang stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pas kyang 'grub pa'i phyir/ 'jug pa'i rnam bshad ltar na dpyad rgyu yod kyang*/ re zhig phar phyin drug po gang rung la/ stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin dgos pa gtso chen ste/ des ma zin pa'i byang sems kyi sbyin sogs dang po lnga la phar phyin gyi ming khyad par can mi thob pa'i phyir te/ de skad du yang*/ mdo bsdud pa las/ dmus long dmigs bu med pa bye ba khrag khrig rnams/ /lam yang mi shes grong khyer 'jug par ga la 'gyur/ /shes rab med na mig med pha rol phyin lnga 'di/ /dmigs bu med pas byang chung reg par nus ma yin/ /gang tshe shes rab kyis ni rab tu zin gyur na/ /de tshe mig rnyed gyur cing 'di yi ming 'thob po/ /zhes dang*/ dbu ma 'jug pa las/ ji ltar long ba'i tshogs kun bde blag tu/ /mig ldan skyes bu gcig gi 'dod pa yis/ /yul du 'khrid pa de bzhin 'dir yang blos/ /mig nyams yon tan blangs te rgyal nyid 'gro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa ni/ /zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi sher phyin de gzhung sher phyin la byed pa yin te/ de ni yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum la byed rigs pa'i phyir/ 'di'i rkang pa gnyis kyis rgyan gyi lus mdor bstan pa yin te/ rgyan gyi brjod bya la dngos po brgyad du phye nas mdor bstan pa'i phyir/ rnam kun mkhyen nyid lam shes nyid/ ces pa nas/ rnam pa bzhi ni yang dag brjod/ ces pa'i bar gyis lus rgyas par bshad pa yin te/ nges don bdun cu'i sgo nas rgyas par 'chad pa'i phyir/ dngos po brgyad yod de/

mkhyen pa gsum dang*/ sbyor ba bzhi dang*/ 'bras bu chos sku dang brgyad yin la/ don mngon par rtogs pa brgyad kyi tha snyad byed pa'i tshe/ phyi ma'i dod la ye shes chos sku zhes 'dren pa'i phyir/ don bdun bcu 'jog tshul yod de/ rnam mkhyen mtshon byed chos bcu/ lam shes mtshon byed kyi chos bcu gcig /gzhi shes mtshon byed kyi chos dgu /rnam rdzogs sbyar ba mtshon byed kyi chos bcu gcig /rtse sbyor mtshon byed kyi chos brgyad/ mthar gyis sbyor ba mtshon byed kyi chos bcu gsum/ skad cig sbyor ba mtshon byed kyi chos bzhi/ 'bras bu chos sku mtshon byed kyi chos bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ mtshon tshul yod de/ rnam mkhyen mtshon byed bcus rnams mkhyen yul can gyi sgo nas mtshon la/ gzhan rnams ngo bo dang yul dang byed las ci rigs kyis mtshon pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ sems bskyed sogs chos bcu nyams su blangs nas mthar phyin pa'i sgo nas de mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes ni rnam mkhyen nyid yin no zhes mtshon par byed pa'i phyir/ sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir/ zhes sogs kyi skabs su/ rtsod lan dang*/ sems bskyed kyi rnam bzhag bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ rtsa bar/ byang chub 'dod/ ces sems bskyed la 'dod pa'i ming gis bstan pa la/ kho na re/ de lta bu'i 'dod pa de chos can/ sems bskyed ma yin par thal/ sems 'byung yin pa'i phyir/ zhe na/ skyon med de/ theg chen sems bskyed la 'dod pa'i ming gis btags shing de la dgos pa gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ phyi ma yin te/ sems bskyed la gzhan don 'dod pa rgyur dgos shing*/ rang don 'dod pa grogs su dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin pa'i phyir/ de yang yin te/ theg chen sems bskyed skye ba la sems can sdug bsngal dang bral na snyam pa sogs gzhan don don gnyer gyi blo sngon du 'gro dgos shing*/

de rang gi grogs rdzogs pa'i byang chub don gnyer gyi bdun pa dang mtshungs ldan yin par shes pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ sems bskyed kyi rten dang*/ brten pa sems bskyed bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ lus rten dang sems rten bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ theg chen sems bskyed gsar du skye ba'i lus rten gyi khyad par yod de/ gling gsum gyi mi dang*/ 'dod gzugs kyi lha'i rten la gsar du skye ba yod cing*/ ngan song gsum dang lha min dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang dri za sogs kyi rten la yang gsar du skye ba srid pa'i phyir/ gzugs med khams pa dang 'tshams med stobs chen byas pa sogs dang*/ za ma ma ning sgra mi snyan pa'i rten la gsar du skye ba med de/ gzugs med na tshor ba sdug bsngal med cing*/ gzhan rnams las dang rnam smin gyi sgrib pa shas chen po'i ci rigs kyis bsgribs pa'i phyir/ gzugs med khams na ni byang sems yod de/ las nyon gyis der skye ba blangs pa'i byang sems yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ las nyon gyis dud 'gror skyes pa'i byang sems yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ skyes rabs las/ las kyi rnam par smin pa bsam mi khyab/ /brtse ba'i bdag nyid che yang dud 'gror skyes/ zhes gsungs pa gang zhig mtshungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa sems rten yod de/ spyir theg chen sems bskyed skye ba'i rgyu snying rje chen po nges par dgos shing*/ rgyu rkyen mtha' chod pa'i dbang du byas na rgyu bzhi/ rkyen bzhi/ stobs bzhi la rten nas skye ba yod pa'i phyir te/ rgyu theg chen gyi rigs sad pa/ theg chen dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis zin pa/ sems can sdug bsngal dang bral 'dod kyi snying rje/ rgyal sras kyi dka' spyad kyi bzod pa ste rgyu bzhi dang*/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi nus mthu dpag tu med pa mthong ba/ theg chen gyi sde snod mang du thos pa/ theg chen gyi bstan pa nub pa mi bzod pa/
