snyigs dus sems bskyed pa rnyed dga' ba dang mthong ba ste rkyen bzhi dang*/ grogs gzhan gyis bskul stobs dang*/ sngon dge rtsa mang du bsags pa/ rang stobs kyis 'bad pa/ tshe 'dir rgyu 'bras man ngag bdun gyis sbyangs pa lta bu sbyangs stobs kyis skyes pa dang bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ de'i nang nas gzhan gyis bskul ba dang rigs sad pa dang dge rtsa goms pa dang sde snod thos pa dang rgyu 'bras man ngag bdun gyis sbyangs pa lta bu lnga las snga ma snga ma mi brtan cing phyi ma brtan pa yin te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ grogs stobs rgyu stobs rtsaba'i stobs/ thos stobs dge ba goms pa las/ mi brtan pa dang brtan 'byung ba/ gzhan gyi brtan pa'i sems bskyed bshad/ ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ gtso bo'i dbang du byas na/ rgyal sras kyi yon tan la dmigs pa'i dad pa dang*/ snying rje chen po dang*/ rgyal sras kyi dka' spyad la bzod pa'i bzod pa la brten nas skye ba yin te/ dkon mchog sgron me las/ rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras la dad gyur cing*/ / rgyal sras rnams kyi spyod la dad byed pa/ byang chub bla na med la dad gyur na/ skyes bu chen po rnams kyi sems skye'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa brten pa sems bskyed la/ ngo bo/ dbye ba/ phye ba so so'i don/ sbyor tshul/ cho ga'i khyad par dang lnga/ dang po yod de/ gzhan don du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la dmigs shing*/ rang gi grogs rdzogs byang don gnyer gyi 'dun pa dang mtshungs ldan du gyur pa'i theg chen gtso bo'i yid kyi rnam rig khyad par can gang zhig /spyod pa'i rten byed pa'i rigs su gnas pa de/ theg chen sems bskyed kyi ngo bo'am mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ sgras brjod rigs kyi sgo nas dbye na gnyis yod de/ kun rdzob sems bskyed dang*/ don dam sems bskyed gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ ngo bo'i sgo nas gnyis yod de/

smon 'jug gi sems gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ sa mtshams kyi sgo nas bzhi yod de/ mos pas spyod pa'i sems bskyed sogs bzhi yod pa'i phyir te/ dpe grogs chos mthun gyi sgo nas nyer gnyis yod de/ sa lta bu'i sems bskyed sogs nyer gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa phye ba so so'i don la/ kun rdzob sems bskyed sngar bzhin yin la/ don dam sems bskyed kyi khyad par yod de/ theg chen 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i yid kyi rnam shes rnams de yin pa'i phyir/ smon sems kyi khyad par yod de/ 'jug sdom ma thob pa'i sems bskyed rnams de yin pa'i phyir/ 'jug sems kyi khyad par yod de/ 'jug sdom thob cing spyod pa nyams len gyi bya bas dngos su zin pa la ltos dgos pa'i sems bskyed rnams de yin pa'i phyir/ 'jug sdom thob pa'i sems bskyed yin na 'jug sems yin pas ma khyab ste/ byang sems 'phags pa'i rgyud la smon sems yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de'i rgyud la stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis dngos su ma zin pa'i sems bskyed dang spyod pa yod pa'i phyir/ 'jug sdom dang 'jug sems gnyis 'gal yang/ 'jug sems su 'gyur ba ni 'jug sdom bzung ba la rags las pa yin te/ byang sems kyi sdom pa bzung ba la rags las pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ 'jug sdom dang byang sdom gnyis don gcig cing*/ de gnyis ka'ang sems bskyed nas rgyal sras kyi spyod pa la slob par khas blangs pa'i ldog cha thob pa 'jog pa'i phyir/ 'jug sems bskyed pa la pasmon sems sngon du 'gro mi dgos te/ 'jug sdom bzung ba dang sems bskyed pa dus mnyam pa zhig yod pa'i phyir/ de ltar yin kyang sbyor 'jug las/ 'gro bar 'dod dang 'gro ba yi/ bye brag ji ltar shes pa ltar/ de bzhin mkhas pas 'di gnyis kyi/ bye brag rim bzhin shes par bya/

zhes smon 'jug gi sems kyi go rim gsungs pa dang mi 'gal te/ de ni gtso che ba la dgongs pa'i phyir/ 'jug sdom blangs pa tsam gyis 'jug pa sems bskyed thob mi dgos te/ lam ma zhugs na 'jug sdom thob pa yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de na spyod pa la slob par khas blangs pa yod pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa sbyong tshul la gnyis yod de/ rgyu 'bras man ngag bdun gyi sgo nas sbyong pa dang*/ bdag gzhan mnyam brje'i sgo nas spyong tshul gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ dang po yod de sems can rnams mar shes pa/ drin dran pa/ drin gzo ba/ yid 'ong gi byams pa/ snying rje chen po/ /lhag bsam rnam dag rnams ni snga ma snga ma las byung ba'i rgyu 'bras te rgyu drug dang*/ 'bras bu byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang bdun yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa bdag gzhan mnyam brje'i sgo nas sbyong tshul yod de/ bdag gi bde dge thams cad gzhan la gtong ba'i byams pa dang gzhan gyi sdug bsngal thams cad rang gi steng du len pa'i snying rje gnyis kyi sgo nas sbyong ba'i phyir/ phyi ma'i byams snying rje gnyis dang*/ snga ma'i rgyu drug ni gzhan don don gnyer gyi blo sbyong ba'i nang du 'dus shing*/ byang chub don gnyer gyi blo bcos ma ma yin pa skyes pa dang*/ sems bskyed pa gnyis dus mnyam ste/ rgyu drug po la rim gyi myong ba 'thon nas/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan mthong ba'i rkyen gyis de'i shugs drag gis thob 'dod dang don gnyer bcos ma ma yin pa'i myong ba nam 'thon pa na 'bras bu theg chen sems bskyed skyes par 'jog pa'i phyir te/ gzhung 'di'i rtsa 'grel rnams las gzhan don don gnyer sems bskyed kyi rgyu dang byang chub don gnyer sems bskyed kyi grogs su bshad pa'i don yod pa'i phyir/ lnga pa cho ga'i khyad par la gnyis yod de/ smon sems bskyed pa'i cho ga dang*/ 'jug sems bskyed pa'i cho ga gnyis yod pa'i phyir/

dang po yod de/ rgyas pa ni lam rim chen po sogs nas 'byung ba ltar yin pa'i phyir/ len pa'i cho ga bsdus pa yod de/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma lta bu yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa yod de/ rgyas pa ni byang sa rtsa 'grel nas bshad pa ltar yin pa'i phyir/ bsdus pa len tshul yod de/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ zhes sogs dang*/ ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs kyis/ /zhes sogs lta bu'i sgo nas kyang len du rung ba'i phyir/ cho ga tsam du ma zad gzhan yang shes dgos te/ de yul gang las len pa/ gang zag gang gis len pa/ kun slong ji lta bus len pa dmigs gsal dang bslab bya ji lta bu sogs kyang byed dgos pa'i phyir ro/ ༈ /dbye ba zhar la brjod nas zhes sogs kyi skabs su/ gdams ngag la la/ nyan pa'i rten gyi gang zag /nyan pa'i yul/ nyan pa'i rgyu/ nyan bya'i gdams ngag gi khyad par dang bzhi/ dang po yod de/ blo gzu bor gnas shing blo gros dang ldan pa dang*/ legs bshad don du gnyer ba zhig gis nyan pa'i phyir/ bzhi brgya pa las/ gzur gnas blo ldan don gnyer ba/ /nyan po snod ces bya bar bshad/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ de la gnyis yod de/ tha snyad kyi bstan bcos dang*/ nang don gyi gdams ngag nyan pa'i gang zag gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa yul gang las nyan pa yod de/ mchog gi sprul sku dang byang sems nyan rang sogs las nyan pa yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa nyan pa'i rgyu yod de/ don gnyer gyis zin pa'i dran pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab sogs mang yang*/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas grangs med pa las gdams ngag khyad par can rgya chen po nyan pa la chos rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin thob dgos pa'i phyir te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ de'i tshe chos kyi rgyun las ni/ / sangs rgyas rnams las zhi gnas dang*/ ye shes spangs pa thob bya'i phyir/ gdams ngag rgya chen rnyed par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa la/ ngo bo/

dbye ba/ phye ba so so'i don bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po la/ gdams ngag gi ngo bo yod de/ mngon mtho nges legs sogs blang dor gyi gnas ci rigs phyin ci ma log par ston pa'i rjod byed de ltar yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa dbye na du ma yod de/ theg pa che chung gi gdams ngag gnyis dang*/ rjes bstan gyi gdams ngag dang*/ 'doms pa'i gdams ngag gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ phyi ma de gnyis kyi khyad par yod de/ yon tan ma thob pa thob par bya ba'i phyir gdams pa ni dang po dang*/ thob zin mi nyams pa'i phyir gdams ni gnyis pa yin pa'i phyir/ gdams ngag la bka' dang bstan bcos gnyis yod kyang*/ skabs 'di'i dngos bstan gyi gdams ngag la sangs rgyas kyi bkas khyab ste/ de yin na/ mchog gi sprul sku'i ngag yin pas khyab pas phyir/ de la dbye na bcu yod de/ don bsdus sgron me las/ gdams ngag rnam pa bcu yin te/ ngo bo ngag gi 'khor lo yin/ dbye ba yul gyi sgo nas brjod/ ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ spyir gdams ngag ston pa po dang nyan pa po/ /gdams ngag gsum gyi sa mtshams yod de/ lam ma zhugs nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar du yod pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyis kyang chos nyan pa yod de/ des rang don du gzhan las gdams ngag nyan mi dgos kyang*/ gzhan don la dgongs nas sangs rgyas nang phan tshun chos nyan par yod pa'i phyir dang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang sku rgyab snyung ba'i tshul bstan pa'i tshe/ shā ri'i bu kho bo la 'phags pa'i chos ston cig ces bka' bstsal nas nyan par bshad pa'i phyir/ de yang mi 'gal te/ dper na/ byams 'jam dbyangs sogs kyis gzhan don la dgongs nas ston pa las chos nyan pa bzhin no/ /byang chub kyi sems kyi rab tu dbye ba ji skad bshad pa sgrub pa la zhes sogs kyi skabs su bden gnyis kyi rnam bzhag 'chad pa la/ nyan thos sde ba'i lugs/ sems tsam pa'i lugs/ dbu ma pa'i lugs dang gsum/

dang po la/ bye brag tu smra bas 'diltar du 'dod pa de yin te/ blos cha shas gzhan gsal ba na der 'dzin gyi blo 'dor du rung ba'i chos de/ kun rdzob bden pa'i 'jog byed dang*/ de ltar 'dor du mi rung ba'i chos de/ don dam bden pa'i 'jog byed du 'dod pa'i phyir/ de gnyis so so'i mtshan gzhi yod de/ bum pa dang nang gi chu lta bu dang po dang*/ rdul phran phyogs kyi cha med dang shes pa skad cig cha med lta bu gnyis pa yin pa'i phyir/ mdo sde pa'i lugs kyi bden gnyis 'jog tshul yod de/ rtog pas btags tsam du yod pa'i chos de kun rdzob bden pa'i ngo bo dang*/ rtog pas btags tsam ma yin par yul rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i sdod lugs kyi ngos nas grub pa de/ don dam bden pa'i ngo bor 'dod pa'i phyir/ so so'i mtshan gzhi yod de/ ka bum gnyis tha dad lta bu dang po dang*/ ka bum gnyis lta bu gnyis pa yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa sems tsam pa'i lugs la bden gnyis kyi 'jog tshul yod de/ phal cher dbu ma'i lugs dang 'dra yang mtshan gzhi la ngos 'dzin mi 'dra ste/ 'di bas gzugs nas reg bya'i bar phyi rol don gyis stong pa dang*/ gzugs nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar rang nyid rang nyid ces pa'i tha snyad 'jug pa'i 'jug gzhir rang gi mtshan nyid kyis ma grub pa don dam bden pa'i mtshan gzhir 'dod pa lta bu'i khyad par yod pa'i phyir ro/ /༈ gsum pa dbu ma pa'i lugs la/ dbye gzhi/ dbye ba dang grangs nges/ phye ba so so'i rnam gzhag /nges tshig /bden gnyis dang tha dad gang yin/ gtan la phab pa'i dgos pa dang drug go /dang po la/ shes bya bden pa gnyis kyi dbye gzhi yin te/ yab sras 'jal ba'i mdo las/ shes par bya ba yang kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i bden pa 'dir zad do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa shes bya la bden pa gnyis su yod cing*/ der grangs nges pa yin te/ shes bya gang zhig /de gnyis las gcig yin par yongs gcod la grub na/

cig shos yin pa rnam bcad la khegs/ cig shos yin pa rnam bcad la khegs na/ gzhan yin pa yongs gcod la grub pas phung gsum sel ba'i phyir/ dper na/ lus can yin par nges nas/ de min pa khegs/ de ma yin par nges na/ de yin pa khegs pa bzhin yin pa'i phyir te/ dbu ma snang ba las/ gang zhig yongs su gcod pa gang rnam par bcad pa med na med pa de ni phan tshun gnas pa'i mtshan nyid yin no/ /zhes pa nas/ de dag ni phung po gzhan sel bar byed pa yin te/ dper na/ lus can dang lus can ma yin pa la sogs pa'i bye brag lta bu'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa phye ba so so'i rnam bzhag la/ so so'i ngo bo/ dbye ba'i khyad par dang gnyis/ dang po yod de/ /khyod gang gis rnyed pa'i tshad ma khyod la ltod nas mthar thug dpyod pa'i rigs shes su song ba/ khyod don dang bden pa'i mtshan nyid dam ngo bo dang*/ khyod gang gis rnyed pa'i tshad ma khyod la ltos nas tha snyad dpyod pa'i tshad mar song ba de/ khyod kun rdzob bden pa'i mtshan nyid dam ngo bo yin pa'i phyir/ lugs 'dir chos de la mthar thug pa'i dpyod byed kyi tshad ma yin pa tsam gyis/ de la mthar thugs gi don rtogs pa'i rigs shes tshad mar song bas ma khyab ste/ myu gu don dam par gzhan las mi skye bar rtogs pa'i rigs shes rjes dpag des/ myu gu'i mthar thugs gi don rtogs pa'i phyir/ der thal myu gu don dam par gzhan las mi skye ba de de'i rnyed don gang zhig /de mthar thug gi don ma yin pa'i phyir/ phyi ma der thal/ de stong nyid ma yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa don dam pa la/ sgras brjod rigs kyi sgo nas dbye na du ma yod de/ yul don dam bden pa dang*/ yul can don dam bden pa gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ dang po la dngos dang rjais mthun gnyis yod de/ myu gu bden stong lta bu dang po dang*/ bden stong sgyu ma lta bu gnyis pa yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la yang dngos dang rjes mthun gnyis yod

de/ /myu gu bden stong mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes lta bu dang po dang*/ /myu gu bden stong rtogs pa'i rjes dpag lta bu gnyis pa yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang*/ de la don don dam pa/ thob pa don dam pa/ sgrub pa don dam pa gsum dang*/ rnam grangs pa'i don dam pa/ rnam grangs ma yin pa'i don dam pa zhes pa'i tha snyad mdzad pa yod kyang dngos btags ci rigs kyi dbang du byas pa yin te/ don dam bden pa dngos ni stong nyid dang don gcig pa'i phyir ro/ /kun rdzob bden pa la yang yang log gnyis yod cing de gnyis kyi ngo bo yod de/ rang nyid gtso bor snang yul du byed pa'i blo la snang ba snang ba ltar du grub pa'i kun rdzob de/ yang dag kun rdzob dang*/ de lta bu'i blo la snang ba de snang ba ltar ma grub pa dai/ log pa'i kun rdzob kyi don nam ngo bor 'jog pa'i phyir/ so so'i tshad gzhi yod de/ byad bzhin dang ka bum dang chu dang shes pa dang kha dog thams cad dang po dang*/ byad bzhin gyi gzugs brnyan dang*/ smig rgyu'i chu dang chu'i zla ba dang*/ me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bu gnyis pa yin pa'i phyir/ de yang 'jig rten gyi grags pa ltar yin te/ 'jig rten na byad bzhin dang ka bum dang chu la sogs pas 'jig rten pa'i tha snyad don 'thun ltar don byed nus pas yang dag kun rdzob dang*/ byad bzhin gyi gzugs brnyan dang smig rgyu'i chu sogs kyis ni de ltar don byed mi nus pas log pa'i kun rdzob tu bzhag pa'i phyir te/ bden gnyis las/ snang du 'dra yang don byed dag /nus pa'i phyir dang mi nus phyir/ yang dag yang dag ma yin pa'i/ /kun rdzob kyi ni dbye ba byas/ zhes dang*/ de'i rang 'grel las kyang*/ chu la sogs pa dang smig rgyu la sogs pa yang dag dang yang dag pa ma yin par rtogs so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ thal 'gyur bas ni 'jig rten shes ngo la ltos nas yang log gnyis kyi dbye ba 'dod kyang*/

kun rdzob la yang dag kun rdzob dang log pa'i kun rdzob gnyis kyi dbye ba mi 'dod de/ yang dag kun rdzob mi bzhed pa'i phyir/ der thal/ snang ba snang ba ltar grub pa'i kun rdzob mi bzhed pa'i phyir/ der thal/ snang ba snang ba ltar grub na don dam bden pa yin dgos par bzhed pa'i phyir ro/ /bzhi pa nges tshig la/ don dam bden pa chos can/ khyed la der brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ blo don dam pa 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag gi gzigs ngor snang tshul dang gnas tshul mthun zhing*/ don yang yin dam pa yang yin pas na de ltar du brjod pa'i phyir/ kun rdzob bden pa chos can/ khyod la der brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ blo kun rdzob pa rang nyid bden par 'dzin pa'i bden 'dzin gyi ngo bor bden yang don la bden par med pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis de ltar du brjod pa'i phyir/ lnga pa ni/ bden gnyis ngo bo gcig la ldog pa tha dad byas pa dang mi rtag pa bzhin yin te/ byang chub sems 'grel las/ kun rdzob las ni tha dad par/ /de nyid dmigs pa ma yin te/ /kun rdzob stong pa nyid du bshad/ stong de kho na kun rdzob yin/ /med na mi 'byung nges pa'i phyir/ /byas dang mi rtag ji bzhin no/ /zhes dang*/ mdo las/ gzugs stong pa'o/ /stong pa nyid gzugs so/ /gzugs las kyang stong pa nyid gzhan ma yin/ stong pa nyid las kyang gzugs gzhan ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ bden gnyis tha dad gtan med kyi gcig min te/ kun rdzob dang don dam gyi gzhi 'thun mi srid pa'i phyir/ de gnyis ngo bo tha dad min te/ myu gu dang bden stong gnyis ngo bo gcig tu 'dod dgos pa'i phyir te/ myu gu nyid bden pas stong pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /drug pa dgos pa yod de/ gzhi dus su bden gnyis kyi rnam gzhag shes pa la brten nas/ lam dus su tshogs gnyis zung 'brel du nyams su len pa de 'byung*/ de la brten nas 'bras dus su chos gzugs kyi sku gnyis zung 'jug tu thob pa 'byung ba'i phyir te/

bden gnyis las/ bden gnyis rnam dbye shes pa dag /thub pa'i bka' la mi rmongs te/ /de nyid ma lus tshogs bsags te/ /phun tshogs pha rol 'gro bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 7 /sdug bsngal gzugs la sogs pa 'bras bur gyur pa'i zhes sogs kyi skabs su bden bzhi'i rnam gzhag la dbye ba sgra don grangs nges/ go rim/ so so'i ngo bo/ sgom tshul/ bsgoms pa'i dgos pa dang bdun/ dang po ni/ 'dir bsgom bya'i bden pa'i rnam pa la bzhi yod de/ sdug bsngal bden pa sogs bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ de bzhi chos can/ khyod la 'dir bden pa'i ming gis brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ 'phags pas gzigasas pa ltar bden cing byis pas bzung ba ltar mi bden pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis de ltar du brjod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ grol ba don gnyer gyi blang dor gyi gnas kyi gtso bo'i gnas la bden pa bzhir grangs nges te/ de'i dor bya'i gtso bo'i gnas la sdug kun gnyis dang*/ blang bya'i gnas la 'gog lam gyi phyogs gnyis su grangs nges pa'i phyir te/ spang bya'i rgyu 'bras la sdug kun gnyis su grangs nges/ blang bya'i rgyu 'bras la 'gog lam gnyis su grangs nges pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa go rim la gnyis yod de/ rgyu 'bras don gyi go rim dang*/ mngon rtogs skye ba'i go rim gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ dang po yod de/ rgyu dang las dang sdug bsngal dang*/ /'gog pa la ni go rim bzhin/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar yin pa'i phyir/ 'dir ni phyi ma'i dbang du bya ba yin te/ sdug bsngal bden pa dang kun 'byung bden pa dang 'gog bden dang lam bden bzhi rim par bstan pa'i phyir/ de ltar bstan pa la dgos pa yod de/ dang por mi rtag sdug bsngal sogs sdug bden gyi gnyis dmigs shes dgos/ de shes na de'i rgyu yod med brtags pa na lus nyon gnyis de'i rgyur shes pa de 'byung zhing de gnyis spang 'dod skye/

de nas sdug kun gnyis 'gags pa'i 'gog pa yod par shes nas de la thob 'dod skye/ de nas 'gog pa de thob byed kyi lam bden bsgom dgos par mthong nas lam bden bsten byar khong du chud par 'gyur ba yin pa'i phyir te/ dper na/ thog mar nad ngo shes dgos/ de nas de'i rgyu shes dgos/ de nas de las grol 'dod skye dgos/ de nas sman bsten dgos pa bzhin yin pa'i phyir te/ rgyud bla ma las/ nad ni shes bya nad kyi rgyu ni spang bya la/ bder gnas thob bya sman ni brten par bya ba ltar/ sdug bsngal rgyu dang de 'gog pa dang de bzhin lam/ shes bya spang bya rig par bya zhing bsten par bya/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ lnga pa so so'i ngo bo bshad pa la/ bzhi'i dang po sdug bden la ngo bo/ /dbye ba/ phye ba so so'i don/ rnam pa gtan la 'bebs tshul dang bzhi/ dang po yod de/ rang rgyu kun 'byung bden pas lag rjes bzhag pa'i nyer len gyi phung po de/ sdug bden gyi mtshan nyid dam ngo bo yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa dbye na du ma yod de/ ngo bo'i sgo nas khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal/ 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal/ sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal dang gsum dang*/ myong tshul gyi sgo nas der gyur pa'i bde sdug btang snyoms gsum dang*/ snod bcud kyi sgo nas gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la/ spyir las nyon gyi dbang gis nying mtshams sbyar ba'i nyer len gyi phung po lnga ni 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal rags pa yin la/ de lta bu'i phung po dang bcas pa'i skye rga na 'chi bzhi'i mi rtag pa spyi tsam yang*/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal rags pa dang*/ nyer len gyi phung po de rang grub dus kyi skad cig gnyis par mi sdod pa ni 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal phra mo yin pa'i phyir/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal phra mo mthong nas phra ba'i mi rtag pa mthong ba yin te/ phra ba'i mi rtag pa de rtogs dka' zhing de ltar mngon sum du mthong na 'phags pa'i ye shes kyang skye ba yin pa'i phyir/

'du byed kyi sdug bsngal la khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ las nyon gyis 'du byas pa dang khams gsum la khyab cing sdug bsngal gzhan gnyis la yang khyab pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis de skad ces brjod pa'i phyir/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal yin na/ khams gsum la khyab mi dgos te/ rang re'i nyer len gyi phung po 'di khams gsum la ma khyab pa'i phyir ro/ /skye rga na 'chi bzhi'i nang nas skye rga gnyis ni 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal bar gtso che yang*/ na 'chi ni de dang mi 'dra ste/ de gnyis phal cher 'gyur ba dang sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal gang rung du gtso che ba'i phyir/ 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal yod de/ 'gro ba'i dus su re zhig bsdad pa'i bde ba dang kha zas kyi ro myong ba'i tshor ba bde ba lta bu ni 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal du 'jog pa'i phyir/ mkhal ma'i zug zer nyams su myong ba dang mtshon gyis rmas pa'i tshor ba sdug bsngal drag po lta bu ni sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal yin te/ de dag ni 'jig rten na'ang sdug bsngal che bar drag pa'i phyir/ bzhi ba sdug bden gyi rnam pa la bzhi yod pa las/ zag bcas nyer len gyi phung po chos can/ mi rtag pa yin te/ rkyen gyis bskyed pa'i phyir/ sdug bsngal ba yin te/ las nyon gyi gzhan dbang can yin pa'i phyir/ don gzhan gyis stong pa yin te/ bdag don gzhan gyis ma bskyed pa'i phyir/ bdag med pa'i rnam pa can yin te/ rang gi ngo bo bdag tu ma grub pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa kun 'byung bden pa la/ ngo bo/ /dbye ba/ phye ba so so'i don/ rnam pa gtan la 'bebs tshul dang bzhi/ dang po yod de/ rang 'bras sdug bsngal bden pa skyed byed rgyu'i phyogs kun nas nyon mongs pa'i bden pa de/ kun 'byung bden pa'i ngo bo'am mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa de la dbye na gnyis yod de/ nyon mongs pa'i kun 'byung dang las kyi kun 'byung gnyis yod pa'i phyir/

gsum pa la/ las nyon gnyis las/ nyon mong pa'i kun 'byung la gnyis yod de/ der byur ba'i rtsa nyon dang*/ nye nyon gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ rtsa nyon la drug yod de/ der gyur pa'i 'dod chags/ khong khro/ nga rgyal/ ma rigs pa/ the tshom nyon mongs can/ lta ba nyon mongs can dang drug yod pa'i phyir/ nye nyon la nyi shu yod de/ khro ba dang 'khon 'dzin dang 'chab pa dang 'tshig pa dang phrag dog dang ser sna dang g.yo dang sgyu dang rgyags par dang rnam pa 'tshe dang ngo tsha med pa dang khrel med pa dang rmugs pa dang rgod pa dang ma dad pa dang le lo dang bag med dang brjed ngas dang shes bzhin ma yin pa dang rnam par g.yeng pa dang nyi shu yod pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang sred pa nyon mongs pa'i kun 'byung gi gtso bo yin te/ thams cad du 'gro ba rnam pa drug gi sgo nas gtso bor 'gyur ba'i phyir te/ kun las btus las/ 'di ltar sred pa ni dngos po ni thams cad du 'gro ba dang*/ gnas skabs thams cad du 'gro ba dang*/ dus thams cad du 'gro ba dang*/ khams thams cad du 'gro ba dang*/ tshol ba thams cad du 'gro ba dang*/ rnam pa thams cad du 'gro ba'o/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ sred pa de la gsum yod de/ 'dod sred/ 'jigs sred/ srid sred gsum yod pa'i phyir/ de gsum gyi ngo bo yod de/ zag bcas kyi yul gzugs sgra sogs yid du 'ong ba la mi 'bral bar 'dod pa'i sred pa dang po/ /yul yid du mi 'ong ba la 'bral bar 'dod pa'i sred pa gnyis pa/ 'chi ba'i dus su phung po la sred pa'i sred pa de gsum pa yin pa'i phyir te/ las kyi kun 'byung la dbye na du ma yod de/ der gyur pa'i dge mi dge lung ma stan gsum dang*/ sgo gsum gyi las gsum dang*/ gzhan rnam grangs kyis dbye na bsod nams dang bsod nams ma yin pa dang mi g.yo ba'i las gsum dang*/ skye nas myor 'gyur gyi las sogs gsum dang*/ 'phen 'grub rdzogs byed kyi las gsum dang*/

dkar la rnam smin dkar ba'i las sogs gsum dang*/ sdom sdom min par ma'i las gsum rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ zag med kyi las ni las kyi kun 'byung du mi 'dod de/ de zag bcas ma yin pa'i phyir/ so skye'i rgyud kyi dge mi dge'i las gnyis phal cher las kyi kun 'byung yin pa'i 'khor ba'i rgyu byed kyang*/ nges 'byung byang chub kyi sems lta ba rnam dag rnams dang des dngos su zin pa'i dge rtsa rnams kyis ni 'khor ba'i rgyu mi byed de/ de rnams ni 'khor ba spong pa la phyogs shing de 'joms byed kyi gnyen po dam par gsungs pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa rnams pa bsgrub tshul ni/ so skye'i rgyud kyi zag bcas kyi las sred gnyis chos can/ rgyu'i rnam pa yin te/ rang 'bras sdug bsngal gyi rgyu'i gtso bo byed pa'i phyir/ kun 'byung gi rnam pa yin te/ sdug bsngal yang yang kun tu skyed pa'i phyir/ rab skye'i rnam pa yin te/ sdug bsngal drag tu skyed pa'i phyir/ rkyen gyi rnam pa yin te/ yang srid du 'phen pa'i lhan cig byed rkyen yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa/ 'gog bden la/ ngo bo/ /dbye ba/ so so'i don/ rnam pa gtan la 'bebs pa dang bzhi/ dang po yod de/ lam bden gyi stobs kyis thob pa'i bral 'bras te/ 'gog bden gyi ngo bo'am mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa de la sgras brjod rigs kyi dbye na gnyis yod de/ so sor btags 'gog dang btags min gyi 'gog pa gnyis yod cing*/ gzhan yang rdzogs ma rdzogs kyi 'gog bden gnyis rgyan bcas rgyan med gnyis/ lhag bcas lhag med gnyis sogs yod pa'i phyir/ 'gog bden la 'phags rgyud kyi yon tan yin pas khyab ste/ de la mthong spangs nyon sgrib spangs pa zhig nges par dgos pa'i phyir/ de la don dam bden pa yin min gnyis yod de/ bar chad med lam gyi stobs kyis mthong spangs nyon mongs spangs ba'i cha de 'gog bden du gyur pa'i kun rdzob bden pa yin la/

de spangs pa'i de bzhin nyid de 'gog bden du gyur pa'i don dam bden pa yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa rnam pa gtan la 'bebs tshul ni/ theg chen mthong lam rnam grol lam pa ba'i rgyud kyi 'gog bden chos can/ 'gog pa'i rnam pa yin te/ nyon mongs kun btags spangs pa'i bral ba yin pa'i phyir/ zhi ba'i rnam pa yin te/ nyon mongs des bskyed pa'i sdug bsngal spangs pa'i bral ba yin pa'i phyir/ gya nom pa'i rnam pa yin te/ phan bde'i ngo bor gyur pa'i bral ba yin pa'i phyir/ nges 'byung gi rnam pa yin te/ nyon mongs kun btags rtsa ba nas spangs pa'i bral ba yin pa'i phyir/bzhi pa lam bden la ngo bo/ /dbye ba/ so so'i don/ rnam pa gtan la 'bebs tshul dang bzhi/ dang po yod de/ rang gi thob bya'i 'gog bden thob byed bral rgyus bsdus pa'i rnam byang bden pa de/ lam bden gyi ngo bo'am mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la dbye na mang ste/ theg pa gsum gyi 'phags lam thams cad de ltar yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la/ lam bden gyi gtso bo ni bar chad med lam rnams yin te/ de rnams kyis rang gi bral 'bras 'gog bden gyi bral rgyu dngos su byed pa'i phyir/ 'phags pa'i rnam grol lam dang rjes thob ye shes rnams lam bden yin kyang bral rgyu'i phyogs kyis bsdus pa yin gyi/ bral rgyu dngos gnas pa min te/ de rnams kyi bral rgyu dngos su mi byed pa'i phyir/ tshogs lam la lam bden yod kyang lam bden gyis ma khyab ste/ nyan rang gi tshogs lam yin na lam bden min pas khyab pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang lam bden gyis bsdus te/ gtso 'khor gyi tshul gyis bsdus pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa rnam pa gtan la 'bebs tshul ni/ nyan thos kyi mthong lam bar chad med lam chos can/ lam gyi rnam pa yin te/ thar par bgrod byed kyi 'phags rgyud kyi mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ rig pa'i rnam pa yin te/ nyon mongs pa'i gnyen po yin pa'i phyir/

sgrub pa'i rnam pa yin te/ sems kyi gnas lugs rtogs pa'i 'phags lam yin pa'i phyir/ nges 'byin gyis rnam pa yin te/ sdug bsngal spang byed kyi 'phags lam yin pa'i phyir/ drug pa la rnam pa bsgom tshul yod de/ thog mar rang gi nyer len gyi phung po lnga po 'di mi rtag par bsam/ de nas 'khor ba spyi dang bye brag gi sdug bsngal rnams bsam/ de rjes kyi sdug bsngal de dag byed pa po don gzhan gyi bdag gis stong bar bsam/ de nas myong ba po nyid rang dbang ba'i bdag tu ma grub pa'i tshul bsam pa'i sgo nas sdug bden shes par byed/ de nas sdug bsngal de rgyu gang las byung na las nyon gny-is las byung bar shes te de gnyis rgyu kun 'byung rab skye rkyen gyi rnam pa'i ngo bor bsgom pa nas kun 'byung bar spong ba la 'jug /de nas sdug kun gnyis 'gag pa'i 'gog pa ngos bzung nas de 'gog pa zhi ba gya nom nges 'byung gi rnam par bsams te 'gog pa mngon du byed/ de nas 'gog bden de nyid thob byed kyi thabs dam pa lam bden spyi dang bdag med rtogs pa'i ye shes de lam rig pa sgrub pa nges 'byin gyi rnam par bsam pa'i sgo nas rgyud la bsten par byed pa yin pa'i phyir/ bdun pa la rnam pa de ltar du bsgom pa la dgos pa yod de/ thog mar 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsams te sdug kun zhi ba'i thar ba thob 'dod skyed cing de nas lam bslab gsum sogs nyams su blangs stobs kyis 'khor ba las grol ba'i thar ba thob par 'gyur ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir ro/ /༈ sangs rgyas la sogs pa dkon mchog gsum/ zhes sogs kyi skabs su/ dkon mchog gsum gyi rnam bzhag la/ bye brag smra ba'i lugs dang*/ theg chen pa'i lugs gnyis/ dang po yod de/ bye brag smra bas sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi zad mi skye shes pa'i ye shes/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog tu byed pa'i byed chos yin pas sangs rgyas dkon mchog yin la/

slob pa 'phags pa dang mi slob pa gzhan gyi rgyud kyi zad mi skye shes te/ de rnams dge 'dun du byed pa'i byed chos yin pas dge 'dun dkon mchog dang*/ de dag gi rgyud kyi 'gog bden rnams chos dkon mchog tu 'dod pa'i phyir/ de skad du yang*/ sangs rgyas dge 'dun byed pa'i chos/ /mi slob pa dang gnyis ka dang*/ /mya ngan 'das la skyabs su 'gra/ོ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gzugs sku gnyis sangs rgyas dkon mchog min kyang sangs rgyas yin te/ de gnyis sangs rgyas su byed pa'i byed chos khas len pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa la/ skyabs gsum spy-i'i rnam bzhag /theg chen thung mong ma yin pa'i skyabs gsum ngos bzung ba/ kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i khyad par/ skyabs 'gro bshad pa dang bzhi/ dang po yod de/ rgyu'i skyabs 'gro'i dbang du byas na rigs can gsum ka dkonamachog gsum ka la skyabs su 'gro yang*/ 'bras bu'i skyabs 'gro'i dbang du byas na theg chen gyi rigs can gyis sangs rgyas dkon mchog mchod pa dang don du gnyer ba ci rigs kyi sgo nas sangs rgyas dkon mchog de'i skyabs su bzhag /rang rgyal gyi rigs can gyis chos dkon mchog mchod pa dang don du gnyer ba ci rigs kyi sgo nas chos dkon mchog de'i skyabs su bzhag /nyan thos kyi rigs can gyis dge 'dun dkon mchog mchod pa dang thob byar don du gnyer ba ci rigs kyi sgo nas de de'i skyabs su bzhag pa'i phyir/ rgyu'i skyabs 'gro'i dbang du byas na rigs can gsum kas dkon mchog gsum ka la yang skyabs su 'gro ba yin te/ de gsum kas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la skyabs ston pa'i ston pa/ chos dkon mchog la skyabs dngos/ dge 'dun dkon mchog la skyabs sgrub pa'i zla grogs su byed pa 'dra ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun dkon mchog gi khyad par dang gsum/ dang po la/

ngo bo dang*/ dbye ba dang*/ yon tan gyi khyad par gsum/ dang po yod de/ don gnyis mthar phyin pa'i skyabs gnas mthar thug de/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog gi ngo bo'am mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa dbye na gnyis yod de/ chos gzugs kyi sku gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog de yon tan brgyad dang ldan te/ skye 'jig gnas gsum gyis 'dus ma byas pa'i yon tan/ 'bad rtsol dang rnam rtog spangs pa'i lhun gyis grub pa'i yon tan/ sgra rtogs sogs kyi rkyen tsam gyis rtogs par mi nus pa'i yon tan/ mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi yon tan dang ldan zhing*/ dang po gsum rang don gyis bsdus pa'i yon tan dang*/ phyi ma gsum gzhan don gyi yon tan yin pa'i phyir te/ rgyud bla ma las/ 'dus ma byas shing lhun gyis grub/ /gzhan gyi rkyen gyis rtogs min pa/ mkhyen dang brtse dang nus par ldan/ don gnyis ldan pa'i sangs rgyas nyid/ ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa chos dkon mchog la ngo bo/ dbye ba yon tan dang gsum/ 'gog lam gang rung gis bsdus pa'i rnam byang bden pa de/ de'i ngo bo'am mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa dbye na gnyis yod de/ ngo bo'i sgo nas 'gog bden dang lam bden gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la chos dkon mchog de yon tan brgyad dang ldan te/ rtog ge'i blos mu bzhir bsam du med pa dang*/ las nyon ci rigs spangs pa dang*/ tshul min yid byed kyi rnam rtog ci rigs med pa dang*/ nyon mongs ci rigs dag pa dang*/ de kho na nyid gsal ba dang*/ mi mthun phyogs kyi gnyen po byed pa'i yon tan rnams dang ldan cing*/ dang po gsum gang zhig chags pa dang bral ba 'gog bden gyi yon tan dang*/ phyi ma gsum gang gi chags pa dang bral ba lam bden gyi yon tan yin pa'i phyir te/ rgyud bla ma las/ bsam med gnyis med rtog med pa/ dag gsal gnyen po'i phyogs nyid kyis/

gang zhig gang gis chags bral ba/ bden gnyis mtshan nyid can te chos/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa dge 'dun dkon mchog la/ dbye ba yon tan gsum/ dang po yod de/ rigs grol gyi yon tan brgyad po gang rung dang ldan pas 'phags pa de'i ngo bo'am mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa dbye na gnyis yod de/ theg pa che chung gi 'phags pa'i dge 'dun gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la/ theg chen gyi dge 'dun dkon mchog de yon tan brgyad dang ldan te/ ji lta ji snyed nang ye shes gzigs pa'i yon tan gsum dang*/ chags sgrib thogs sgrib dman sgrib ci rigs las grol ba'i yon tan gsum dang ldan cing*/ dang po gsum rig pa'i yon tan dang*/ phyi ma gsum grol ba'i yon tan yin pa'i phyir te/ rgyud bla ma las/ ji ltar ji snyed nang gi ni/ /ye shes gzigs pa dag pa'i phyir/ blo ldan phyir mi ldogs pa'i tshogs/ bla med yon tan dang ldan nyid/ ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la/ don dam pa'i skyabs yin min gyi khyad par yod de/ lam gyi bgrod pa mthar phyin pa'i skyabs de/ don dam pa'i skyabs yin zhing*/ de las ldog pa ni don dam pa'i skyabs su mi 'os pa'i phyir/ don dam pa'i skyabs dang sangs rgyas dkon mchog gnyis don gcig kyang*/ chos dkon mchog dang dge 'dun dkon mchog la yang don dam pa'i skyabs ni yod de/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi chos dkon mchog rnams sangs rgyas yin pa'i don dam pa'i skyabs yin la/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nyid kyang dge 'dun dkon mchog yin pa'i phyir/ phyi ma grub ste/ de mthar thug gi dge 'dun dkon mchog yin pa'i phyir/ gzugs sku gnyis kun rdzob pa'i sku yin kyang*/ kun rdzob pa'i skyabs min tai/ de gnyis sangs rgyas yin pa'i phyir/ slob pa 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi 'gog lam gnyis don dam pa'i chos dkon mchog yin kyang*/ don dam pa'i skyabs min te/

sangs rgyas ma yin pa'i phyir/ kun rdzob pa'i chos dkon mchog yin na/ kun rdzob pa'i skyabs yin min dgos te/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi lung gi chos dkon mchog rnams kun rdzob pa'i chos dkon mchog yin yang kun rdzob pa'i skyabs ma yin pa'i phyir/ der thal don dam pa'i skyabs yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ sangs rgyas yin pa'i phyir/ kun rdzob pa'i chos dkon mchog yin na chos dkon mchog ma yin pas khyab ste/ chos dkon mchog yin na/ don dam pa'i chos dkon mchog yin dgos pa'i phyir/ don dam pa'i dge 'dun dkon mchog yin na/ dge 'dun dkon mchog yin mi dgongs te/ lam bden rnams don dam pa'i chos dkon mchog dang don dam pa'i dge 'dun dkon mchog gnyis ka yin pa'i phyir/ dge 'dun dkon mchog yin na/ kun rdzob pa'i dge 'dun dkon mchog yin dgos la/ dge 'dun la dge 'dun dkon mchog gis ma khyab ste/ so skye'i dge 'dun rnams dge 'dun dkon mchog ma yin pa'i phyir/ 'dul ba las/ dge slong bzhi yan la dge 'dun dang gsum man la gang zag ces bshad kyang mi 'gal te/ rnam gzhag so so pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /bzhi pa skyabs 'gro rnam gzhag la/ rgyu gang gis skyabs su 'gro ba/ yul gang la dang*/ skyabs 'gro'i ngo bo/ /ci tsam gyis skyabs su stong ba/ dbye ba dang bslab bya/ dgos pa dang phan yon bshad pa dang drug /dang po yod de/ 'khor ba spyi dang bye brag ngan song gi sdug bsngal shes nas de las skyob pa'i nus pa yod par yid ches pa'i dad pa de/ de'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir/ de med na dkon mchog la skyabs su 'gro 'dod mi 'byung zhing*/ yod na 'byung ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa yod de/ thar 'dod kyi skyabs 'gro'i yul gyi gtso bo la dkon mchog gsum du grangs nges pa'i phyir te/ skyabs 'gro'i bdun bcu pa las/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun ni/ thar ba 'dod pa rnams kyi skyabs/

zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ skyabs 'gro'i yul tsam la nges pa med de/ slob pa so skye dang lha klu mthu can sogs la'ang skyabs su 'gro ba yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la spyir skyabasas 'gro'i ngo bo yod de*/ yul gzhan la rang stobs kyis dpung gnyen du re ltos 'cha' ba'i sems pa de/ de'i ngo bo yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ji tsam gyis skyabs su song ba'i tshad yod de/ snying thag pa nas re ltos 'cha' nus pa de de yin pa'i phyir/ lnga pa de la/ dbye na gnyis yod de/ skyabs 'gro phal ba dang*/ khyad par can yod pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang gsum yod de/ skyes bu chung 'bring chen po'i skyabs 'gro gsum yod pa'i phyir/ de gsum gyi khyad par yod de/ rang nyid ngan song gi sdug bsngal las thar bar 'dod nas skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las thar ba 'don nas skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las bsgral nas sangs rgyas la 'god pa'i ched du skyabs su 'gro ba'i skyabs 'gro gsum ni/ rim pa bzhin du de gsum gyi ngo bor 'jog pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang gnyis yod de/ rgyu dang 'bras bu'i skyabs 'gro gnyis yod pa'i phyir te/ gzhan rgyud la grub zin pa'i dkon mchog la skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ rang rgyud la 'byung ba'i dkon mchog la skyabs su 'gro ba'i skyabs 'gro gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ bslab bya la gnyis yod de/ so so'i ba dang thun mong ba'i bslab bya gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ dang po yod de/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su song nas 'jig rten pa'i lha klu sogs gzhan la skyabs su mi 'gro/ /chos la skyabs su song nas sems can la gnod 'tshe spong*/ dge 'dun la skyabs su song nas mu stegs can dang mi 'grogs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa yod de/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag bya ba dang mchod cing bsngags pa brjod pa sogs yin pa'i phyir/ drug pa dgos pa dang phan yon gyi khyad par yod de/

nang ba sangs rgyas par chud pa/ sdom pa'i rten byed pa/ ngan 'gro'i sgo gcod pa/ srung ba'i mchog tu 'gyur ba'i dgos pa dang*/ lha mi gzhan gyis phyag bya bar 'os pa/ tshogs chen po gsog pa/ sgrib pa sbyong ba/ dkon mchog gi go 'phang thob par 'gyur ba sogs kyi phan yon yod pa'i phy-i+-ir/ /༈ sha'i dang rnam par smin pa las byung ba'i lha'i dang zhes sogs kyi skabs su spyan lnga bshad pa la/ rten dang ngo bo dang byed las dang sa mtshams dang dgos pa bshad pa lnga/ dang po la/ lus rten dang sems brten gnyis/ dang po yod de/ spyan dang po gnyis so skye'i rten la yod cing phyi ma gsum gyi brten 'phags pa kho nar nges pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa sems rten yod de/ dang por bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi la rten nas skye ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa spyan lnga po so so'i ngo bo 'jog tshul yod de/ rang gi gzhal byar gyur pa'i dpag tshad brgya'i gzugs phra rags du ma mngon sum du mthong ba'i sgo nas spyan du bzhag pas rab tu phye ba de sha'i spyan dang*/ rang gi gzhal byar gyur pa'i sems can 'chi 'pho byed pa'i sems can gyi gzugs phra rags du ma mngon sum du mthong ba'i sgo nas spyan du bzhag pas rab tu phye ba de lha'i spyan dang*/ rang gi gzhal byar gyur pa'i bdag med phra rags gsum po gang rung mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sgo nas spyan du bzhag pas rab tu phye ba de shes rab kyi spyan dang*/ rang gi gzhal byar gyur pa'i 'phags pa'i gang zag gi dbang po rno rtul gyi rim pa mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sgo nas spyan du bzhag pas rab tu phye ba de chos kyi spyan dang*/ bden gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sgo nas spyan du bzhag pa de sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyi ngo bo'am 'jog byed yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa byed las yod de/ sha'i spyan gyis gdul bya sogs gang na yod pa ji lta ba bzhin du shes/

lha'i spyan gyis gdul bya yul gang nas gang du skyes pa de shes/ shes rab kyi spyan gyis de grol byed gyi lam shes/ chos kyi spyan gyis gdul bya'i dbang po'i rim pa shes/ sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis gdul bya'i khams dang bsam pa dang don byed tshul rnams mngon sum du shes par byed pa'i phyir/ bzhi ba sa mtshams yod de/ sha'i spyan tshogs lam nas dang*/ lha'i spyan sbyor lam dang*/ shes rab kyi spyan mthong lam mnyam bzhag dang*/ chos kyi spyan mthong lam rjes thob dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi spyan rje mthun pas brgyad pa dang dngos gnas pa sangs rgyas pa nas thob pa'i phyir/ lnga pa spyan lnga rgyud la bskyed pa la dgos pa yod de/ sgrub pa la rang dbang du 'jug nus pa'i dgos pa yod pa'i phyir/ /༈ rdzu 'phrul dang lha'i rna ba dang zhes sogs kyi skabs su mngon shes drug gi rnam gzhag la/ rten dang ngo bo dang khyad par dang mtshams dang dgos pa bzhin/ dang po la gnyis yod de/ lus rten dang sems rten gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ lus rten yod de/ phyi rol pa nas sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rten kyi bar yod pa'i phyir/ sems rten yod de/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi la brten nas skye ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa mngon shes la dbye na drug yod cing drug po so so'i ngo bo yod de/ sprul sgyur sna tshogs mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sgo nas mngon shes su bzhag pas rab tu phye ba dang*/ gzugs phra rags mthong ba dang*/ sgra phra rags thos pa dang*/ gzhan gyi sems shes pa dang*/ sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa dang*/ zag pa zad pa'i khyad par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sgo nas mngon shes su bzhag pas rab tu phye ba rnams ni/ rim pa bzhin du rdzu 'phrul gyi mngon shes dang*/ lha'i mig gi mngon shes dang/ lha'i rna ba'i mngon shes dang*/ gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes dang*/ sngon gnas rjes dran gyi mngon shes dang*/ zag pa zad pa'i mngon shes su 'jog pa'i phyir/

gsum pa khyad par la lha'i spyan dang lha'i mig gi mngon shes gnyis la khyad par yod de/ sha'i spyan dang lha'i spyan la dbang shes kyis khyab cing*/ spyan gzhan gsum dang mngon shes drug ka la yid shes kyis khyab pas dbang shes yin pa med pa'i phyir/ rdzu 'phrul dang rdzu 'phrul gyi mngon shes la khyad par yod de/ sprul bsgyur sna tshogs ston pa ni rdzu 'phrul yin la/ de dag mngon sum du rtogs pa'i yid kyi mngon shes de rdzu 'phrul gyi mngon shes yin pa'i phyir/ spyir rdzu 'phrul de la skyes stobs kyis thob pa sogs bzhi yod de/ mdzod las/ rdzu 'phrul gsang sngags sman dag dang*/ /las las skye dang rnam pa bzhi/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa sa 'tshams kyi khyad par yod de/ mngon shes dang po lnga phyir rol pa nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar du yod cing*/ zag zad kyi mngon shes ni dgra bcom pa kho na'i rten la yod cing gzhan la med pa'i phyir/ lnga pa mngon shes rgyud la bskyed pa la dgos pa yod de/ gdul bya'i don byed pa'i yul dang thabs la rmongs pa zlog cing thabs 'bras bu dang bcas pa shes pa'i dgos pa yod pa'i phyir te/ lha'i mig gi mngon shes kyis gdul bya sogs gang na gnas pa shes/ gzhan sems shes pas rang gzhan gyi sems dge mi dge lung ma bstan gang yin shes/ sngon gnas rjes dran gyis rang bzhin gyi tshe rabs snga ma mang po shes/ zag zad kyi mngon shes kyis gdul bya grol ba'i thabs 'bras bu dang bcas pa shes par byed pa'i phyir ro/ /spyan dang mngon shes kyi sgra don yod de/ mig dang cha 'dra ba dang mngon sum du shes pa'i cha nas de ltar du brjod pa'i phyir/ /༈ dbang po rtul dang rnon po dag /zhes sogs kyi skabs su dge 'dun nyi shu'i rnam gzhag la/ mtshon byed dpe'i dge 'dun dang*/ mtshon bya don gyi dge 'dun bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ du ma yod kyang mtshon tsam bshad na/

dge sbyong gi tshul yod de/ nyan thos kyi zag med bar chad med lam rnams ni dge sbyong tshul yin pa'i phyir/ dge sbyong tshul gyi 'bras bu 'jog tshul yod de/ dge sbyong gi tshul des thob pa'i nyan thos kyi rnam byang bden pa rnams de yin pa'i phyir/ dge sbyong tshul gyi 'bras bu de'i dbye ba bsdu na bzhi yod de/ rgyun zhugs kyi 'bras bu sogs bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ rgyas par dbye na rnam grol lam gya dgu dang*/ 'gog bden gya dgu yod de/ mdzod las/ de dag brgyad cu rtsa dgu'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir 'bras bu de dag sa gang la brten nas thob pa yod de/ bsam gtan gyi nyer bsdogs dang dngos gzhi ci rigs la brten nas thob dgos pa'i phyir/ zhugs pa la bzhi yod de/ rgyun zhugs zhugs pa sogs bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ 'bras gnas la yang bzhi yod de/ rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas sogs bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ dang po zhugs 'bras kyi 'jog tshul yod de/ mthong spang kun sbyor gsum spong phyir du zhugs pa dang de spangs pa'i dge sbyong tshul gyi 'bras bu thob pa'i khyad par gyis 'jog pa'i phyir/ rgyun zhugs zhugs pa la dbye na du ma yod de/ dbang po'i sgo nas der gyur pa'i dbang po rno rtul gnyis/ spang bya spong tshul gyi sgo nas cig car pa dang rim gyis pa'i zhugs pa gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas la dbye na du ma yod de/ dbang po'i sgo nas der gyur pa'i dad mos dang mthong thob pa gnyis/ sbyor ba'i sgo nas tsam khyad gnyis/ spang bya'i sgo nas cig car ba dang rim gyis pa gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ phyir 'ong zhugs 'bras kyi 'jog tshul yod de/ 'dod nyon drug pa spong phyir du zhugs pa dang spangs pa'i sgo nas 'jog pa'i phyir/ dbye na du ma yod de/ dbang po'i sgo nas rno rtul gnyis/ spang bya spong tshul gyi sgo nas chags bral sngon song dang 'bras bu rim gyis pa gnyis yod pa'i phyir/

phyir mi 'ong zhugs 'bras kyi 'jog tshul yod de/ 'dod nyon dgu pa spong phyir du zhugs pa dang spangs pa'i sgo nas 'jog pa'i phyir/ phyir mi 'ong zhugs pa la gnyis yod de/ chags bral sngon song dang 'bras bu rim gyis pa'i phyir mi 'ong zhugs pa gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ phyir mi 'ong 'bras gnas la dbye na mang du yod de/ 'dod par tshe yongs su gyur ma gyur gnyis/ ma gyur pa la gzugs nyer 'gro gzugs med nyer 'gro /phyir mi 'ong mthong chos zhi/ lus mngon byed dang bzhi/ gzugs gnyer 'gro la/ der gyur pa'i bar 'da' ba/ skye 'da' ba/ gong 'pho ba dang gsum/ bar 'da' ba la myur bar 'da' ba/ myur bar mi 'da' ba/ yun ring mo zhig nas 'da' ba dang gsum/ skye 'da' pa la skyes tsam nas 'da' ba/ 'du byed med par 'da' ba/ 'du byed dang bcas te 'da' ba gsum/ gong 'pho ba la 'og min 'gro dang*/ srid tsher 'gro ba gnyis/ 'og min 'gro la 'phar ba/ phyed 'phar ba/ gnas thams cad du 'chi 'pho ba dang gsum/ gzugs med nyer 'gro la skye 'da' ba dang*/ gong 'pho ba gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ dgra bcom zhugs 'bras kyi 'jog tshul yod de/ srid nyon dgu pa spong phyir du zhugs pa dang spangs pa'i sgo nas 'jog pa'i phyir/ dgra bcom zhugs pa la dbye na du ma yod de/ dbang po'i sgo nas rno rtul gnyis/ spang bya spong tshul gyi sgo nas cig car pa dang rim gyis pa'i dgra bcom zhugs pa gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ dgra bcom 'bras gnas la dbye na du ma yod de/ spang bya'i sgo nas cig car pa dang rim gyis pa'i dgra bcom 'bras gnas gnyis/ mngon shes thob ma thob kyi sgo nas rgyan bcas rgyan med gnyis/ 'gog snyoms thob ma thob kyi sgo nas gnyis ka'i cha las grol ba dang*/ shes rab rkyang bas rnam par grol ba'i dgra bcom 'bras gnas gnyis/ dbang po'i sgo nas dbang rtul dus sbyor dang*/ dbang rnon dus mi sbyor gnyis kyi dang po la dgra bcom nyams pa'i chos can sogs lnga yod cing*/

lugs 'dir dgra bcom pa mthong chos la bden gnas kyi rtogs pa las nyams pa yod kyang*/ dgra bcom gyi rtogs pa las nyams pa med de/ rnam 'grail las/ bdag lta'i sa bon spangs pa'i phyir/ slar mi gshegs pa nyid yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ ༈ gnyis pa mtshon bya don gyi dge 'dun bshad pa la/ grangs 'dod tshul dang*/ de la rgyun zhugs sogs kyi ming gis 'dogs pa'i dgos pa gnyis/ dang po yod de/ shan+ṭi ba dang bung+nghu shris rtsa ba'i sgras zin ltar nyi shur bzhed kyang*/ slob dpon gyi ni rtsa ba'i sgras zin bcu bdun dang*/ gsum kha bskang nas nyi shu byed pa'i phyir te/ rgyun zhugs kyi skor la dbang po rno rtul gnyis/ bar pa gnyis kyi zhugs pa gnyis/ rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas tsam po ba kha bskang*/ rgyun zhugs rigs nas rigs skye gnyis/ phyir 'ong tshe cig bar chad cig pa/ shugs bstan 'bras gnas tsam po ba/ bar 'da' ba/ skye 'da' ba sogs gsum/ 'og min 'gro dbye gzhir byas nas 'phar ba gsum/ srid rtse'i mthar thug 'gro gzugs kyi chags bcom zhes pa dbye gzhir byas nas mthong chos zhi dang lus mngon byed gnyis/ dgra bcom 'bras gnas kha bskang*/ bse ru rang sangs rgyas kyi ming can dang nyi shur bzhed/ 'phags pas rtsa bas sgras zin ltar bcu drug dang rgyun zhugs bar pa gnyis kyi 'bras gnas dang dgra bcom 'bras gnas bzhi kha bskang nas nyi shur bzhed pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa de dag la rgyun zhugs sogs kyi ming gis 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ spangs rtogs chos 'thun ci rigs brtsi tshul yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin pa'i phyir/ dgos pa yod de/ sgrub phyogs nas nyan thos kha cig theg chen lam du 'khrid pa dang*/ dgag phyogs nas kha cig skyes bu zung bzhi dang gang zag brgyad kyi rnam bzhag ma bshad pa'i phyir dge 'dun dkon mchog ma bstan pas sangs rgyas kyi bka' min nam snyam pa'i log rtog 'gog pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir ro/

/༈ dmigs pa dang ni rnam pa dang*/ /zhes sogs kyi skabs su sbyor lam bshad pa la/ sbyor lam gyi rten/ brten pa sbyor lam/ blo rig gang yin dpyad pa dang gsum/ dang po la/ lus rten dang sems rten gnyis/ dang po lus rten yod de/ ngan song gsum dang*/ tshe de la mtshams med dang chos spong gi las chen po bsags la ma sbyangs pa dang*/za ma dang ma ning dang*/ sgra mi snyan pa ma gtogs pa'i gling gsum gyi mi dang 'dod lha dang gzugs khams pa'i rten la gsar du skye ba yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa yod de/ nyan thos kyi sbyor lam nyer sdogs mi lcogs med dang bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi ci rigs la brten nas skye/ rang rgyal gyi sbyor lam bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi la brten nas skye/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam de rab mtha'i bsam gtan bzhi pa'i dngos gzhi la brten nas gsar du skyes pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa brten pa theg chen gyi sbyor lam bshad pa la/ ngo bo/ /dbye ba/ skye tshul/ phye ba so so'i don dang bzhi/ dang po yod de/ theg chen thar ba cha 'thun rdzogs rjes su byung ba'i theg chen gyi don mngon rtogs de theg chen gyi sbyor lam gyi ngo bo'am mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa dbye na bzhi yod de/ theg chen gyi spyod lam drod sogs bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ gnas skabs kyi dbye na bcu gnyis yod de/ bzhi po re re la'ang chung 'bring chen po gsum gsum yod pa'i phyir/ skabs 'di'i dngos bstan gyi sbyor lam la bsgoms byung gis khyab cing*/ spyir theg chen gyi sbyor lam la bsgoms byung gtso che yang*/ des ma khyab ste/ de la thos byung dang gnyis kyang yod pa'i phyir te/ theg chen sbyor lam pas thos bsam byed dgos pa'i phyir/ gsum pa skye tshul yod de/ dang po nyid nas theg chen rigs nges pa'i byang sems tshogs lam pa des tshogs lam skad cig tha ma'i dus su stong nyid la dmigs pa'i zhi gnas la mnyam par bzhag bzhin pa'i ngang nas dpyad stobs kyis lus sems shin sbyangs kyi bde ba nam 'dren nus pa de'i tshe/

stong nyid la dmigs pa'i zhi lhag gzung 'brel thob pa na theg chen sbyor lam du 'phos pa yin pa'i phyir/ stong nyid rtogs pa'i thos bsam sgo gsum gyi shes rab gsum 'jog tshul yod de/ stong nyid ston pa'i gsung rab thos stobs kyis yid dpyod kyi tshul du stong nyid kyi don thog mar rtogs pa'i shes rab de/ stong nyid rtogs pa'i thos byung gi shes rab dang*/ go ba ltar don de nyid rtags yang dag la brten nas rtogs pa'i shes rab de/ de rtogs pa'i bsam byung gi shes rab dang*/ de'i rgyun goms pa'i zhi gnas grub pa'i dus kyi shes rab de stong nyid rtogs pa'i bsgoms byung gi shes rab tu 'jog pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa so so'i don la/ theg chen sbyor lam bzhi po 'jog tshul yod de/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam drod de shes sgrib nyon mongs gzung rtog kun btags mngon gyur ba 'dzoms pa'i nus pa khyad par can thob pa'i sgo nas dang*/ sbyor lam rtse mo de shes sgrib rnam byang gzung rtog kun btags mngon 'gyur ba 'joms pa'i nus pa khyad par can thob pa'i sgo nas dang*/ sbyor lam bzod pa de shes sgrib rdzas 'dzin rtog pa kun btags mngon 'gyur ba 'joms pa'i nus pa khyad par can thob pa'i sgo nas dang*/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam chos mchog de shes sgrib btags 'dzin rtog pa kun btags mngon 'gyur ba 'joms pa'i nus pa khyad par can thob pa'i sgo nas 'jog pa'i phyir/ der thal/ drod nas gzung ba'i chos nyid la gsal snang thob/ rtse mo nas 'phel/ bzod pa nas 'dzin pa'i chos nyid la gsal snang thob/ chos mchog nas 'phel ba'i sgo nas de ltar 'joms par byed pa'i phyir/ der thal/ mdo sde rgyan las/ de tshe de yi bzung ba yi/ rnam par g.yeng ba de spong 'gyur/ 'di ltar de yi 'jug thogs su/ 'dzin pa'i rnam par g.yeng ba spong*/ zhes gsungs pa'-i phyir/ khyad par de ltar 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan yod de/

gzung 'dzin gyi chos bzhi po de la nges dka' sla'i khyad par yod pa'i phyir/ drod sogs kyi ming gis 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ stong nyid rtogs pa'i zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi bsgoms 'byung gi ye shes kyi me dang por skyes pas drod/ de rab tu 'phel bas rtse mo dang*/ stong nyid la mi skrag pas bzod pa dang*/ 'jig rten pa'i lam gyi mchog yin pas chos mchog ces brjod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa blo rig gang yin la/ dman lam sngon du ma song ba'i stong nyid rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi sbyor lam bzhi po de tshad ma min te/ de mngon sum tshad ma min zhing*/ rjes dpag kyang ma yin pa'i phyir/ dang po ma yin te/ des stong nyid mngon sum du ma rtogs pa'i phyir/ rjes dpag kyang ma yin te/ bsgoms byung gi mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ des na tshad min gyi blo yin la/ de yang stong nyid la dpyad shes yin te/ blo rig bdun po gang rung yin/ gzhan drug po gang yang min pa'i phyir/ der thal/ tshad ma min zhing*/ gzhan lnga po gang rung yang ma yin pa'i phyir/ phyi ma der thal/ the tshom dang log shes min pa ni nges sla la/ yid dpyod kyang min te/ stong nyid la mi slu ba'i rig pa yin pa phyir/ snang la ma nges pa'i blo min te/ mngon sum ma yin pa'i phyir/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam de/ dman pa'i sbyor lam las khyad chos drug gi khyad par du 'phags te/ dmigs pa mi rtag la sogs bcu drug gtso bor bden par grub ma grub dpyod par dmigs par ldan/ rnam pa bden med du gtso bor sgom/ theg chen mthong lam gyi nye rgyu byed/ thabs shes rdzogs par ston pa'i theg chen dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang ldan/ rnam rtog bzhi spang bya'i gtso bor byed/ snga ma snga ma las phyi ma phyi ma rtogs pa khyad par can gong nas gong 'phel 'gyur ba'i chung 'bring chen po'i khyad chos dang ldan pa'i phyir/ ༈ khyad par gzhan spong pa dang mi spong pa zhes sogs kyi skabs su rtsod lan la/

rtsod pa dang*/ lan bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la kho na re/ dmigs rnam lhag ma rnams ston pa'i gzhung gis dmigs rnam lhag ma rnams chos can bden bzhi la brten pa sgras zin la mi ston pa mi rigs par thal/ dmigs lhag ma rnams chos can bden bzhi la brten pa sgras zin la ma bstan na de ltar brten pa go mi nus pa'i phyir/ zhes rtsod/ gnyis pa lan ni/ de ltar sgras zin la ma bstan kyang dmigs pa rnams lhag ma rnams bden bzhi la brten pa mi go ba'i skyon med de/ drod chung ngu'i dmigs rnam gyi skabs su bden pa'i rten can de yi ni/ zhes chos can bden bzhi la brten pa sgras zin la brjod pa'i rigs 'gros kyis go nus pa'i phyir/ der thal gzhung lhag ma de dag gis bden bzhi'i khyad chos mi rtag sogs sgras zin la brjod pa gang zhig /gzhi gcig la ltos pa'i chos can brjod pa'i sgra gnyis po de gzhi de la ltos te khyad par gzhan spong mi spong ma gtogs gzhi gcig po de brjod pa la khyad par med pa'i phyir/ phyi ma grub ste/ rnam 'grel las/ gnyis kas gcig gcig brjod mod kyi/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gzhi gcig la ltos te chos dang chos can brjod pa'i sgra'i khyad par yod de/ sgra'i mi rtag ces brjod pa'i ngag de/ sgra la ltos te chos brjod kyi sgra dang khyad par gzhan spong gi sgra yin la/ sgra mi rtag ces pa'i ngag de sgra la ltos te chos can brjod pa'i sgra dang khyad par gzhan mi spong ba'i sgra yin pa'i phyir/ de yang yin te/ snga ma des sgra khyad gzhi khyad chos gnyis kyi nang nas khyad chos lta bur go bar byed pas de la ltos pa'i chos brjod kyi sgra dang*/ mi rtag pa de sgra las gzhan gyi khyad chos yin pa blo ngor spangs te go bar byed pas de la ltos pa'i khyad par gzhan spong gi sgra yin la/ sgra mi rtag ces pa'i ngag des sgra khyad gzhi khyad chos gnyis kyi nang nas khyad gzhi lta bur go bar byed pas de la ltos pa'i chos can brjod pa dang*/

mi rtag pa de sgra las gzhan gyi khyad chos yin pa blo ngor spangs pa'i tshul gyis go bar byed pas na de la ltos pa'i khyad chos gzhan mi spong pa'i sgra yin pa'i phyir te/ don de la ltos pa'i chos brjod pa'i sgra dang khyad par gzhan spong gi sgra don gcig /don de la ltos pa'i chos can brjod pa'i sgra dang khyad par gzhan mi spong gi sgra gnyis don gcig yin pa'i phyir/ ༈ gzhi dang de yi gnyen po yi/ zhes sogs gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa'i rnam gzhag la/ spyir bstan pa dang*/ bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ spyir sgra don 'dres rung du 'dzin pa'i zhen rig ni rtog pa'i 'jog byed yin la/ de la gnyis yod de/ rtog pa don 'thun dang don mi 'thun gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ ngo bo/ /dbye ba dang so so'i don/ grangs nges/ go rim/ rnam pa'i khyad par/ dgos pa dang drug /dang po yod de/ rang gi dmigs yul gyi chos la dmigs nas bden par 'dzin pa'i bden 'dzin de/ skabs 'di'i dngos bstan gyi spang bya rtog pa'i ngo bo'am mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa de la dbye na gnyis yod de/ der gyur pa'i shes sgṛ+ib gzung rtog dang 'dzin rtog gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ gzung rtog la yang gnyis yod de/ nyon mongs gzung rtog dang rnam byang gzung rtog gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ de gnyis kyi khyad par yod de/ rim pa bzhin du rang g-i dmigs yul du gyur pa'i nyon mongs phyogs dang rnam byang phyogs kyi chos la dmigs nas longs spyod byar bden par 'dzin pa'i sgo nas 'jog pa'i phyir/ nyon mongs phyogs dang rnam byang phyogs kyi chos gnyis kyi khyad par yod de/ sdug kun gnyis lta bu dang po dang*/ 'gog lam gnyis lta bu phyi ma yin pa'i phyir/ 'dzin rtog la yang gnyis yod de/ der gyur pa'i rdzas 'dzin rtog pa dang btags 'dzin rtog pa gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ de gnyis kyi khyad par yod de/

rim pa ltar dmigs yul du gyur ba'i rdzas 'dzin dang btags 'dzin la dmigs nas longs spyod byed dang spyod pa por bden par 'dzin pa'i tshul gyi sgo nas 'jog pa'i phyir/ 'di'i gzung rtog dang 'dzin rtog gnyis rang gi dmigs yul gzung 'dzin la dmigs pa ni yul dang yul can la dmigs tshul gyi dbang du byas pa yin te/ gzung ba ni yul gzugs sogs dang 'dzin pa ni yul can gang zag dang shes pa lta bu ci rigs la byed pa'i phyir/ longs sbyad bya dang spyod pa por bden par 'dzin zhes pa'i don yod de/ shes bya dang bsgom bya dang spang bya dang thob bya sogs bya ba'i sgo nas bden par 'dzin pa ni longs spyod byar bden par 'dzin pa'i don yin la/ shes byed dang shes pa po dang sgom byed dang sgom pa po dang spong byed dang spong pa po dang thob byed dang thob pa po sogs byed las dang byed pa po ci rigs kyi sgo nas bden par 'dzin pa ni longs spyod pa por bden par 'dzin pa'i don yin pa'i phyir/ rdzas 'dzin dang btags 'dzin zhes pa'i khyad par yod de/ rdzas btags la dmigs pa'i sgo nas bzhag pa'i phyir/ rdzas yod la rnam grangs kyi sgo nas mang ste/ rigs pas grub pa'i rdzas yod/ brtan pa'i rdzas yod/ don byed nus pa'i rdzas yod/ rang rkya thub pa'i rdzas yod dang bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ de rnams kyi khyad par yod de/ shes bya thams cad dang po/ /rtag pa rnams gnyis pa/ dngos po rnams gsum pa yin la/ shes pa dang kha dog lta bu bzhi pa yin pa'i phyir/ phyi ma 'di rdzas yod dngos yin zhing snga ma gsum dngos gnas pa min te/ gzhan la rdzas yod min pa yod cing rtag pa yin na rdzas yod min pas khyab pa'i phyir/ btags yod kyi khyad par yod de/ skyes bu dang shing rta dang ka bum lta bu sogs yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa grangs nges yod de/ gzung 'dzin gyi chos la rnam pa bzhir grangs nges pa'i phyir/

bzhi pa la/ rnam par rtog pa bzhi la go rim de ltar 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ rnam rtog bzhi mgo gnon dka' sla'i dbang gis de ltar du bshad pa'i phyir/ der thal/ gzung 'dzin gyi chos la nges dka' sla'i khyad par yod pa'i phyir/ lnga pa dgag sgrub gang gi rnam pa can yin pa yod de/ dmigs yul kun rdzob kyi chos la dmigs pa la phal cher sgrub rtog dang*/ stong nyid la dmigs pa rnams dgag rtog yin pa'i phyir/ drug pa 'dir gzung 'dzin gyi chos la dmigs pa'i bden 'dzin gyi rnam rtog bzhi bshad pa la dgos pa yod de/ 'jug ldog gi yul yul can gang la yang bden pa 'dzin mi rung bar bstan pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir ro/ ༈ /sems mi 'gong pa nyid la sogs/ zhes sogs kyi skabs su sbyir bstan pa dang*/ bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ spyir yongs 'dzin gyi khyad par yod de/ rang la blang dor gyi gnas legs par ston pa'i skyes bu zhig la 'jog pa'i phyir/ de la gnyis yod de/ khyad par can dang phal pa gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ nges legs dang mngon mtho tsam ston pa'i sgo nas de ltar du yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ byang sems sbyor lam pa'i yongs 'dzin gyi khyad par yod de/ de la thabs shes rdzogs par ston pa'i phyi'i yongs 'dzin dang*/ de srid zhi gang rung gi mthar mi ltung bar 'dzin pa'i nang gi yongs 'dzin gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ de gnyis kyi khyad par yod de de la chos ston pa'i mchog gi sprul sku lta bu dang po dang*/ de'i rgyud kyi thabs shes khyad par can rnams gnyis pa yin pa'i phyir/ /༈ rtogs pa yi ni chos drug dang*/ /zhes sogs kyi skabs su rigs kyi rnam bzhag la/ nyan thos sde ba dang*/ theg chen pa'i lugs gnyis/ dang po yod de/ bye brag smra bas bdag dang bdag gi ba la ma chags pa'i sems pa zhig rigs su 'dod cing*/ de yang chos gos ngan ngon tsam gyis chog pa dang*/

de bzhin du bsod nams ngan ngon tsam dang*/ gnas mal ngan ngon tsam gyis chog shes pa'i sems pa gsum dang*/ spong pa dang sgom pa la dga' ba dang bzhi 'phags pa'i rigs su 'dod cing*/ dang po gsum lam sgrub pa'i rkyen dang*/ bzhi ba de sgrub tshul dngos yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ sems tsam pa'i lugs dang dbu ma pa'i lugs gnyis/ dang po la/ ngo bo/ /dbye ba/ khyad par/ rigs 'dus byas su sgrub tshul dang bzhi/ dang po yod de/ rang 'bras zag med kyi rtog pa skye rung zhig de yin pa'i phyir te/ kun gzhi khas len pa dag gis kun gzhi'i steng dang*/ khas mi len pas nang gi skye mched drug gi steng na yod pa'i zag med sems kyi sa bon la bzhed pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa dbye na gnyis yod de/ rang bzhin gnas rigs dang*/ rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa de gnyis kyi khyad par yod de/ thos sogs kyi rkyen gyis gsos ma btab pa de dang po dang*/ gsos btab pa'i zag med sems kyi sa bon de gnyis pa yin pa'i phyir/ lung gi rjes 'brang gi sems tsam pas rigs chad kyi sems can 'dod pa yin te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ la la gcig tu nyes pa sbyor nges yod/ la la dkar po'i phyogs rnams kun tu bcom/ la la thar pa cha 'thun dge ba med/ dkar po dman pa yod pa rgyu dang bral/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rigs chad kyi sems can yin na/ rigs rgyud la med pas ma khyab ste/ rigs dman pa tsam rgyud la ldan yang rigs chad du 'dod pa'i phyir te/ dkar po dman pa yod pa rgyu dang bral zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa rigs gnyis po de 'dus byas yin te/ sems can gyi rgyud la zag med sems kyi khyad par khams mi 'dra ba bden grub gsum dang*/ de bzhin du mos pa dang*/ sgrub pa dang*/ byang chub mi 'dra ba bden grub gsum gsum 'byung ba'i phyir/ der thal/ rgyan las/ khams rnams dang ni mos pa dang*/

/sgrub pa tha dad dbye ba dang*/ / 'bras bu tha dad dmigs pa'i phyir/ /rigs yod du ni nges par brjod/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ /rigs gnyis la mchog dman yod de/ rang bzhin gnas rigs dman la/ rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs mchog tu 'dod pa'i phyir te/ dang po rgyu dus kho nar yod cing phyi ma 'bras dus su yod pa'i phyir/ sems tsam pa'i lugs la rigs 'dus byas yin te/ des rigs gnyis 'dus byas su khas blangs pa la/ slob dpon 'phags pa sogs kyis de ltar na sems can gyi rgyud kyi chos nyid de 'dus byas su thal ba'i skyon 'phen pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa dbu ma pa'i lugs la/ rigs kyi ngo bo/ /dbye ba/ rigs sad pa'i phan yon/ ma sad pa'i nyes dmigs/ sgra don/ rigs chad mi 'dod tshul/ rigs nas 'khrid tshul dang bdun/ dang po yod de/ sangs rgyas su 'gyur rung de/ rigs kyi ngo bo'am mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa dbye na gsum yod de/ rang bzhin gnas rigs/ rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs/ de gnyis las gzhan pa dang gsum yod pa'i phyir/ dang po yod de/ sems can gyi sems kyi chos nyid dang sems bden stong de rang bzhin gnas rigs yin pa'i phyir/ de la yang gnyis yod de/ lam ma zhugs kyi gang zag gi rgyud kyi rang bzhin gnas rigs dang*/ lam zhugs gang zag gi rgyud kyi de gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ phyi ma yod de/ rtogs pa'i chos bcu gsum gyi chos nyid lta bu de yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs la gsum yod de/ gang zag dang*/ shes pa dang*/ ldan min 'du byed gsum yod pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ sems can thams cad de yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ sems can thams cad 'tshang rgya ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa grub ste/ sems can gyi rgyud kyi dge bar gyur pa'i shes pa thams cad de yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa grub ste/ sems can gyi rgyud kyi zag med sems ky-i sa bon lta bu de yin pa'i phyir/

rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs la rgyas gyur gyi rigs kyis ma khyab ste/ thos sogs kyis gsos ma btab pa'i sems kyi sa bon rnams rgyas 'gyur yin yang rgyas gyur ma yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa de gnyis las gzhan pa'i rigs yod de/ byang sems tshogs lam pa rtag pas stong ba dang de'i ldog pa lta bu de yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa rigs sad pa'i phan yon yod de/ rigs sad na ngan 'gror skye dka' zhing skyes kyang myur du thar ba dang der sdug bsngal chung du tsam myong ba dang*/ 'khor ba las skyo zhing sems can smin par byed nus pa'i phyir te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ ring mo zhig nas ngan song du/ 'gro zhing myur du thar ba dang*/ der yang sdug bsngal chung ngu myong*/ skyo bcas sems can smin par byed/ ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa rigs ma sad pa'i nyes dmigs yod de/ de'i dbang gis nyon mongs shas che ba dang*/ grogs ngan gyi dbang du 'gro ba dang*/ 'tsho ba'i yo byad kyis 'phongs pa dang*/ gzhan gyis dbang du 'gro ba sogs yin pa'i phyir te/ de nyid las/ nyon mongs goms dang grogs ngan dang*/ phongs dang gzhan gyi dbang nyid dang*/ mdor na rigs kyi nyes dmigs ni/ rnam pa bzhir ni shes par bya/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rigs sad pa'i rtags sam mtshan ma bzhi yod de/ byang chub kyi sems ma skyes kyang de'i sngon du snying rje dang mos pa dang bzod pa rgya chen po sgom pa la dga' ba dang sbyin pa rgya chen po gtong ba sogs dge ba sgrub pa la'ang dga' ba'i phyir te/ de nyid las/ sbyor ba'i sngon du snying rje dang*/ mos pa dang ni bzod pa dang*/ / dge la yang dag spyod pa ni/ /rigs kyi rtags su shes par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ dper na/ du ba yod pa mthong ba'i tshe me dang*/ chu skyar yod pa mthong ba ni chu yod pa'i dpog pa lta bu yin te/ chos bcu pa'i mdo las/ du ba las ni me shes dang*/ /chu skyar las ni chur shes ltar/

/byang chub sems dpa' blo ldan gyi/ /rigs ni mtshan ma dag las shes/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ skabs 'dir bstan gyi rigs yod de/ theg chen sgrub pa bden stong de theg chen sgrub pa'i rten rang bzhin gnas rigs su byas nas/ theg chen sgrub pas rang nyid la dmigs nas de nyid gong 'phel du 'gyur pa'i sgo nas 'jog pa yin pa'i phyir/ lnga pa sgra don yod de/ rigs zhes pa ni rgyu'i don yin pas/ sangs rgyas su 'gyur ba'i rgyu dngos btags ci rigs byed pas na de ltar du brjod pa'i phyir/ drug pa la/ 'dir rigs chad kyi sems can mi 'dod de/ sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la rten rang bzhin gnas rigs kyis khyab pas sems can thams cad 'tshang rgya rung yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ sems can gyi sems rgyud kyi dri ma rnams 'bral rung yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ dri ma rnams ni glo bur ba'i sprin bzhin byung ba yin gyi sems kyi rang bzhin ma yin pa'i phyir/ rigs chad yod pa gsungs pa'i mdo rnams drang don yin te/ dgongs gzhi dgos pa dngos la gnod byed gsum gyi sgo nas drang don du 'grel ba'i phyir/ dgongs gzhi yod de/ chos la sdang ba'i log sred can yun ring por thal bar mi 'thob pa la dgongs pa'i phyir/ dgos pa yod de/ de dag chos la sdang ba 'gog pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gnod byed yod de/ sems can rnams kyi rgyud kyi sgrib pa gnyen pos spang du rung ba dang*/ sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las 'jug cing rang bzhin gyi gnas rigs kyis khyab pa sogs yin pa'i phyir/ sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin gnas rigs kyis khyab ste/ rgyud bla ma las/ de bzhin nyid ni thams cad la/ khyad med gyur kyang rnam dag pa/ de bzhin gshegs nyid de yi phyir/ 'gro kun de yi snying po can/ zhes gsungs shing*/ de yang dpe dgu don dgu'i sgo nas 'chad par mdzad pa'i phyir/

bdun pa'i rigs nas 'khrid tshul yod de/ thog mar nyan sa nas bshad pa ltar mos pa shes par byas te theg pa che chung gi sde snod thos par byas nas de'i don la 'khrid/ de nas skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa ltar 'khrid pa na nges 'byung byams snying rje byang chub sems dang spyod pa phyin drug la slob tshul sogs la rim gyi 'khrid pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang rgyan 'dir rigs sngon du mi 'chad par sems bskyed sngon du bshad pa dang mi 'gal te/ skye rim gyi dbang du byas na rigs sngon du 'chad rigs kyang*/ 'dir theg chen lam gyi 'jug sgo nas bshad rim gyi dbang du byas te sems bskyed de sngon du bshad pa tsam yin pa'i phyir/ ༈ rkun po phyung ba dang sgo 'phar bcad pa ltar dus mnyam pa zhes sogs kyi skabs su spang gnyen gyi rnam gzhag la/ spy-i dang bye brag gnyis las/ dang po ni/ gnyen pos spang bya spong tshul la don mi 'dra ba yod de/ sdom pa lta bu rang gi spang bya spong ba ni re zhig spong ba dang*/ bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi skyes pa'i tshe 'dod nyon spangs zhes pa ni mnyam gzhag de'i dus su 'dod nyon mngon 'gyur ba mi 'jug pa'i don dang*/ sbyor lam bzod pa thob na ngan 'gror mi skye ba ni rkyen ma tshang ba dang*/ byang 'phags kyis sdug kun dang skye rga na 'chi spangs pa lta bur ni snga ma ni de mi 'byung ba dang phyi ma las nyon gyis de mi byed pa'i don dang*/ longs sku lta bus ma dag pa'i zhing spangs pa der mi bzhugs pa'i don dang*/ skyes bu dam pas sdig grogs spangs pa lta bu ni de dang mi 'grogs pa'i don dang*/ rab byung gis phyi dro'i kha zas spangs pa lta bu ni dus der de mi za ba'i don yin la/ mthong sgom gyi bar chad med lam gyis spang bya spong tshul ni gnyen pos lag rjes bzhag pa'i sgo nas gtan du spong pa yin pa'i phyir/ spong tshul yod de/

theg chen mthong lam bar chad med lam skye ba la mngon du phyogs pa dang bden 'dzin kun btags 'gag pa la mngon du phyogs pa dus mnyam/ de skyes zin pa dang bden 'dzin kun btags 'gags zin pa'i tshul gyis spong ba gnyis dus mnyam zhing*/ de bzhin du rgyun mtha'i bar chad med lam skye ba la mngon du phyogs pa dang bden 'dzin lhan skyes 'gag pa la mngon du phyogs pa dus mnyam/ de skyes zin pa dang bden 'dzin lhan skyes 'gags zin pa'i tshul gyis spong ba gnyis dus mnyam zhing*/ de bzhin du nyan thos kyi mthong lam bar chad med lam skye ba la mngon du phyogs pa dang skyes zin pa dang gang zag gi bdag 'dzin kun btags 'gag pa la mngon du phyogs pa dang 'gags zin pa'i tshul gyis spong ba dang*/ de'i sgo lam rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin skye ba dang skyes pa na bdag 'dzin lhan skyes spong tshul sngar bzhin dang*/ rang rgyal gyi mthong sgom bar chad med lam skye ba la mngon du phyogs pa dang skyes zin pa na phyi rol don 'dzin gyi rtog pa kun lhan 'gag pa la mngon du phyogs pa dang 'gags zin pa rnams sngar ltar yin pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang bar chad med lam rnams skyes zin pa'i tshe rang gi ngos skal gyi spang bya de dag 'gags zin kyang spangs pa ni min te/ de dag gis drangs pa'i rnam grol lam skyes zin pa dang dus mnyam du spang bya de dag spangs par 'jog pa'i phyir te/ 'grel pa las/ rkun po phyung ba dang zhes sogs kyi don de ltar yin pa'i phyir/ /༈ de'i 'og tu bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du zhes sogs kyi skabs su/ mdo sde la grangs nges 'jog tshul yod de/ don dam bden pa dngos bstan bstan bya'i gtso bor byas nas ston pa'i sgra ji bzhin pa'i mdo de/ nges don gyi mdo'i 'jog byed yin zhing*/ mtshan gzhi ni rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum lta bu/ don dam bden pa dngos bstan bstan bya'i gtso bor byas nas mi ston pa'i mdo/

drang don gyi mdo'i 'jog byed yin pa'i phyir/ phyi ma la sgra ji bzhin pa yin min gnyis yod de/ kye ma 'dus byas rnams mi rtag /ces sogs kyi mdo lta bu sgra ji bzhin pa yin la/ sgra ji bzhin pa ma yin pa'i mdo la dgongs pa can dang*/ ldem por dgongs pa'i mdo gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ de gnyis kyi 'jog tshul yod de/ dgongs gzhi gtso bor byas nas ston pa'i sgra ji bzhin pa min pa'i mdo de/ dgongs pa can gyi mdo dang*/ dgos pa gtso bor byas nas ston pa'i sgra ji bzhin pa min pa'i mdo de/ ldem por dgongs pa'i mdor 'jog pa'i phyir/ dang po la dbye na du ma yod de/ mnyam pa nyid gsum la dgongs pa sogs bzhi yod pa'i phyir te/ de de'i tshe sangs rgyas rnam gzigs su gyur to zhes pa'i mdo lta bu mnyam pa nyid gsum la dgongs pa/ pha dang ma ni bsad bya zhing*/ zhes sogs kyi mdo lta bu don gzhan la dgongs pa/ bde ba can du skye ba'i smon lam btab pa tsam gyis der skye bar ston pa'i mdo lta bu dus gzhan la dgongs pa/ gang zag rang rkya thub pa'i rdzas yod 'dod pa'i gdul bya'i ngor dge slong dag khur yod do/ /khur 'khur ba po yod do zhes sogs kyis de yod par bstan pa lta bu gang zag gi bsam ngo la dgongs pa yin pa'i phyir te/ dang po ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni tshogs rdzogs pa dang chos sku brnyes pa dang gzhan don byed pa'i sgo gsum mnyam pa la dgongs nas gsungs/ gnyis pa ni pha ma lta bu'i sred len dang rgyal po lta bu'i 'jig lta 'khor bcas spong pa la dgongs nas gsungs/ gsum pa ni/ phyis dus gzhan zhig tu der skye ba la dgongs nas gsungs/ bzhi pa ni/ las 'bras la spyod pa po 'thad ldan du 'dzin pa'i ched du dgongs nas gsungs pa'i phyir/ ldem por dgongs pa'i mdo la du ma yod de/ zhugs pa la ldem por dgongs pa sogs bzhi yod pa'i phyir te/

nyan thos sde pa kha cig theg chen du kha drangs pa'i ched du gsungs pa'i mdo lta bu zhugs pa la ldem por dgongs pa/ mtshan nyid gsum la bden par yod med phye nas ston pa'i mdo lta bu mtshan nyid la ldem por dgongs pa/ sangs rgyas dang chos la brnyas pa sogs ky-i gnyen por gsungs pa 'ga' zhig lta bu gnyen po la ldem por dgongs pa/ rab tu grags pa'i tshig ngan pa bzhin gsungs kyang don rab tu bzang po gzhan du bsgyur nas ston pa'i pha dang ma ni zhes sogs kyi mdo lta bu bsgyur ba la ldem por dgongs pa yin pa'i phyir/ /༈ chos kyi dbyings la dbyer med phyir/ /zhes sogs kyi skabs su rtsod spong la/ dngos dang*/ 'phros don gnyis/ dang po la/ rtsod pa dang*/ lan gnyis/ dang po la kha cig na re/ sems can thams cad theg chen lam gyi gnas skabs kyi rigs la gnas par thal/ rtogs pa yi ni chog drug dang*/ zhes sogs kyis sgrub pa bcu gsum bden pas stong ba de rigs su bstan pa gang zhig /sems bden pas stong pa ni sems can thams cad la spy-ir gnas pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang*/ gnas skabs rigs gsum dang rigs can gsum gyi dbye ba mi 'thad par thal/ sems can rnams kyi sems bden stong de'i ngo bo la rigs mi 'dra ba'i khyad par med pa'i phyir zhe na/ gnyis pa lan la/ de lta bu'i khyad par med kyang rigs gsum dang rigs can gsum gyi dbye ba mi 'thad pa'i skyon med de/ theg pa gsum gyi slob pa'i sgrub pa gsum po des sems bden stong la dmigs nas rtogs pa gong nas gong 'phel du 'gyur ba'i sgo nas khyad par de lta bu 'thad pa'i phyir dang*/ brten pa sgrub pa mi 'dra ba gsum gyi dbye bas kyang de ltar du 'jog pa'i phyir/ dper na/ bum pa gcig kho na'i nang du rim pa bzhin du ka ra dang sbrang rtsi dang 'o ma sogs blug pa na bcud mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis de dang de'i bum pa'i tha snyad byed pa bzhin no/

/gnyis pa la kha cig /rgyan rtsai ba'i dgongs pa mthar thug thal 'gyur du gnas par thal/ chos kyi dbyings la dbyer med phyir/ zhes sogs rtsa 'grel gyis 'phags pa la stong nyid rtogs myong gis khyab pa bstan pa'i phyir/ der thal/ des 'phags pa yin na/ rang gi sems bden stong rtogs myong gis khyab par bstan pa'i phyir/ der thal/ 'di dag gis theg chen sgrub pa bcu gsum po des/ rang nyid bde stong la dmigs nas rtogs pa gong nas gong 'phel du 'gyur bar bstan pa la dgos pa yod pa'i phyir zhe na/ skyon med de/ gzhung 'di dag gis theg dman 'phags pa la stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs par yod pa'i tshul gyi/ de la stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pas khyab par bstan pa ma yin pa'i phyir/ de ltar yin kyang skabs gsum pa'i de ni mtshan mar dmigs sgo nas/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa dang mi 'gal te/ de ni dang po nyid nas theg dman du rigs nges pa kha cig la dgongs pa'i drang don yin pa'i phyir/ / ༈ dmigs pa chos rnams thams cad de/ /zhes sogs kyi skabs su sgrub pa'i dmigs pa bshad pa la/ ngo bo/ /dbye ba/ so so'i don bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po yod de/ theg chen sgrub pa'i sgro 'dogs gcad gzhi de/ de'i ngo bo'am 'jog byed y-in pa'i phyir/ gzhi grub na de'i dmigs pa yin pas khyab ste/ bzhi grub na/ rtogs pas khyab pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa dbye na du ma yod de/ 'dir dge sogs bcu gcig yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la/ rang 'bras rnam smin gyi 'bras bu yid 'ong 'byin rung du lung du bstan pa'i blang bya de dge ba'i ngo bo yin zhing*/ de la sgras brjod rigs kyi sgo nas bzhi yod de/ don dam pa'i dge ba sogs bzhi yod pa'i phyir te/ thar ba lta bu don dam pa'i dge ba/ ngo tsha khrel yod kyi bsam pa lta bu ngo bo nyid kyi dge ba/ de dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems sems byung lta bu mtshungs ldan gyi dge ba/

bsam pa de kun nas slong byed kyi sems sems byung lta bu kun slong gi dge ba yin pa'i phyir/ rang 'bras rnam smin yid mi 'ong 'byin rung du lung du bstan pa'i dor bya de mi dge ba'i ngo bo dang*/ de la yang sngar bzhin dbye bar bya ste/ 'khor ba lta bu don dam pa'i mi dge ba/ ngo tsha khrel med kyi bsam pa lta bu ngo bo nyid kyi mi dge ba/ de dang mtshungs ldan rnams mtshungs ldan gyi mi dge ba/ de kun nas slong byed rnams kun slong gi mi dge ba yin pa'i phyir/ rang 'bras rnam smin 'byin du mi rung ba'i chos/ lung ma bstan gyi ngo bo yin la/ de la yang bzhi yod de/ nam mkha' lta bu don dam pa'i lung ma bstan/ bzo dang spyod lam gyi las lta bu ngo bo nyid kyi lung ma bstan/ de dang mtshungs ldan dang kun nas slong byed rnams ni mtshungs ldan dang kun slong gi lung ma bstan pa yin pa'i phyir/ /༈ sems can kun mchog nyid sems dang*/ zhes sogs kyi skabs su theg chen sgrub pa'i ched du bya la/ ngo bo dang*/ dbye ba bshad pa gnyis/ dang po yod de/ gang gi ched du byang sems sgrub pa la 'jug pa'i thob byed de/ theg chen sgrub pa'i ched du bya ba dang*/ de 'dra ba'i thob bya mthar thug de/ theg chen sgrub pa'i ched du bya ba mthar thug gi ngo bo dang 'jog byed yin pa'i phyir/ dang po la dbye na du ma yod de/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi ched du bya ba gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ mthar thug la 'dir gsum yod de/ sems chen po/ /spong ba chen po/ /rtogs pa chen po gsum yod pa'i phyir/ mtshan gzhi yod de/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi snying rje chen po dang*/ sgrib gnyis spangs pa'i spangs pa dang*/ ji lta ji snyed kyi chos thams cad mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes gsum rim pa bzhin du 'jog pa'i phyir/ /༈ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyi yul la zhes sogs kyi skabs su theg chen sgrub pa'i rnam gzhag la/

spyi'i rnam gzhag dang*/ so so'i rang bzhin gnyis dang po la ngo bo/ dbye ba/ sa mtshams/ sgra don bshad pa dang bzhi/ dang po yod de/ theg chen sems bskyed la brten nas byang chub chen po'i sgrub pa'i sems dpa'i ye shes de/ theg chen sgrub pa'i ngo bo dang 'jog byed yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ ston tshul gyi sgo nas mtshan gzhi'i sgo nas dbye ba dang gnyis/ dang po la gnyis yod de/ mkhyen pa yul dang*/ sbyor ba bye brag gi sgrub pa gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ de gnyis don gcig kyang ston tshul gy-i sgo nas tha dad du bzhag pa yin te/ skabs dang po gsum du mkhyen gsum nyams su len tshul gyi sgo nas bshad pas mkhyen pa yul gyi sgrub pa dang*/ sbyaur bzhi'i skabs su phyin drug nyams len gyi ngos nas gtso bor bshad pas sbyor ba bye brag gi sgrub par bzhag pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa mtshan gzhi'i sgo nas bye na bzhi yod de/ go sgrub/ tshogs sgrub/ 'jug sgrub/ nges 'byung sgrub pa dang bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ de bzhi skabs dang po 'dir 'chad tshul yod de/ de dag so sor sbyin la sogs/ /zhes sogs kyis go sgrub/ bsam gtan gzugs med sbyin sogs dang*/ /zhes sogs kyi skabs su 'jug sgrub/ brtse dang sbyin la sogs pa drug /ces sogs kyis tshogs sgrub/ ched du bya dang mnyam nyid dang*/ zhes sogs kyis nges 'byung sgrub pa 'chad cing*/ yongs su sbyong ba rnam bcu yis/ zhes sogs kyis tshogs sgrub bye brag tu phye nas 'chad pa'i phyir/ gsum pa sa mtshams kyi khyad par yod de/ theg chen sgrub pa dang sems dpa'i ye shes don gcig cing*/ theg chen gyi tshogs lam nas rgyun mtha'i bar yod pa'i phyir/ sgrub pa bzhi so so'i sa mtshams yod de/ go sgrub theg chen gyi tshogs lam nas rgyun mtha'i bar dang*/ 'jug sgrub theg chen gyi sbyor lam nas de'i bar dang tshogs sgrub theg chen gyi sbyor lam chos mchog nas de'i bar dang*/

nges 'byung sgrub pa ni dag pa sa gsum na yod pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa sgra don yod de/ bsam pa rgya che bas go sgrub/ sbyor ba lag len rgya che bas 'jug sgrub/ tshogs rgya che bas tshogs sgrub/ rnam mkhyen du gdon mi za bar 'byin par byed pas nges 'byung sgrub pa zhes bya ba'i phyir/ /༈ gnyis pa so so'i rang bzhin la/ go sgrub sogs bzhi las dang po ni/ de dag so sor sbyin la sogs/ /zhes sogs kyi skabs su/ go sgrub bshad pa dang*/ phyin drug gi rnam gzhag bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ ngo bo/ /dbye ba/ bsdu tshul dang gsum/ dang po yod de/ phar phyin re re'i nang du drug tshang bar bsdus nas nyams su len pa'i rigs gnas kyi sems dpa'i ye shes de go sgrub gyi ngo bo dang 'jog byed yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa dbye na du ma yod de/ drug drug so drug yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa bsdu tshul yod de/ sbyin pa'i go char gyur pa'i sbyin sogs drug po de sbyin pa'i go char chos 'thun pa nas/ shes rab kyi go char gyur pa'i sbyin sogs drug shes rab kyi go cha chos 'thun pa'i phyir/ sbyin pa lta bu gcig nyams su len pa'i tshe drug ldan du nyams su len tshul yod de/ de'i tshe sbyin pa gtong ba'i sems pa de sbyin pa/ zhi bde tsam don gnyer gyi blo spong ba de tshul khrims/ gzhan gyis mi snyan par smra ba la bzod pa de bzod pa/ theg pa chen po'i chos bsgrub pa'i phyir 'bad pa de brtson 'grus/ theg chen du sems rtse gcig tu byed pa de bsam gtan/ sbyin pa'i 'khor gsum bden med du rtogs pa'i shes rab dang de nyid kyis zin pa'i sgo nas nyams su len cing*/ de bzhin du tshul khrims sogs la'ang sbyor rigs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa phyin drug gi rnam gzhag la/ /ngo bo/ /dbye ba/ grangs nges/ go rim/ sgrub tshul/ bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu/ sgra don dang bdun/ dang po yod de/
