khyad chos bzhi dang ldan pa'i theg chen gyi ye shes de phar phyin gyi ngo bo yin pa'i phyir/ khyad chos bzhi yod de/ rang gi mi mthun phyogs nyams pa/ grogs mi rtogs pa'i ye shes dang ldan pa/ sems can gyi 'dod pa rdzogs par byed pa/ sems can smin par byed pa'i khyad chos dang ldan pa'i phyir te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ sby-in pas mi mthun phyogs nyams byed/ /rnam par mi rtogs ye shes ldan/ /sems can rnams ni yongs smin byed/ /ces dang*/ de bzhin du tshul khrims sogs gzhan lnga la'ang sbyar nas gsungs pa'i phyir/ sbyor tshul yod de/ sbyin pas mi mthun phyogs ser sna nyams par byed pa de bzhin du tshul khrims kyis tshul 'chal/ bzod pas khro ba/ brtson 'grus kyis le lo/ /bsam gtan gyis rnam g.yeng*/ shes rab kyis shes 'chal nyams par byed pa sogs yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa dbye na drug yod de/ sbyin sogs phar phyin drug yod pa'i phyir/ de drug so so'i ngo bo mtshan gzhi yod de/ rim pa bzhin du der gyur pa'i chos nor gtong ba'i sems pa/ /nyan rang yid byed spong ba'i tshul khrims/ khro med kyi bzod pa/ le lo med pa'i brtson 'grus/ mi g.yeng ba'i bsam gtan/ de dag bden med rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa rnams yin pa'i phyir/ sbyin pa la dbye na du ma yod de/ zang zing gi sbyin pa dang chos kyi sbyin pa dang*/ mi 'jigs pa skyabs kyi sbyin pa gsum yod pa'i phyir/ tshul khrims la gsum yod de/ nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims/ dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims/ sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims gsum yod pa'i phyir/ bzod pa la gsum yod de/ sdug bsngal dang len gyi bzod pa/ gnod pa la ji mi snyam pa'i bzod pa/ chos la nges sems kyi bzod pa gsum yod pa'i phyir/ brtson 'grus la gsum yod de/ rtag sbyor gyi brtson 'grus/ gus sbyor gyi brtson 'grus/ sems can don byed kyi brtson 'grus gsum yod pa'i phyir/

bsam gtan la gsum yod de/ mthong chos la bden gnas kyi bsam gtan/ yon tan mngon par sgrub pa'i bsam gtan/ sems can don byed kyi bsam gtan gsum yod pa'i phyir/ shes rab la gsum yod de/ kun rdzob shes pa'i shes rab/ don dam shes pa'i shes rab/ sems can don shes pa'i shes rab gsum yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa grangs nges la du ma yod de/ bslab gsum gyi dbang du byas pa/ mngon mtho nges legs sgrub pa'i dbang du byas pa/ don gnyis sgrub pa'i byas pa rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ phar phyin dang po gsum tshul khrims kyi bslab pa'i nyams len/ tha ma gnyis shes rab kyi bslab pa'i nyams len dang*/ brtson 'grus ni bslab pa gsum car gyi nyams len du 'du ba'i phyir te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ bslab gsum dbang du mdzad nas ni/ rgyalabs pha rol phyin pa drug /yang dag bshad de dang po gsum/ tha ma gnyis ni rnam pa gnyis/ gcig ni gsum char la yang gtogs/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa grub ste/ dang po gsum mngon mtho dang*/ phyi ma gnyis nges legs/ brtson 'grus ni gnyis ka'i nyams len du 'du ba'i phyir/ gsum pa grub ste/ dang po gsum gzhan don dang*/ phyi ma gnyis rang don sgrub pa dang*/ brtson 'grus ni gnyis ka'i nyams len du 'du ba'i phyir/ bzhi pa go rim yod de/ snga ma snga ma la brten nas phyi ma phyi ma skye ba'i rgyu 'bras kyi rim pa dang*/ snga ma snga ma las phyi ma phyi ma mchog yin pa'i go rim dang*/ phra rags kyi go rim yang yin pa'i phyir te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ snga ma la brten phyi ma skye/ dman dang mchog tu gnas phyir dang*/ rags pa dang ni phra ba'i phyir/ de dag rim pa bstan pa yin/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ lnga pa sgrub tshul yod de/ dang por sbyin pa'i nyams len dang*/ de nas tshul khrims sogs rim pa nyams su len dgos pa'i phyir/ drug pa 'bras bu yod de/ rin chen 'phreng ba las/

sbyin pas longs spyod khrims kyi bde/ bzod pas mdangs ldan brtson pas brjid/ bsam gtan gyis zhi blo yis grol/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ bdun pa sgra don yod de/ mdo sde rgyan las/ dbul ba 'dor ba byed pa dang*/ bsil ba thob dang khro bzod dang*/ mchog sbyar ba dang yid 'dzin dang*/ don dam shes pa'i phyir bshad do/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa/ bsam gtan gzugs med sbyin la sogs/ zhes sogs kyi skabs su 'jug sgrub la/ spyi'i rnam gzhag dang*/ bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la ngo bo dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po yod de/ theg chen sbyor lam thob pa'i gang zag gi rgyud kyi stong nyid rtogs pa'i bsgoms byung gi shes rab kyis zin pa'i sgo nas theg chen gyi chos sbyor ba lag len gtso bor byas nas gtso bor nyams su len pa'i sems pa'i ye shes de/ 'jug sgrub kyi ngo bo dang 'jog byed yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa dbye na dgu yod de/ rgyu theg chen 'jug pa brgyad dang*/ 'bras bu rnams mkhyen la 'jug pa gcig yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ snyoms 'jug gi rten dang*/ brten pa snyoms 'jug bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ lus rten dang*/ sems rten gnyis/ dang po yod de/ sngar sbyor lam gyi rten bshad pa bzhin yin pa'i phyir/ cung zad mi 'dra ba yod de/ gzugs med kyi rten la snyoms 'jug 'ga' zhig gsar du skye ba yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa yod de/ bsam gtan gyi nyer bsdogs ni 'dod sems la brten nas skye/ de'i dngos gzhi ni nyer bsdogs la brten nas skye/ gzugs med kyi snyoms 'jug ni bsam gtan la brten nas skye ba yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa brten pa snyoms 'jug la/ bsam gtan gyi snyoms 'jug dang*/ gzugs med kyi snyoms 'jug bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la rgyas par na mang du yod kyang 'dir bsdu na bsam gtan gyi snyoms 'jug gi ngo bo yod de/

dmigs pa dang yan lag gnyis kyi nang nas yan lag gi sgo nas bzhag pas rab tu phye ba'i gong ma'i snyoms 'jug de/ de'i ngo bo yin pa'i phyir/ de la dbye na du ma yod de/ bsam gtan dang po'i snyoms 'jug sogs bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ de bzhi so so'i 'jog tshul yod de/ rang gi 'og sa 'dod pa la 'dod chags bral byed dang bral zin gang yang rung bas rab tu phye ba'i rigs gnas kyi bsam gtan gyi snyoms 'jug dang*/ de bzhin du rang gi 'og sa bsam gtan dang po dang bsam gtan gnyis pa dang gsum pa la chags pa dang bral byed dang bral zin gang yang rung bas rab tu phye ba'i snyoms 'jug rnams ni rim pa bzhin du bsam gtan dang po dang gnyis pa dang gsum pa dang bzhi pa'i snyoms 'jug gi ngo bo dang 'jog byed yin pa'i phyir/ nang gses gyi dbye na du ma yod de/ de re re la yang nyer bsdogs dang dngos gzhi gnyis re dang zhi lhag gnyis re yod pa'i phyir/ yan lag du dang ldan tshul yod de/ bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi de yan lag lnga dang ldan/ gnyis pa'i dngos gzhi de yan lag bzhi dang ldan/ gsum pa'i dngos gzhi de yan lag lnga dang ldan/ bzhi pa'i dngos gzhi de yan lag bzhi dang ldan pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa gzugs med kyi snyoms 'jug gi ngo bo yod de/ dmigs pa de dang yan lag gnyis kyi nang nas dmigs pa'i sgo nas bzhag pas rab tu phye ba'i gong sa'i snyoms 'jug de gzugs med kyi snyoms 'jug gi ngo bo yin pa'i phyir/ de la dbye na du ma yod de/ gzugs med nam mkha'i snyoms 'jug sogs bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ de bzhi so so'i 'jog tshul yod de/ rang gi 'og sa bsam gtan bzhi pa dang gzugs med dang po sogs bzhi la chags pa dang bral byed dang bral zin gang rung gi gong ma'i snyoms 'jug yin pa'i sgo nas 'jog pa'i phyir/ nang tshan gyis dbye na du ma yod de/ de re re la'ang de gyur pa'i nyer bsdogs dang dngos gzhi gnyis re dang zhi lhag gnyis re yod pa'i phyir/

'bras bu skye ba'i bsam gzugs kyi khyad par yod de/ rgyu snyoms 'jug gi bsam gzugs bsgoms stobs kyis thob pa'i gong ma gnyis kyi zag bcas rnam smin gyi phung po lta bu yin pa'i phyir/ lhag ma ni gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /༈ gsum pa/ brtse dang sbyin la sogs pa drug /zhes sogs kyi skabs su tshogs sgrub la/ ngo bo/ /dbye ba/ tshogs gsum gyi khyad par dang gsum/ dang po yod de/ theg chen sbyor lam chos mchog chen po thob pa'i gang zag gi rgyud kyi tshogs rgya chen pos zin pa'i sgo nas/ byang chen 'byin byed kyi sems dpa'i ye shes de/ de'i ngo bo dang 'jog byed yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa dbye na du ma yod de/ der gyur pa'i snying rje chen po dang phyin drug gi tshogs sgrub sogs bcu bdun yod pa'i phyir/ dang po snying rje la/ ngo bo dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po yod de/ sdug bsngal can gy-i sems can la bu cig pa ltar sdug bsngal dang bral 'dod kyi snying rje de/ snying rje chen po'i ngo bo yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa dbye na gsum yod de/ der gyur pa'i sems can tsam la dmigs pa'i snying rje/ chos la dmigs pa'i snying rje/ dmigs med kyi snying rje chen po dang gsum yod pa'i phyir/ de gsum gyi khyad par gsum yod de/ rang gi dmigs yul du gyur pa'i sems kyi mi rtag pa la sogs pa'i rnam pa ma shar bar sdug bsngal dang bral 'dod kyi snying rje chen po de dang po dang*/ de lta bu'i sems can mi rtag pa dang rags pa'i bdag med kyi rnam pa shar ba'i sgo nas sdug bsngal dang bral 'dod kyi snying rje chen po de gnyis pa dang*/ de bden med kyi rnam pa shar ba'i sgo nas sdug bsngal dang bral 'dod kyi snying rje chen po de gsum pa yin pa'i phyir/ gzungs kyi tshogs tsam la dbye na mang yang 'dir gzungs khyad par can la dbye na bzhi yod de/ tshig gi gzungs dang*/

don gyi gzungs dang*/ bzod pa'i gzungs dang*/ gsang sngagasakyi gzungs rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ de bzhi'i khyad par yod de/ thos pa'i gsung rab kyi tshig bskal pa'i bar du mi brjed par 'dzin nus pa'i gzungs de dang po dang*/ don bskal ba'i bar du mi brjed par dran nus pa'i gzungs de gnyis pa dang*/ stong nyid kyi don la mi skrag pas rab tu phye ba'i gzungs de gsum pa dang*/ sdig pa zhi bar byed pa sogs kyi gsang sngags kyi khyad par can rtsom nus pa'i gzungs de bzhi pa yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa tshogs gsum bshad pa la/ ye shes kyi tshogs/ sa'i tshogs/ gnyen po'i tshogs sgrub dang gsum/ dang po yul dang yul can la du ma yod de/ yul de la stong nyid nyi shu dang*/ yul can la yang de rtogs pa'i ye shes nyi shu yod pa'i phyir/ dang po yod de/ nang stong pa nyid la sogs pa bcu drug dang*/ dngos po stong pa nyid dang*/ dngos po med pa stong pa nyid dang*/ rang gi ngo bo stong pa nyid dang*/ gzhan gyi ngo bo stong pa nyid dang bzhi ste nyi shu yod pa'i phyir/ mdo las yul stong nyi shu bshad pa'i tshig gis yul can nyi shu yang 'phangs pa'i phyir/ nang stong pa nyid sogs nyi shu rtogs pa'i sa bcu'i 'phags pa'i ye shes bcu bdun dang sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyi ldog pa gsum yang 'phangs nas ston pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa sa'i tshogs ni/ yongs su sbyor ba rnams bcu yis/ /zhes sogs kyis 'chad cing*/ 'di la bzhi/ sa'i ngo bo/ /sa'i yon tan/ sa'i nges tshig /sa'i yongs sbyong bshad pa dang bzhi/ dang po yod de/ snying rje chen po dang stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i sgo nas yon tan gyi rten byed pa'i theg chen 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa de/ sa'i ngo bo yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa yon tan la/ phar phyin lhag tshul/ skye ba 'dzin tshul/ yon tan thob tshul/ rtogs pa dang rmi lam gyi khyad par/

spang bya'i khyad par dang lnga/ dang po yod de/ sa dang po sbyin pa'i phar phyin gyi nyams len lhag pa thob pa nas/ sa bcu par ye shes kyi phar phyin gyi nyams len lhag ma thob pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa yod de/ sa dang po 'dzam bu'i gling la dbang bas 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po'i skye ba 'dzin pa dang*/ de bzhin du gnyis pa nas bcu pa'i bar gling bzhi dang*/ sum cu rtsa gsum/ 'thab bral/ dga' ldan/ 'phrul dga'/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed/ stong dang po/ /stong gsum/ gnas gtsang lha'i rgyal por skye ba 'dzin nus pa'i phyir/ gsum pa yod de/ sa dang por yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis thob/ skad cig la sangs rgyas brgya'i zhal mthong de rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs/ bskal brgyar gnas nus/ sngon dang phyi mtha'i bskal ba brgya brgya la ye shes kyi gzigs pa 'jug /ting nge 'dzin brgya la 'jug ldang byed/ 'jig rten gyi khams brgya g.yo bar byed/ de brgyar 'gro /de brgya snang bar byed/ chos kyi sgo mi'adra ba brgya 'gyed/ rang gi lus brgyar cig car du sprul nus/ de re re'i 'khor du byang sems brgya phrag re res skor ba byed nus pa'i yon tan dang ldan cing*/ yon tan de rnams sa gnyis par stong phrag bcu gnyis/ gsum par 'bum phrag bcu gnyis/ bzhi par bye ba phrag bcu gnyis/ lnga par bye ba stong phrag bcu gnyis/ drug par khrag khrig bcu gnyis/ bdun par khrag khrig 'bum phrag bcu gnyis/ brgyad par stong gsum gyi rdul dang mnyam pa'i yon tan/ dgu par stong gsum 'jig rten gyi khams grangs med 'bum phrag bcu'i rdul phra rab kyi grangs dang mnyam pa/ bcu par sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i yon tan rnams gong 'phel du byas nas thob par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ bzhi pa yod de/ sa dang por chos dbyings kun tu 'gro ba'i don rtogs pa nas/ sa bcu bar yid kyi byed las gnas gyur pa'i sgo nas chos nyid rtogs pa la dbang ba'i rtogs pa thob cing rmi lam du sa dang por stong gsum 'di gter bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gi gang ba nas bcu par de bzhin bshegs pa'i sku la tshangs pa bye ba khrag khrig brgyad stong du mas bskor nas chos ston pa rmi ba 'byung ba'i phyir/

lnga pa yod de/ sa bcu so sos phar phyin bcu so so'i nyams len lhag pa thob pa la bgegs byed kyi sgrib pa bcu spong zhing*/ dman lam sngon du ma song bas ni sa dang po'i ngo bor gyur pa'i mthong lam bar chad med kyis mthong spang nyon mongs brgya dang bcu gnyis kyi sa bon spang ba nas/ de'i ngo bor gyur pa'i sgo lam bar chad med lam nas rgyun mtha'i bar chad med lam gyi bar rang rang gi ngo skal gyi sgom spang nyon mongs bcu drug gi sa bon spong ba'i bar yin pa'i phyir/ mthong spang nyon mongs la brgya dang bcu gnyis yod de/ 'dod pa'i sas bsdus kyi lta ba lnga/ lta min lnga/ de dag bden bzhi la dmigs pa'i sgo nas bzhi bcu/ de bzhin du khams gong ma gnyis la khong khro bor pa'i so drug so drug dang bcas pa'i brgya dang bcu gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ sgom spang nyon mongs la bcu drug tu 'byed tshul yod de/ ngo bo'i sgo nas 'dod chags sogs rtsa nyon drug la khams kyi sgo nas 'dod pa na drug dang*/ gong ma gnyis su khong khro dor bas lnga lnga dang bcas pa'i bcu drug yod pa'i phyir/ shes sgrib spong tshul yang yod de/ bden 'dzin kun btags dang lhan skyes gnyis po re re la yang brgya rtsa brgyad du mthong spang mthong lam dang*/ sgom spang rnams sgom lam bar chad med lam dgus spong ba'i phyir/ brgya rtsa brgyad du 'byed tshul yod de/ khams gsum po re re'i sas bsdus kyi bden bzhi la dmigs pa'i shes sgrib gzung 'dzin gyi rnam par rtog pa dgu bzhi so drug pa gsum tshan gcig yod pa'i phyir/ kun tu rmongs pa spong tshul yod de/ sa bcu po re res kun tu rmongs pa gnyis re spong ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa nges tshig la/ sa spyi dang*/ so so'i nges tshig gnyis/ dang po yod de/ 'jig rten gyi sas sems can dpag med gnas pa'i rten byed cing*/ lo rtog skyed pa dang gnas pa'i rten byed pa bzhin du/

byang sems kyi sas kyang byang sems dpag med 'jigs pa med par gnas par byed/ yon tan ma thob pa thob par byed thob pa rnams gong 'phel du byed pa'i phyir ro/ gnyis pa so so'i nges tshig yod de/ mdo sde rgyan las/ byang chub la ni nye ba dang*/sems can don 'grub mthong ba'i phyir/ de phyir rab dga' zhes brjod do/ /zhes pa nas/ sprin bzhin gnyis kyis nam mkha'i khyon/ /khyab pa'i phyir na chos kyi sprin/ /zhes pa'i bar 'byung ba ltar yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa yongs spyong la/ yongs spyong kyi grangs dang*/ sar 'pho mtshams bshad pa gnyis/ dang po yod de/ sa dang po la yongs sbyong bcu/ gnyis pa la brgyad/ gsum pa la lnga/ bzhi pa la bcu/ lnga pa la bcu/ drug pa la bcu gnyis/ bdun pa la nyi shu zung*/ brgyad pa la brgyad/ dgu pa la yongs sbyong bcu gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ sbyor tshul yod de/ bden med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i sgo nas sa'i skyon sel zhing yon tan rdzogs par byed pa'i sgo nas sbyong bar byed pa'i phyir/ 'o na/ sa dgu man chad yon sbyong gi sgo nas bshad nas sa bcu la de ltar mi 'chad pa ci zhe na de'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ sa bcu pa mtshan nyid kyi sgo nas bshad pas dgu pa man chad kyi mtshan nyid kyang shes par 'gyur ba dang*/ gzhan dgu yon sbyong gi sgo nas bshad pas bcu pa'i yon sbyong kyang shes par 'gyur ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ bcu pa mtshan nyid kyi sgo nas bshad tshul yod de/ 'da' bya sa dgu 'das shing*/ sangs rgyas kyi sa ma thob gong du sangs rgyas kyi sa zhes brjod pa'i byang sems kyi sa de nyid de'i mtshan nyid du bstan pa'i phyir/ sa bcu ba'i 'da' bya'i sa la dgu yod de/ dman pa'i sa brgyad dang byang sems kyi sa 'og ma rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ de dgu la 'da' bya'i sa zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ dman pa'i sa brgyad po de shes mthong gis bltas nas 'da' ba'i las dang*/

byang sems kyi sa de rnams ni bskyed cing gnas nas 'da' ba'i lam yin pa'i phyir/ dman pa'i sa brgyad yod de/ rigs kyi sa/ brgyad pa'i sa/ mthong pa'i sa/ srab pa'i sa/ 'dod chags dang bral ba'i sa/ byas pa rtogs pa'i sa/ nyan thos kyi sa/ rang sangs rgyas kyi sa rnams yin pa'i phyir ro/ /ngo bo yod de/ nyan thos kyi sbyor lam de dang po/ /rgyun zhugs zhugs pa'i rtogs pa de gnyis pa/ rgyun zhugs mthong lam pa'i rtogs pa gsum pa/ phyir 'ong gi rtogs pa bzhi pa/ phyir mi 'ong gi rtogs pa lnga pa/ nyan thos dgra bcom gyi rtogs pa drug pa/ rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas gzhan rnams kyi rtogs pa nyan thos kyi sa/ rang rgyal gyi rtogs pa rnams rang rgyal gyi sar 'jog pa'i phyir/ sa bcu pa'i ye shes de la sangs rgyas kyi sa zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ sa bcu pa'i rjes thob nas gzhan don byed pa'i sgo sangs rgyas dang mnyam pa zhig thob pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis de ltar brjod pa'i phyir te/ rgyud bla ma las byang chub sems dpa'i tshul 'di ni/ /rjes thob de bzhin gshegs rnams dang*/ /sems can yang dag sgrol ba la/ /'jig rten na ni mnyam pa nyid/ /ces gsungs pa'i phy-i+ir/ gnyis pa 'pho 'tshams yod de/ sa rang rang gi ngo skal gyi yongs sbyongs nam rdzogs pa nas gzhan du 'phos par 'jog pa'i phyir/ ༈ gsum pa/ mthong dang sgom pa'i lam dag la/ /zhes sogs kyi skabs su gnyen po'i tshogs sgrub la/ ngo bo dang dbye ba gnyis/ dang po yod de/ mthong sgom gyi spang bya rtog pa'i gnyen po gyur ba'i theg chen 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa de/ de'i ngo bo yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa dbye na gnyis yod de/ mthong spang gnyen po dang*/ sgom spang gnyen po'i tshogs gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ de gnyis so so'i ngo bo yod de/ mthong spang dngos su 'joms byed kyi theg chen mthong lam bar chad med lam de/ dang po'i ngo bo dang*/

rang gi ngo skal gyi sgom spong dngos su 'joms byed kyi theg chen gyi sgom lam bar chad med lam de/ gnyis pa'i ngo bo yin pa'i phyir/ de gnyis so so'i spang bya la bzhi bzhi yod de/ mthong sgom gyi spang bya'i shes sgrib gzung 'dzin gyi rnam par rtog pa bzhi bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ /༈ bzhi pa/ ched du bya dang mnyam nyid dang*/ zhes sogs kyi skabs su nges 'byung sgrub pa la/ ngo bo dang*/ /dbye ba gnyis/ dang po yod de/ rang 'bras rnam mkhyen du gdon mi za bar nges par 'byin pa byed pa'i dag sa'i ye shes de/ nges 'byung sgrub pa'i ngo bo dang 'jog byed yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa dbye na brgyad yod de/ nges par 'byung ba brgyad kyi sgo nas phye ba brgyad yod pa'i phyir/ de yang yin te/ chen po gsum gcig tu byas pa dang*/ sems chen po'i khyad par gsum/ spong ba chen po'i khyad par gnyis/ rtogs pa chen po sgrub byed kyi khyad par gnyis dang bcas pa'i brgyad yod pa'i phyir/ yum gsum brjod bya'i skyed tshal du/ /mkhyen gsum dpag bsam ljon pa la/ /sbyor bzhi'i yal 'dab rgyas pa'i rtser/ /sku bzhi'i 'bras bu'i khur gyis brjid/ rgyal yum rgyan gyi lus bzang por/ /mdzes byed chos bcus spras pa ni/ /gsal byed dang po'i spyi don 'dir/ /snang bas blo gsal dga' ba skyed/ /ces bya'o/ /skabs dang po'i spyi don 'di yang shākya'i btsun pa bshad sgrub ming can gyis co ne dgon nyid du dad pas sbyar ba'o// //maṅga laṃ// //
